text:
Ilm-e-Quran sab se bari daulat hai. Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein suraton ke awal huruf-e-muqatta'at ki tafsir puri tarah bayan ho chuki hai jise dobara bayan karne ki zarurat nahi. Go yeh bhi marwi hai ki murad 'Ta-Ha' se 'Aye shakhs' hai, kehte hain ki yeh Nabti kalma hai, koi kehta hai mu'arrab hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein ek paon zameen par tikate aur dusra utha lete to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari yani Ta-Ha, yani zameen par dono paon tika diya karo. Hum ne yeh Quran tujh par is liye nahi utara ki tujhe mashaqqat-o-takleef mein daal dein. Kehte hain ki jab Quran par amal Huzoor ﷺ ne aur aap ke sahabah ne shuru kar diya to mushrikeen kehne lage ki yeh log to achhi khaasi museebat mein par gaye, is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ki yeh paak Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein daalne ko nahi utara balki yeh neko ke liye ibrat hai, yeh ilhami ilm hai jise yeh mila use bahut bari daulat mil gayi. Chunancha Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ki jis ke sath Allah ka irada bhalayi ka ho jata hai use deen ki samajh ata farmata hai. Hafiz Abul Qasim Tabarani ؒ ek marfu sahih hadith laaye hain ki Qiyamat ke din jab ke Allah Ta'ala apne bando ke faisle farmane ke liye apni kursi par ijlas farmayega to ulama se farmayega ki maine apna ilm aur apni hikmat tumhein isisi liye ata farmayi thi ki tumhare tamam gunaho ko bakhsh dun aur kuch parwah na karun ki tum ne kya kiya hai? Pehle log Allah ki ibadat ke waqt apne ap ko rassiyon mein latka liya karte the, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh mashaqqat apne is kalam-e-pak ke zariye asan kar di aur farma diya ki yeh Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein dalna nahi chahta, jaise farman hai jis qadar asani se parha jaye parh liya karo. Yeh Quran shaqawat aur badbakhti ki cheez nahi balki rahmat-o-noor aur daleel-e-jannat hai. Yeh Quran naik logo ke liye jin ke dilon mein khouf-e-Ilahi hai tazkirah, waz-o-hidayat-o-rahmat hai. Ise sun kar Allah ke naik anjam bande halal haram se waqif ho jate hain aur apne dono jahan sanwaar lete hain. Yeh Quran tere Rab ka kalam hai, usi ki taraf se nazil shuda hai jo har cheez ka khaliq, malik, raziq, qadir hai. Jis ne zameen ko neechi aur kaseef banaya hai aur jis ne asman ko ooncha aur lateef banaya hai. Tirmizi wagaira ki sahih hadith mein hai ki har asman ki motai panch sau saal ki rah hai aur har asman se dusre asman tak ka fasla bhi panch sau saal ka hai. Hazrat Abbas wali hadith mein Imam Ibn Abi Hatim ne isi ayat ki tafsir mein warid ki hai. Woh Rahman apne arsh par mustawi hai, iski puri tafsir Surah Al-A'raf mein guzar chuki hai, yahan warid karne ki zarurat nahi. Salamati wala tareeqa yahi hai ki ayat-o-ahadith-e-sifat ko ba-tariq-e-salaf-e-saliheen un ke zahiri alfaaz ke mutabiq hi mana jaye baghair kaifiyat talbi ke aur baghair tehreef-o-tashbeeh aur tateel-o-tamseel ke. Tamam cheezein Allah ki hi mulk hain, usi ke qabze aur irade aur chahat tale hain, wahi sab ka khaliq, malik, Ilah aur Rab hai kisi ko is ke sath kisi tarah ki shirkat nahi.

Satween zameen ke neeche bhi jo kuch hai sab usi ka hai. Ka'ab kehte hain is zameen ke neeche pani hai, pani ke neeche phir zameen hai, phir us ke neeche pani hai, isi tarah musalsal phir us ke neeche ek patthar hai, us ke neeche ek farishta hai, us ke neeche ek machhli hai jis ke dono bazu arsh tak hain, us ke neeche hawa, khala aur zulmat hai, yehin tak insan ka ilm hai baqi Allah jaane. 

Hadith mein hai har do zameeno ke darmiyan paanch sau saal ka fasla hai, sab se oopar ki zameen machhli ki pusht par hai jis ke dono bazu aasman se mile hue hain, yeh machhli ek patthar par hai, woh patthar farishte ke haath mein hai. Doosri zameen hawaon ka khazana hai. Teesri mein jahannum ke patthar hain. Chauthi mein jahannum ki gandhak. Paanchwein mein jahannum ke saanp hain. Chhathi mein jahannumi bichhoo hain. Satween mein dozakh hai, wahin Ibleas jakra hua hai, ek haath aage hai ek peeche hai, jab Allah chahta hai use chhod deta hai. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ka farmaan Rasul ﷺ se hona bhi ghor talab hai.

Musnad Abu Ya'ala mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah ؓ farmate hain hum Ghazwa-e-Tabuk se laut rahe the, garmi sakht tarakhay ki pad rahi thi, do do chaar chaar admi muntashir ho kar chal rahe the, main lashkar ke shuroo mein tha, achanak ek shakhs aaya aur salam kar ke poochne laga tum mein se Muhammad kaun hain? Rasul ﷺ. Main us ke sath ho gaya, mere sathi aage badh gaye. Jab lashkar ke darmiyan ka hissa aaya to us mein Huzoor Rasul ﷺ the, main ne use batlaya ke yeh hain Huzoor Rasul ﷺ surkh rang ki oontni par sawar hain, sar par boja dhoop ke kapda daale hue hain, woh aap ki sawari ke paas gaya aur nakeel thaam kar arz karne laga ke aap hi Muhammad hain? ﷺ. Aap ne jawab diya ke haan. Us ne kaha main chand baatein aap se daryaft karna chahta hoon jinhein zameen walon mein se bajaz ek do admiyon ke aur koi nahi jaanta. Aap ne farmaya tumhein jo kuch poochna ho pooch lo. 

Us ne kaha bataiye Anbiya-e-Allah sote bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya un ki aankhein so jati hain lekin dil jaagta rehta hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad hua hai. 

Ab yeh farmaiye ke kya wajah hai ke bacha kabhi to baap ki shabahat par hota hai kabhi maan ki? Aap ne farmaya suno, mard ka pani safed aur ghaleez hai aur aurat ka pani patla hai, jo pani ghalib aa gaya usi par shabih jati hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad farmaya. 

Achha yeh bhi farmaiye ke bachhe ke kaun se aaza mard ke pani se bante hain aur kaun se aurat ke pani se? Farmaya mard ke pani se haddiyan, rag aur phattay aur aurat ke pani se gosht, khoon aur baal. Us ne kaha yeh bhi sahi jawab mila. 

Achha yeh bataiye ke is zameen ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya ek makhlooq hai. 
Kaha un ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya zameen. 
Kaha us ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya pani. 
Kaha pani ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya andhera. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Farmaya hawa. 
Kaha hawa ke neeche? Farmaya tar mitti. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Aap ke aansoo nikal aaye aur irshad farmaya ke makhlooq ka ilm to yehin tak pahunch kar khatam ho gaya. Ab Khaliq ko hi is ke aage ka ilm hai.

Aye sawal karne wale is ki baabat tu jis se sawal kar raha hai woh tujh se ziyada janne wala nahi. Us ne Aap ki sadaqat ki gawahi di Aap ne farmaya ise pehchana bhi? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Us ke Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai Aap ne farmaya yeh Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) thay. Yeh hadith bhi bohat hi ghareeb hai aur is mein jo waqia hai bara hi ajeeb hai is ke rawiyon mein Qasim bin Abdur Rahman ka tafarrud hai jinhein Imam Yahya bin Moin (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh kisi cheez ke barabar nahi. Imam Abu Hatim Razi bhi unhein zaeef kehte hain. Imam Ibn Adi farmate hain yeh maroof shakhs nahi aur is hadith mein ghalat malat kar diya hai Allah hi janta hai ke jaan booch kar aisa kiya hai ya aisi hi kisi se li hai. 
Allah woh hai jo zahir o batin oonchi neeechi choti bari sab kuch janta hai jaise farman hai ke aalan kar de ke is Quran ko Us ne nazil farmaya hai jo asman o zameen ke asrar-e-amal ko us ke ilm se bhi pehle Allah Ta'ala janta hai. Tamam guzishta mojooda aur ayindah makhlooq ka ilm Us ke pas aisa hi hai jaisa aik shakhs ka ilm. Sab ki paidaish aur mar kar jalana bhi Us ke nazdeek aik shakhs ki paidaish aur us ki mout ke baad ki doosri baar ki zindagi ke misl hai. 
Tere dil ke khayalat ko aur jo khayalat nahi aate un ko bhi woh janta hai. Tujhe ziyada se ziyada aaj ke poshida aamal ki khabar hai aur ise tu tum kal kya chhupao ge un ka bhi ilm hai. Arade hi nahi balki waswase bhi Us par zahir hain. Kiye hue amal aur jo karega woh amal Us par zahir hain. Wohi mabood-e-barhaq hai aala sifatain aur behtareen naam Isi ke hain. Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein Asma-e-Husna ke mutaliq hadeethen guzar chuki hain.

Jab lashkar ke darmiyan ka hissa aaya to us mein Huzoor Rasul ﷺ the, main ne use batlaya ke yeh hain Huzoor Rasul ﷺ surkh rang ki oontni par sawar hain, sar par boja dhoop ke kapda daale hue hain, woh aap ki sawari ke paas gaya aur nakeel thaam kar arz karne laga ke aap hi Muhammad hain? ﷺ. Aap ne jawab diya ke haan. Us ne kaha main chand baatein aap se daryaft karna chahta hoon jinhein zameen walon mein se bajaz ek do admiyon ke aur koi nahi jaanta. Aap ne farmaya tumhein jo kuch poochna ho pooch lo. 

Us ne kaha bataiye Anbiya-e-Allah sote bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya un ki aankhein so jati hain lekin dil jaagta rehta hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad hua hai. 

Ab yeh farmaiye ke kya wajah hai ke bacha kabhi to baap ki shabahat par hota hai kabhi maan ki? Aap ne farmaya suno, mard ka pani safed aur ghaleez hai aur aurat ka pani patla hai, jo pani ghalib aa gaya usi par shabih jati hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad farmaya. 

Achha yeh bhi farmaiye ke bachhe ke kaun se aaza mard ke pani se bante hain aur kaun se aurat ke pani se? Farmaya mard ke pani se haddiyan, rag aur phattay aur aurat ke pani se gosht, khoon aur baal. Us ne kaha yeh bhi sahi jawab mila. 

Achha yeh bataiye ke is zameen ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya ek makhlooq hai. 
Kaha un ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya zameen. 
Kaha us ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya pani. 
Kaha pani ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya andhera. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Farmaya hawa. 
Kaha hawa ke neeche? Farmaya tar mitti. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Aap ke aansoo nikal aaye aur irshad farmaya ke makhlooq ka ilm to yehin tak pahunch kar khatam ho gaya. Ab Khaliq ko hi is ke aage ka ilm hai.

Aye sawal karne wale is ki baabat tu jis se sawal kar raha hai woh tujh se ziyada janne wala nahi. Us ne Aap ki sadaqat ki gawahi di Aap ne farmaya ise pehchana bhi? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Us ke Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai Aap ne farmaya yeh Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) thay. Yeh hadith bhi bohat hi ghareeb hai aur is mein jo waqia hai bara hi ajeeb hai is ke rawiyon mein Qasim bin Abdur Rahman ka tafarrud hai jinhein Imam Yahya bin Moin (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh kisi cheez ke barabar nahi. Imam Abu Hatim Razi bhi unhein zaeef kehte hain. Imam Ibn Adi farmate hain yeh maroof shakhs nahi aur is hadith mein ghalat malat kar diya hai Allah hi janta hai ke jaan booch kar aisa kiya hai ya aisi hi kisi se li hai. 
Allah woh hai jo zahir o batin oonchi neeechi choti bari sab kuch janta hai jaise farman hai ke aalan kar de ke is Quran ko Us ne nazil farmaya hai jo asman o zameen ke asrar-e-amal ko us ke ilm se bhi pehle Allah Ta'ala janta hai. Tamam guzishta mojooda aur ayindah makhlooq ka ilm Us ke pas aisa hi hai jaisa aik shakhs ka ilm. Sab ki paidaish aur mar kar jalana bhi Us ke nazdeek aik shakhs ki paidaish aur us ki mout ke baad ki doosri baar ki zindagi ke misl hai. 
Tere dil ke khayalat ko aur jo khayalat nahi aate un ko bhi woh janta hai. Tujhe ziyada se ziyada aaj ke poshida aamal ki khabar hai aur ise tu tum kal kya chhupao ge un ka bhi ilm hai. Arade hi nahi balki waswase bhi Us par zahir hain. Kiye hue amal aur jo karega woh amal Us par zahir hain. Wohi mabood-e-barhaq hai aala sifatain aur behtareen naam Isi ke hain. Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein Asma-e-Husna ke mutaliq hadeethen guzar chuki hain.

Ilm-e-Quran sab se bari daulat hai. Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein suraton ke awal huruf-e-muqatta'at ki tafsir puri tarah bayan ho chuki hai jise dobara bayan karne ki zarurat nahi. Go yeh bhi marwi hai ki murad 'Ta-Ha' se 'Aye shakhs' hai, kehte hain ki yeh Nabti kalma hai, koi kehta hai mu'arrab hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Huzoor ﷺ namaz mein ek paon zameen par tikate aur dusra utha lete to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari yani Ta-Ha, yani zameen par dono paon tika diya karo. Hum ne yeh Quran tujh par is liye nahi utara ki tujhe mashaqqat-o-takleef mein daal dein. Kehte hain ki jab Quran par amal Huzoor ﷺ ne aur aap ke sahabah ne shuru kar diya to mushrikeen kehne lage ki yeh log to achhi khaasi museebat mein par gaye, is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ki yeh paak Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein daalne ko nahi utara balki yeh neko ke liye ibrat hai, yeh ilhami ilm hai jise yeh mila use bahut bari daulat mil gayi. Chunancha Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ki jis ke sath Allah ka irada bhalayi ka ho jata hai use deen ki samajh ata farmata hai. Hafiz Abul Qasim Tabarani ؒ ek marfu sahih hadith laaye hain ki Qiyamat ke din jab ke Allah Ta'ala apne bando ke faisle farmane ke liye apni kursi par ijlas farmayega to ulama se farmayega ki maine apna ilm aur apni hikmat tumhein isisi liye ata farmayi thi ki tumhare tamam gunaho ko bakhsh dun aur kuch parwah na karun ki tum ne kya kiya hai? Pehle log Allah ki ibadat ke waqt apne ap ko rassiyon mein latka liya karte the, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh mashaqqat apne is kalam-e-pak ke zariye asan kar di aur farma diya ki yeh Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein dalna nahi chahta, jaise farman hai jis qadar asani se parha jaye parh liya karo. Yeh Quran shaqawat aur badbakhti ki cheez nahi balki rahmat-o-noor aur daleel-e-jannat hai. Yeh Quran naik logo ke liye jin ke dilon mein khouf-e-Ilahi hai tazkirah, waz-o-hidayat-o-rahmat hai. Ise sun kar Allah ke naik anjam bande halal haram se waqif ho jate hain aur apne dono jahan sanwaar lete hain. Yeh Quran tere Rab ka kalam hai, usi ki taraf se nazil shuda hai jo har cheez ka khaliq, malik, raziq, qadir hai. Jis ne zameen ko neechi aur kaseef banaya hai aur jis ne asman ko ooncha aur lateef banaya hai. Tirmizi wagaira ki sahih hadith mein hai ki har asman ki motai panch sau saal ki rah hai aur har asman se dusre asman tak ka fasla bhi panch sau saal ka hai. Hazrat Abbas wali hadith mein Imam Ibn Abi Hatim ne isi ayat ki tafsir mein warid ki hai. Woh Rahman apne arsh par mustawi hai, iski puri tafsir Surah Al-A'raf mein guzar chuki hai, yahan warid karne ki zarurat nahi. Salamati wala tareeqa yahi hai ki ayat-o-ahadith-e-sifat ko ba-tariq-e-salaf-e-saliheen un ke zahiri alfaaz ke mutabiq hi mana jaye baghair kaifiyat talbi ke aur baghair tehreef-o-tashbeeh aur tateel-o-tamseel ke. Tamam cheezein Allah ki hi mulk hain, usi ke qabze aur irade aur chahat tale hain, wahi sab ka khaliq, malik, Ilah aur Rab hai kisi ko is ke sath kisi tarah ki shirkat nahi.

Satween zameen ke neeche bhi jo kuch hai sab usi ka hai. Ka'ab kehte hain is zameen ke neeche pani hai, pani ke neeche phir zameen hai, phir us ke neeche pani hai, isi tarah musalsal phir us ke neeche ek patthar hai, us ke neeche ek farishta hai, us ke neeche ek machhli hai jis ke dono bazu arsh tak hain, us ke neeche hawa, khala aur zulmat hai, yehin tak insan ka ilm hai baqi Allah jaane. 

Hadith mein hai har do zameeno ke darmiyan paanch sau saal ka fasla hai, sab se oopar ki zameen machhli ki pusht par hai jis ke dono bazu aasman se mile hue hain, yeh machhli ek patthar par hai, woh patthar farishte ke haath mein hai. Doosri zameen hawaon ka khazana hai. Teesri mein jahannum ke patthar hain. Chauthi mein jahannum ki gandhak. Paanchwein mein jahannum ke saanp hain. Chhathi mein jahannumi bichhoo hain. Satween mein dozakh hai, wahin Ibleas jakra hua hai, ek haath aage hai ek peeche hai, jab Allah chahta hai use chhod deta hai. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ka farmaan Rasul ﷺ se hona bhi ghor talab hai.

Kehte hain ki jab Quran par amal Huzoor ﷺ ne aur aap ke sahabah ne shuru kar diya to mushrikeen kehne lage ki yeh log to achhi khaasi museebat mein par gaye, is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ki yeh paak Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein daalne ko nahi utara balki yeh neko ke liye ibrat hai, yeh ilhami ilm hai jise yeh mila use bahut bari daulat mil gayi. Chunancha Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ki jis ke sath Allah ka irada bhalayi ka ho jata hai use deen ki samajh ata farmata hai. Hafiz Abul Qasim Tabarani ؒ ek marfu sahih hadith laaye hain ki Qiyamat ke din jab ke Allah Ta'ala apne bando ke faisle farmane ke liye apni kursi par ijlas farmayega to ulama se farmayega ki maine apna ilm aur apni hikmat tumhein isisi liye ata farmayi thi ki tumhare tamam gunaho ko bakhsh dun aur kuch parwah na karun ki tum ne kya kiya hai? Pehle log Allah ki ibadat ke waqt apne ap ko rassiyon mein latka liya karte the, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh mashaqqat apne is kalam-e-pak ke zariye asan kar di aur farma diya ki yeh Quran tumhein mashaqqat mein dalna nahi chahta, jaise farman hai jis qadar asani se parha jaye parh liya karo. Yeh Quran shaqawat aur badbakhti ki cheez nahi balki rahmat-o-noor aur daleel-e-jannat hai. Yeh Quran naik logo ke liye jin ke dilon mein khouf-e-Ilahi hai tazkirah, waz-o-hidayat-o-rahmat hai. Ise sun kar Allah ke naik anjam bande halal haram se waqif ho jate hain aur apne dono jahan sanwaar lete hain. Yeh Quran tere Rab ka kalam hai, usi ki taraf se nazil shuda hai jo har cheez ka khaliq, malik, raziq, qadir hai. Jis ne zameen ko neechi aur kaseef banaya hai aur jis ne asman ko ooncha aur lateef banaya hai. Tirmizi wagaira ki sahih hadith mein hai ki har asman ki motai panch sau saal ki rah hai aur har asman se dusre asman tak ka fasla bhi panch sau saal ka hai. Hazrat Abbas wali hadith mein Imam Ibn Abi Hatim ne isi ayat ki tafsir mein warid ki hai. Woh Rahman apne arsh par mustawi hai, iski puri tafsir Surah Al-A'raf mein guzar chuki hai, yahan warid karne ki zarurat nahi. Salamati wala tareeqa yahi hai ki ayat-o-ahadith-e-sifat ko ba-tariq-e-salaf-e-saliheen un ke zahiri alfaaz ke mutabiq hi mana jaye baghair kaifiyat talbi ke aur baghair tehreef-o-tashbeeh aur tateel-o-tamseel ke. Tamam cheezein Allah ki hi mulk hain, usi ke qabze aur irade aur chahat tale hain, wahi sab ka khaliq, malik, Ilah aur Rab hai kisi ko is ke sath kisi tarah ki shirkat nahi.

Satween zameen ke neeche bhi jo kuch hai sab usi ka hai. Ka'ab kehte hain is zameen ke neeche pani hai, pani ke neeche phir zameen hai, phir us ke neeche pani hai, isi tarah musalsal phir us ke neeche ek patthar hai, us ke neeche ek farishta hai, us ke neeche ek machhli hai jis ke dono bazu arsh tak hain, us ke neeche hawa, khala aur zulmat hai, yehin tak insan ka ilm hai baqi Allah jaane. 

Hadith mein hai har do zameeno ke darmiyan paanch sau saal ka fasla hai, sab se oopar ki zameen machhli ki pusht par hai jis ke dono bazu aasman se mile hue hain, yeh machhli ek patthar par hai, woh patthar farishte ke haath mein hai. Doosri zameen hawaon ka khazana hai. Teesri mein jahannum ke patthar hain. Chauthi mein jahannum ki gandhak. Paanchwein mein jahannum ke saanp hain. Chhathi mein jahannumi bichhoo hain. Satween mein dozakh hai, wahin Ibleas jakra hua hai, ek haath aage hai ek peeche hai, jab Allah chahta hai use chhod deta hai. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ka farmaan Rasul ﷺ se hona bhi ghor talab hai.

Musnad Abu Ya'ala mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah ؓ farmate hain hum Ghazwa-e-Tabuk se laut rahe the, garmi sakht tarakhay ki pad rahi thi, do do chaar chaar admi muntashir ho kar chal rahe the, main lashkar ke shuroo mein tha, achanak ek shakhs aaya aur salam kar ke poochne laga tum mein se Muhammad kaun hain? Rasul ﷺ. Main us ke sath ho gaya, mere sathi aage badh gaye. Jab lashkar ke darmiyan ka hissa aaya to us mein Huzoor Rasul ﷺ the, main ne use batlaya ke yeh hain Huzoor Rasul ﷺ surkh rang ki oontni par sawar hain, sar par boja dhoop ke kapda daale hue hain, woh aap ki sawari ke paas gaya aur nakeel thaam kar arz karne laga ke aap hi Muhammad hain? ﷺ. Aap ne jawab diya ke haan. Us ne kaha main chand baatein aap se daryaft karna chahta hoon jinhein zameen walon mein se bajaz ek do admiyon ke aur koi nahi jaanta. Aap ne farmaya tumhein jo kuch poochna ho pooch lo. 

Us ne kaha bataiye Anbiya-e-Allah sote bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya un ki aankhein so jati hain lekin dil jaagta rehta hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad hua hai. 

Ab yeh farmaiye ke kya wajah hai ke bacha kabhi to baap ki shabahat par hota hai kabhi maan ki? Aap ne farmaya suno, mard ka pani safed aur ghaleez hai aur aurat ka pani patla hai, jo pani ghalib aa gaya usi par shabih jati hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad farmaya. 

Achha yeh bhi farmaiye ke bachhe ke kaun se aaza mard ke pani se bante hain aur kaun se aurat ke pani se? Farmaya mard ke pani se haddiyan, rag aur phattay aur aurat ke pani se gosht, khoon aur baal. Us ne kaha yeh bhi sahi jawab mila. 

Achha yeh bataiye ke is zameen ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya ek makhlooq hai. 
Kaha un ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya zameen. 
Kaha us ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya pani. 
Kaha pani ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya andhera. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Farmaya hawa. 
Kaha hawa ke neeche? Farmaya tar mitti. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Aap ke aansoo nikal aaye aur irshad farmaya ke makhlooq ka ilm to yehin tak pahunch kar khatam ho gaya. Ab Khaliq ko hi is ke aage ka ilm hai.

Aye sawal karne wale is ki baabat tu jis se sawal kar raha hai woh tujh se ziyada janne wala nahi. Us ne Aap ki sadaqat ki gawahi di Aap ne farmaya ise pehchana bhi? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Us ke Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai Aap ne farmaya yeh Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) thay. Yeh hadith bhi bohat hi ghareeb hai aur is mein jo waqia hai bara hi ajeeb hai is ke rawiyon mein Qasim bin Abdur Rahman ka tafarrud hai jinhein Imam Yahya bin Moin (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh kisi cheez ke barabar nahi. Imam Abu Hatim Razi bhi unhein zaeef kehte hain. Imam Ibn Adi farmate hain yeh maroof shakhs nahi aur is hadith mein ghalat malat kar diya hai Allah hi janta hai ke jaan booch kar aisa kiya hai ya aisi hi kisi se li hai. 
Allah woh hai jo zahir o batin oonchi neeechi choti bari sab kuch janta hai jaise farman hai ke aalan kar de ke is Quran ko Us ne nazil farmaya hai jo asman o zameen ke asrar-e-amal ko us ke ilm se bhi pehle Allah Ta'ala janta hai. Tamam guzishta mojooda aur ayindah makhlooq ka ilm Us ke pas aisa hi hai jaisa aik shakhs ka ilm. Sab ki paidaish aur mar kar jalana bhi Us ke nazdeek aik shakhs ki paidaish aur us ki mout ke baad ki doosri baar ki zindagi ke misl hai. 
Tere dil ke khayalat ko aur jo khayalat nahi aate un ko bhi woh janta hai. Tujhe ziyada se ziyada aaj ke poshida aamal ki khabar hai aur ise tu tum kal kya chhupao ge un ka bhi ilm hai. Arade hi nahi balki waswase bhi Us par zahir hain. Kiye hue amal aur jo karega woh amal Us par zahir hain. Wohi mabood-e-barhaq hai aala sifatain aur behtareen naam Isi ke hain. Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein Asma-e-Husna ke mutaliq hadeethen guzar chuki hain.

Us ne kaha bataiye Anbiya-e-Allah sote bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya un ki aankhein so jati hain lekin dil jaagta rehta hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad hua hai. 

Ab yeh farmaiye ke kya wajah hai ke bacha kabhi to baap ki shabahat par hota hai kabhi maan ki? Aap ne farmaya suno, mard ka pani safed aur ghaleez hai aur aurat ka pani patla hai, jo pani ghalib aa gaya usi par shabih jati hai. Us ne kaha baja irshad farmaya. 

Achha yeh bhi farmaiye ke bachhe ke kaun se aaza mard ke pani se bante hain aur kaun se aurat ke pani se? Farmaya mard ke pani se haddiyan, rag aur phattay aur aurat ke pani se gosht, khoon aur baal. Us ne kaha yeh bhi sahi jawab mila. 

Achha yeh bataiye ke is zameen ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya ek makhlooq hai. 
Kaha un ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya zameen. 
Kaha us ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya pani. 
Kaha pani ke neeche kya hai? Farmaya andhera. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Farmaya hawa. 
Kaha hawa ke neeche? Farmaya tar mitti. 
Kaha us ke neeche? Aap ke aansoo nikal aaye aur irshad farmaya ke makhlooq ka ilm to yehin tak pahunch kar khatam ho gaya. Ab Khaliq ko hi is ke aage ka ilm hai.

Aye sawal karne wale is ki baabat tu jis se sawal kar raha hai woh tujh se ziyada janne wala nahi. Us ne Aap ki sadaqat ki gawahi di Aap ne farmaya ise pehchana bhi? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Us ke Rasool ko hi poora ilm hai Aap ne farmaya yeh Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) thay. Yeh hadith bhi bohat hi ghareeb hai aur is mein jo waqia hai bara hi ajeeb hai is ke rawiyon mein Qasim bin Abdur Rahman ka tafarrud hai jinhein Imam Yahya bin Moin (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh kisi cheez ke barabar nahi. Imam Abu Hatim Razi bhi unhein zaeef kehte hain. Imam Ibn Adi farmate hain yeh maroof shakhs nahi aur is hadith mein ghalat malat kar diya hai Allah hi janta hai ke jaan booch kar aisa kiya hai ya aisi hi kisi se li hai. 
Allah woh hai jo zahir o batin oonchi neeechi choti bari sab kuch janta hai jaise farman hai ke aalan kar de ke is Quran ko Us ne nazil farmaya hai jo asman o zameen ke asrar-e-amal ko us ke ilm se bhi pehle Allah Ta'ala janta hai. Tamam guzishta mojooda aur ayindah makhlooq ka ilm Us ke pas aisa hi hai jaisa aik shakhs ka ilm. Sab ki paidaish aur mar kar jalana bhi Us ke nazdeek aik shakhs ki paidaish aur us ki mout ke baad ki doosri baar ki zindagi ke misl hai. 
Tere dil ke khayalat ko aur jo khayalat nahi aate un ko bhi woh janta hai. Tujhe ziyada se ziyada aaj ke poshida aamal ki khabar hai aur ise tu tum kal kya chhupao ge un ka bhi ilm hai. Arade hi nahi balki waswase bhi Us par zahir hain. Kiye hue amal aur jo karega woh amal Us par zahir hain. Wohi mabood-e-barhaq hai aala sifatain aur behtareen naam Isi ke hain. Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein Asma-e-Husna ke mutaliq hadeethen guzar chuki hain.

Aag ki talash. Yahan se Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka qissa shuru hota hai. Yeh waqia us waqt ka hai jab ke aap us muddat ko poori kar chuke the jo aap ke aur aap ke khusr sahib ke darmiyan tay hui thi aur aap apne ahl-o-iyal ko lekar das saal se zyada arse ke baad apne watan Misr ki taraf ja rahe the. Sardi ki raat thi, raasta bhool gaye the, paharon ki ghatiyon ke darmiyan andhera tha, abr chaya hua tha, harchand chaqmaq se aag nikalna chahi lekin us se bilkul aag na nikli. Idhar udhar nazrein dorayein toh dayin janib ke pahar par kuch aag dikhai di toh biwi sahibah se farmaya: Is taraf aag si nazar aa rahi hai, main jata hoon ke wahan se kuch angare le aaun taake tum seenk tap karlo aur kuch roshni bhi ho jaye aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke wahan koi aadmi mil jaye jo raasta bhi bata de. Behar soorat raaste ka pata ya aag mil hi jaye gi.

Allah Ta'ala se ham-kalaami. Jab Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) aag ke paas pohnche toh us mubarak maidan ke daayan jaanib ke darakhton ki taraf se aawaz aayi ke اے موسیٰ ! Main tera Rabb hoon tu jootiyan utaar de. Ya toh is liye yeh hukum hua ke aap ki jootiyan gadhe ke chamre ki thin ya is liye ke taazeem karani maqsood thi. Jaise ke Kaaba jaane ke waqt log jootiyan utaar kar jaate hain. Ya is liye ke us ba-barkat jagah par paon padein aur bhi wujooh bayaan kiye gaye hain. Tuwa is wadi ka naam tha. Ya yeh matlab ke apne qadam is zameen se mila do. Ya yeh matlab ke yeh zameen kayi kayi baar paak ki gayi hai aur is mein barkatein bhar di gayi hain aur baar baar dohraayi gayi hain. Lekin zyada sahih pehla qaul hi hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Iza naadahu rabbuhu bil-waadil-muqaddasi tuwa) (79. An-Nazi'aat: 16). Main ne tujhe apna barguzida kar liya hai, duniya mein se tujhe muntakhab kar liya hai, apni risalat aur apne kalaam se tujhe mumtaz farma raha hoon, us waqt ke rooye zameen ke tamam logon se tera martaba badha raha hoon. Kaha gaya hai ke Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se poocha gaya jaante bhi ho ke main ne tujhe doosre tamam logon mein se mukhtar aur pasandida kar ke shraf-e-ham-kalaami kyun baksha? Aap ne jawab diya اے اللہ mujhe is ki wajah maloom nahi, farmaya gaya is liye ke teri tarah aur koi meri taraf nahi jhuka. Ab tu meri wahi ko kaan laga kar dhyan de kar sun. Main hi mabood hoon koi aur nahi. Yahi pehla fariza hai tu sirf meri hi ibadat kiye chale jaana kisi aur ki kisi qism ki ibadat na karna, meri yaad ke liye namazein qaim karna, meri yaad ka yeh behtareen aur afzal tareen tareeqa hai ya yeh matlab ke jab main yaad aaun namaz padho. Jaise hadith mein hai ke tum mein se agar kisi ko neend aajaye ya ghaflat hojaye toh jab yaad aajaye namaz padh le kyunke farmaan-e-ilahi hai meri yaad ke waqt namaz qaim karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai jo shakhs sote mein ya bhool mein namaz ka waqt guzaar de us ka kaffara yahi hai ke yaad aate hi namaz padh le us ke siwa aur kaffara nahi. Qiyamat yaqinan aane wali hai mumkin hai main is ke waqt ke sahih ilm ko zahir na karoon. Ek qiraat ke baad (akhfiha) ke baad (min nafsi) ke alfaz bhi hain kyunke Allah ki zaat se koi cheez makhfi nahi. Yani is ka ilm bajuz apne kisi ko nahi doonga. Pas roye zameen par koi aisa nahi hua jise qiyamat ke qaim hone ka muqarrar waqt maloom ho. Yeh woh cheez hai ke agar ho sake toh khud main apne se bhi ise chhupa doon lekin Rabb se koi cheez makhfi nahi hai. Chunacha yeh malaika se poshida hai ambiya is se be-ilm hain. Jaise farmaan hai (Qul la ya'lamu man fis-samawati wal-ardal-ghaiba illallah, wa maa yash'uru an ayyana yub'asoon) (27. An-Naml: 65). Zameen aasman walon mein se suwaye Allah Wahid ke koi aur ghaib-daan nahi aur aayat mein hai qiyamat zameen-o-aasman par bhaari pad rahi hai woh achanak aajayegi yani is ka ilm kisi ko nahi. Ek qiraat mein akhfiha hai.

Waraqah farmate hain mujhe Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ؒ ne isi tarah padhaya hai. Iske maani hain azharha us din har aamil apne amal ka badal diya jayega khwah zarra barabar neki ho khwah badi ho apne kartoot ka badla us din zaroor milna hai. Pas kisi ko bhi beiman log behka na dein. Qayamat ke munkir, duniya ke maftoon, Maula ke nafarman, khwahish ke ghulam, kisi Allah ke bande ke is paak aqeedah mein ise zalzal ya tazalzul paida na karne payen agar wo apni chahat mein kamyab ho gaye toh yeh gharat hua aur nuqsan mein pada.

Main hi mabood hoon koi aur nahi. Yahi pehla fariza hai tu sirf meri hi ibadat kiye chale jaana kisi aur ki kisi qism ki ibadat na karna, meri yaad ke liye namazein qaim karna, meri yaad ka yeh behtareen aur afzal tareen tareeqa hai ya yeh matlab ke jab main yaad aaun namaz padho. Jaise hadith mein hai ke tum mein se agar kisi ko neend aajaye ya ghaflat hojaye toh jab yaad aajaye namaz padh le kyunke farmaan-e-ilahi hai meri yaad ke waqt namaz qaim karo. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke ek bohat barey aur saaf khuley maujiza ka zikr ho raha hai jo baghair Allah ki qudrat ke namumkin aur jo ghair nabi ke haath par bhi namumkin. Tur pahaad par daryaft ho raha hai ke tere daayein haath mein kya hai? Yeh sawal is liye tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki ghabrahat door ho jaye. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh sawal ba-taur taqreer ke hai yaani tere haath mein lakri hi hai yeh jaisi kuch hai tujhe maloom hai ab yeh jo ho jaye gi woh dekh lena. Is sawal ke jawab mein Kaleemullah arz karte hain yeh meri apni lakri hai jis par main tek lagata hoon yaani chalne mein mujhe yeh sahara deti hai is se main apni bakriyon ka chaara darakht se jhaar leta hoon. Aisi lakriyon mein zara mura hua loha laga liya karte hain taake patte phal aasani se utar aayein aur lakri tute bhi nahi aur bhi bohat se fawaid is mein hain. In fawaid ke bayaan mein baaz logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke yahi lakri raat ke waqt roshan chiragh ban jati thi. Din ko jab aap so jaate toh yahi lakri aap ki bakriyon ki rakhwali karti jahan kahin saya-dar jagah na hoti aap ise gaar dete yeh khaime ki tarah aap par saya karti waghera waghera lekin bazahir yeh qaul Bani Israel ka afsana maloom hota hai warna phir aaj ise ba-soorat saanp dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) is qadar kyun ghabraate? Woh toh is lakri ke ajaibat dekhte chale aate thay. Phir baaz ka qaul hai ke darasal yeh lakri Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki thi. Koi kehta hai yahi lakri Qiamat ke qareeb Dabbat-ul-Arz ki soorat mein zahir hogi. Kehte hain is ka naam Masha tha. Allah hi jaane in aqwal mein kahan tak jaan hai? Laathi ajdaha ban gayi. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko lakri ka lakri hona jata kar unhein bakhubi bedar aur hoshiyar kar ke hukm mila ke ise zameen par daal do. Zameen par parte hi woh ek zabardast ajdahay ki soorat mein phanphnati hui idhar udhar chalne phirne balki dorne bhaagne lagi. Aisa khaufnak ajdaha is se pehle kisi ne dekha hi na tha. Is ki toh yeh halat thi ke ek darakht samne aa gaya toh yeh ise hazam kar gaya. Ek chattan patthar ki raaste mein aa gayi toh is ka luqma bana gaya. Yeh haal dekhte hi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ulte paon bhaage. Awaaz di gayi ke Musa pakar le lekin himmat na pari phir farmaya Musa (A.S) dar nahi pakar le phir bhi jhunjhak baaki rahi teesri martaba farmaya tu hamare amn mein hai ab haath barha kar pakar liya. Kehte hain farman-e-Ilahi ke saath hi aap ne lakri zameen par daal di phir idhar udhar aap ki nigah ho gayi ab jo nazar dali bajaye lakri ke ek khaufnak ajdaha dikhai diya jo is tarah chal phir raha hai jaise kisi ki justaju mein ho.

Gabhun ountni jaise bare bare patharon ko asman se baatein karte hue unche unche darakhton ko ek luqme mein hi pet mein pohancha raha hai, aankhein angaron ki tarah chamak rahi hain. Is haibatnaak khoon-khwaar azdhe ko dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) sahm gaye aur peeth mod kar zor se bhage, phir Allah Ta'ala ki ham-kalami yaad aa gayi toh sharma kar thahar gaye. Wahin aawaz aayi ke Musa laut kar wahin aa jao jahan the. Aap lute lekin nihayat khaufzada the. Toh hukum hua ke apne dahane haath se ise tham lo, kuch bhi khauf na karo, hum ise is ki usi agli halat mein luta denge. Is waqt Hazrat Musa (A.S) soof ka kambal odhe hue the jise ek kante se atka rakha tha, aap ne usi kambal ko apne haath par lapet kar is haibatnaak azdhe ko pakadna chaha. Farishte ne kaha, Musa (A.S) agar Allah Ta'ala ise kaatne ka hukum de de toh kya tera yeh kambal bacha sakta hai? Aap ne jawab diya, hargiz nahi lekin yeh harkat mujh se ba-sabab mere zuaf ke sarzad ho gayi, main zaeef aur kamzor hi paida kiya gaya hoon. Ab daliri ke sath kambal hata kar haath badha kar is ke sar ko tham liya, usi waqt woh azdha phir lakdi ban gaya jaise pehle tha. Is waqt jab ke aap is ghati par chad rahe the aur aap ke haath mein yeh lakdi thi jis par tek lagaye hue the, usi haal mein aap ne pehle dekha tha, usi halat par ab haath mein ba-soorat-e-asa maujood tha.

Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko lakri ka lakri hona jata kar unhein bakhubi bedar aur hoshiyar kar ke hukm mila ke ise zameen par daal do. Zameen par parte hi woh ek zabardast ajdahay ki soorat mein phanphnati hui idhar udhar chalne phirne balki dorne bhaagne lagi. Aisa khaufnak ajdaha is se pehle kisi ne dekha hi na tha. Is ki toh yeh halat thi ke ek darakht samne aa gaya toh yeh ise hazam kar gaya. Ek chattan patthar ki raaste mein aa gayi toh is ka luqma bana gaya. Yeh haal dekhte hi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ulte paon bhaage. Awaaz di gayi ke Musa pakar le lekin himmat na pari phir farmaya Musa (A.S) dar nahi pakar le phir bhi jhunjhak baaki rahi teesri martaba farmaya tu hamare amn mein hai ab haath barha kar pakar liya. Kehte hain farman-e-Ilahi ke saath hi aap ne lakri zameen par daal di phir idhar udhar aap ki nigah ho gayi ab jo nazar dali bajaye lakri ke ek khaufnak ajdaha dikhai diya jo is tarah chal phir raha hai jaise kisi ki justaju mein ho.

Gabhun ountni jaise bare bare patharon ko asman se baatein karte hue unche unche darakhton ko ek luqme mein hi pet mein pohancha raha hai, aankhein angaron ki tarah chamak rahi hain. Is haibatnaak khoon-khwaar azdhe ko dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) sahm gaye aur peeth mod kar zor se bhage, phir Allah Ta'ala ki ham-kalami yaad aa gayi toh sharma kar thahar gaye. Wahin aawaz aayi ke Musa laut kar wahin aa jao jahan the. Aap lute lekin nihayat khaufzada the. Toh hukum hua ke apne dahane haath se ise tham lo, kuch bhi khauf na karo, hum ise is ki usi agli halat mein luta denge. Is waqt Hazrat Musa (A.S) soof ka kambal odhe hue the jise ek kante se atka rakha tha, aap ne usi kambal ko apne haath par lapet kar is haibatnaak azdhe ko pakadna chaha. Farishte ne kaha, Musa (A.S) agar Allah Ta'ala ise kaatne ka hukum de de toh kya tera yeh kambal bacha sakta hai? Aap ne jawab diya, hargiz nahi lekin yeh harkat mujh se ba-sabab mere zuaf ke sarzad ho gayi, main zaeef aur kamzor hi paida kiya gaya hoon. Ab daliri ke sath kambal hata kar haath badha kar is ke sar ko tham liya, usi waqt woh azdha phir lakdi ban gaya jaise pehle tha. Is waqt jab ke aap is ghati par chad rahe the aur aap ke haath mein yeh lakdi thi jis par tek lagaye hue the, usi haal mein aap ne pehle dekha tha, usi halat par ab haath mein ba-soorat-e-asa maujood tha.

Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko maujizat miley. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke ek bohat barey aur saaf khuley maujiza ka zikr ho raha hai jo baghair Allah ki qudrat ke namumkin aur jo ghair nabi ke haath par bhi namumkin. Tur pahaad par daryaft ho raha hai ke tere daayein haath mein kya hai? Yeh sawal is liye tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki ghabrahat door ho jaye. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh sawal ba-taur taqreer ke hai yaani tere haath mein lakri hi hai yeh jaisi kuch hai tujhe maloom hai ab yeh jo ho jaye gi woh dekh lena. Is sawal ke jawab mein Kaleemullah arz karte hain yeh meri apni lakri hai jis par main tek lagata hoon yaani chalne mein mujhe yeh sahara deti hai is se main apni bakriyon ka chaara darakht se jhaar leta hoon. Aisi lakriyon mein zara mura hua loha laga liya karte hain taake patte phal aasani se utar aayein aur lakri tute bhi nahi aur bhi bohat se fawaid is mein hain. In fawaid ke bayaan mein baaz logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke yahi lakri raat ke waqt roshan chiragh ban jati thi. Din ko jab aap so jaate toh yahi lakri aap ki bakriyon ki rakhwali karti jahan kahin saya-dar jagah na hoti aap ise gaar dete yeh khaime ki tarah aap par saya karti waghera waghera lekin bazahir yeh qaul Bani Israel ka afsana maloom hota hai warna phir aaj ise ba-soorat saanp dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) is qadar kyun ghabraate? Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Firon ke samne Kalma-e-Haq. Phir hukum huwa ke Firon ne hamari bagawat par kamar kas li hai, us ke pas ja kar ise samjhao. Wahab Rahimahullah kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko qareeb hone ka hukum diya yahan tak ke aap us darakht ke tane se lag kar khare ho gaye, dil thahar gaya, khauf aur khatra door ho gaya. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Us se kaho ke woh hamari ibadat kare, kisi ko shareek na banaye, Bani Israel ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare, unhein taklif aur eza na de. Firon bara baghi ho gaya hai, duniya ka maftoon ban kar akhirat ko faramosh kar baitha hai aur apne paida karne wale ko bhool gaya hai to meri risalat le kar us ke pas ja. Mere kaan aur meri aankhein tere sath hain, main tujhe dekhta bhalta aur teri baatein sunta sunata rahunga. Meri madad tere pas hogi main ne apni taraf se tujhe hujjatein ata farma di hain aur tujhe qawi aur mazboot kar diya hai to akela hi mera poora lashkar hai. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Meri rububiyat se bezar, meri uluhiyat se bar sar-e-paikar hai. Mujh se aankhein pher li hain, dide badal liye hain. Meri pakar se ghafil ho gaya hai. Mere azabon se be-khauf ho gaya hai. Mujhe apni izzat ki qasam agar main ise dheel dena na chahta to aasman is par toot parte zameen ise nigal jati darya ise dobo dete lekin chunke woh mere muqable ka nahi har waqt mere bas mein hai main ise dheel diye hue hoon aur is se be-parwai barat raha hoon. Main hoon bhi sari makhlooq se be-parwah. Haq to yeh hai ke be-parwai sirf meri hi sifat hai. To meri risalat ada kar, ise meri ibadat ki hidayat kar, ise tauheed-o-ikhlas ki dawat de, meri naamatein yaad dila, mere azabon se dhamka, mere ghazab se hoshyar kar de. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Usay yeh samjha ke meri maan le to main bhi maghfirat se pesh aonga. Chaar sau saal usay sarkashi karte, mere bandon par zulm dhalte, meri ibadat se logon ko rokte guzar chuke hain. Taham na main ne is par baarish band ki na paidawar roki na bimar dala na boodha kiya na maghloob kiya. Agar chahta zulm ke sath hi pakad leta lekin mera hilm bahut badha hua hai. To apne bhai ke sath mil kar is se poori tarah jehad kar aur meri madad par bharosa rakh main agar chahun to apne lashkaron ko bhej kar is ka bheja nikal dun. Lekin is be-buniyaad bande ko dikhana chahta hun ke meri jamaat ka ek bhi rooye zameen ki takaton par ghalib aaskakta hai. Madad mere ikhtiyar mein hai. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main agar chahun to tumhein itna de dun ke Firaun ki daulat is ke pasang mein bhi na asake lekin main apne bandon ko umoman ghareeb hi rakhta hun taake unki akhirat sanwri rahe yeh is liye nahi hota ke woh mere nazeeq qabil-e-ikram nahi balki sirf is liye hota hai ke dono jahan ki nematein ane wale jahan mein jama mil jayen. Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Un ke samne har ek ko ba-adab rehna chahiye. Apni zabaan aur dil ko un ka tabi rakhna chahiye. Sun le mere doston se dushmani rakhne wala goya mujhe ladai ka elan deta hai. To kya mujh se ladne ka irada rakhne wala kabhi sarsabz hosakta hai? Main ne qahr ki nazar se usay dekha aur woh tahas nahas hua. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne apna bachpan ka zamana Firaun ke ghar mein balki is ki god mein guzara tha jawani tak mulk Misr mein usi ki badshahat mein tehre rahe the phir ek qibti be-irada apke haath se margaya tha jis se ap yahan se bhaag nikle the tab se lekar aj tak Misr ki soorat nahi dekhi thi. Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ki duaein.

Jab Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko use hidayat karne ka hukum huwa to Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke mera seena khol de aur mere kaam mein aasani paida kar de agar tu khud mera madadgar na bana to yeh sakht baar mere kamzor kandhe nahi utha sakte. Aur meri zaban ki girah khol de. Chonke Aap ke bachpan ke zamane mein Aap ke samne khajoor aur angare rakhe gaye the Aap ne angara le kar munh mein rakh liya tha is liye zaban mein luknat ho gayi thi to dua ki ke mere zaban ki girah khul jaye Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke is adab ko dekhiye ke qadr-e-hajat sawal karte hain yeh nahi arz karte ke meri zaban bilkul saaf ho jaye balke dua yeh karte hain ke girah khul jaye taake log meri baat samajh lein. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam Allah se sirf hajat-rwai ke mutabiq hi arz karte hain aage nahi barhte. Chonacha Aap ki zaban mein phir bhi kuch kasar reh gayi thi jaise ke Firon ne kaha tha ke kya main behtar hoon ya yeh? Jo fard-e-maya hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain ek girah khulne ki dua ki thi jo poori hui agar poori ki dua hoti to woh bhi poori hoti. Aap ne sirf isi qadr dua ki thi ke Aap ki zaban aisi kar di jaye ke log Aap ki baat samajh liya karein. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain dar tha ke kahin woh ilzam-e-qatl rakh kar qatl na kar dein is ki dua ki jo qabul hui. Zaban mein atkao tha is ki babat dua ki ke itni saaf ho jaye ke log baat samajh lein yeh dua bhi poori hui. Dua ki ke Haroon ko bhi nabi bana diya jaye yeh bhi poori hui. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Rahimahullah ke paas un ke ek rishtedaar aaye aur kehne lage yeh to bari kami hai ke tum bolne mein ghalat bol jate ho. Aap ne farmaya bhatije kya meri baat tumhari samajh mein nahi aati? Kaha haan samajh mein to aa jati hai kaha bas yehi kafi hai Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne bhi Allah se yehi aur itni hi dua ki thi. Phir aur dua ki ke meri khariji aur zahiri imdad ke liye mera wazir bana de aur ho bhi woh mere kunbe mein se. Yani mere bhai Haroon ko nubuwwat ata farma. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt Hazrat Haroon Alaihis Salam ko Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke sath hi nubuwwat ata ki gayi. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa Razi Allahu Anha umrah ke liye jate hue kisi arabi ke yahan muqim thin ke suna ek shakhs poochta hai ke duniya mein kisi bhai ne apne bhai ko sab se ziyada nafa pohchaya hai is sawal par sab khamosh ho gaye aur keh diya ke hamein is ka ilm nahi. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Un ke samne har ek ko ba-adab rehna chahiye. Apni zabaan aur dil ko un ka tabi rakhna chahiye. Sun le mere doston se dushmani rakhne wala goya mujhe ladai ka elan deta hai. To kya mujh se ladne ka irada rakhne wala kabhi sarsabz hosakta hai? Main ne qahr ki nazar se usay dekha aur woh tahas nahas hua. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne apna bachpan ka zamana Firaun ke ghar mein balki is ki god mein guzara tha jawani tak mulk Misr mein usi ki badshahat mein tehre rahe the phir ek qibti be-irada apke haath se margaya tha jis se ap yahan se bhaag nikle the tab se lekar aj tak Misr ki soorat nahi dekhi thi. Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ki duaein.

Jab Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko use hidayat karne ka hukum huwa to Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke mera seena khol de aur mere kaam mein aasani paida kar de agar tu khud mera madadgar na bana to yeh sakht baar mere kamzor kandhe nahi utha sakte. Aur meri zaban ki girah khol de. Chonke Aap ke bachpan ke zamane mein Aap ke samne khajoor aur angare rakhe gaye the Aap ne angara le kar munh mein rakh liya tha is liye zaban mein luknat ho gayi thi to dua ki ke mere zaban ki girah khul jaye Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke is adab ko dekhiye ke qadr-e-hajat sawal karte hain yeh nahi arz karte ke meri zaban bilkul saaf ho jaye balke dua yeh karte hain ke girah khul jaye taake log meri baat samajh lein. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam Allah se sirf hajat-rwai ke mutabiq hi arz karte hain aage nahi barhte. Chonacha Aap ki zaban mein phir bhi kuch kasar reh gayi thi jaise ke Firon ne kaha tha ke kya main behtar hoon ya yeh? Jo fard-e-maya hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain ek girah khulne ki dua ki thi jo poori hui agar poori ki dua hoti to woh bhi poori hoti. Aap ne sirf isi qadr dua ki thi ke Aap ki zaban aisi kar di jaye ke log Aap ki baat samajh liya karein. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain dar tha ke kahin woh ilzam-e-qatl rakh kar qatl na kar dein is ki dua ki jo qabul hui. Zaban mein atkao tha is ki babat dua ki ke itni saaf ho jaye ke log baat samajh lein yeh dua bhi poori hui. Dua ki ke Haroon ko bhi nabi bana diya jaye yeh bhi poori hui. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Rahimahullah ke paas un ke ek rishtedaar aaye aur kehne lage yeh to bari kami hai ke tum bolne mein ghalat bol jate ho. Aap ne farmaya bhatije kya meri baat tumhari samajh mein nahi aati? Kaha haan samajh mein to aa jati hai kaha bas yehi kafi hai Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne bhi Allah se yehi aur itni hi dua ki thi. Phir aur dua ki ke meri khariji aur zahiri imdad ke liye mera wazir bana de aur ho bhi woh mere kunbe mein se. Yani mere bhai Haroon ko nubuwwat ata farma. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt Hazrat Haroon Alaihis Salam ko Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke sath hi nubuwwat ata ki gayi. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa Razi Allahu Anha umrah ke liye jate hue kisi arabi ke yahan muqim thin ke suna ek shakhs poochta hai ke duniya mein kisi bhai ne apne bhai ko sab se ziyada nafa pohchaya hai is sawal par sab khamosh ho gaye aur keh diya ke hamein is ka ilm nahi. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Firon ke samne Kalma-e-Haq. Phir hukum huwa ke Firon ne hamari bagawat par kamar kas li hai, us ke pas ja kar ise samjhao. Wahab Rahimahullah kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko qareeb hone ka hukum diya yahan tak ke aap us darakht ke tane se lag kar khare ho gaye, dil thahar gaya, khauf aur khatra door ho gaya. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Us se kaho ke woh hamari ibadat kare, kisi ko shareek na banaye, Bani Israel ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare, unhein taklif aur eza na de. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ki duaein.

Jab Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko use hidayat karne ka hukum huwa to Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke mera seena khol de aur mere kaam mein aasani paida kar de agar tu khud mera madadgar na bana to yeh sakht baar mere kamzor kandhe nahi utha sakte. Aur meri zaban ki girah khol de. Chonke Aap ke bachpan ke zamane mein Aap ke samne khajoor aur angare rakhe gaye the Aap ne angara le kar munh mein rakh liya tha is liye zaban mein luknat ho gayi thi to dua ki ke mere zaban ki girah khul jaye Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke is adab ko dekhiye ke qadr-e-hajat sawal karte hain yeh nahi arz karte ke meri zaban bilkul saaf ho jaye balke dua yeh karte hain ke girah khul jaye taake log meri baat samajh lein. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam Allah se sirf hajat-rwai ke mutabiq hi arz karte hain aage nahi barhte. Chonacha Aap ki zaban mein phir bhi kuch kasar reh gayi thi jaise ke Firon ne kaha tha ke kya main behtar hoon ya yeh? Jo fard-e-maya hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain ek girah khulne ki dua ki thi jo poori hui agar poori ki dua hoti to woh bhi poori hoti. Aap ne sirf isi qadr dua ki thi ke Aap ki zaban aisi kar di jaye ke log Aap ki baat samajh liya karein. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain dar tha ke kahin woh ilzam-e-qatl rakh kar qatl na kar dein is ki dua ki jo qabul hui. Zaban mein atkao tha is ki babat dua ki ke itni saaf ho jaye ke log baat samajh lein yeh dua bhi poori hui. Dua ki ke Haroon ko bhi nabi bana diya jaye yeh bhi poori hui. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Rahimahullah ke paas un ke ek rishtedaar aaye aur kehne lage yeh to bari kami hai ke tum bolne mein ghalat bol jate ho. Aap ne farmaya bhatije kya meri baat tumhari samajh mein nahi aati? Kaha haan samajh mein to aa jati hai kaha bas yehi kafi hai Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne bhi Allah se yehi aur itni hi dua ki thi. Phir aur dua ki ke meri khariji aur zahiri imdad ke liye mera wazir bana de aur ho bhi woh mere kunbe mein se. Yani mere bhai Haroon ko nubuwwat ata farma. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt Hazrat Haroon Alaihis Salam ko Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke sath hi nubuwwat ata ki gayi. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa Razi Allahu Anha umrah ke liye jate hue kisi arabi ke yahan muqim thin ke suna ek shakhs poochta hai ke duniya mein kisi bhai ne apne bhai ko sab se ziyada nafa pohchaya hai is sawal par sab khamosh ho gaye aur keh diya ke hamein is ka ilm nahi. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Firon ke samne Kalma-e-Haq. Phir hukum huwa ke Firon ne hamari bagawat par kamar kas li hai, us ke pas ja kar ise samjhao. Wahab Rahimahullah kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko qareeb hone ka hukum diya yahan tak ke aap us darakht ke tane se lag kar khare ho gaye, dil thahar gaya, khauf aur khatra door ho gaya. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Us se kaho ke woh hamari ibadat kare, kisi ko shareek na banaye, Bani Israel ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare, unhein taklif aur eza na de. Firon bara baghi ho gaya hai, duniya ka maftoon ban kar akhirat ko faramosh kar baitha hai aur apne paida karne wale ko bhool gaya hai to meri risalat le kar us ke pas ja. Mere kaan aur meri aankhein tere sath hain, main tujhe dekhta bhalta aur teri baatein sunta sunata rahunga. Meri madad tere pas hogi main ne apni taraf se tujhe hujjatein ata farma di hain aur tujhe qawi aur mazboot kar diya hai to akela hi mera poora lashkar hai. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Meri rububiyat se bezar, meri uluhiyat se bar sar-e-paikar hai. Mujh se aankhein pher li hain, dide badal liye hain. Meri pakar se ghafil ho gaya hai. Mere azabon se be-khauf ho gaya hai. Mujhe apni izzat ki qasam agar main ise dheel dena na chahta to aasman is par toot parte zameen ise nigal jati darya ise dobo dete lekin chunke woh mere muqable ka nahi har waqt mere bas mein hai main ise dheel diye hue hoon aur is se be-parwai barat raha hoon. Main hoon bhi sari makhlooq se be-parwah. Haq to yeh hai ke be-parwai sirf meri hi sifat hai. To meri risalat ada kar, ise meri ibadat ki hidayat kar, ise tauheed-o-ikhlas ki dawat de, meri naamatein yaad dila, mere azabon se dhamka, mere ghazab se hoshyar kar de. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Usay yeh samjha ke meri maan le to main bhi maghfirat se pesh aonga. Chaar sau saal usay sarkashi karte, mere bandon par zulm dhalte, meri ibadat se logon ko rokte guzar chuke hain. Taham na main ne is par baarish band ki na paidawar roki na bimar dala na boodha kiya na maghloob kiya. Agar chahta zulm ke sath hi pakad leta lekin mera hilm bahut badha hua hai. To apne bhai ke sath mil kar is se poori tarah jehad kar aur meri madad par bharosa rakh main agar chahun to apne lashkaron ko bhej kar is ka bheja nikal dun. Lekin is be-buniyaad bande ko dikhana chahta hun ke meri jamaat ka ek bhi rooye zameen ki takaton par ghalib aaskakta hai. Madad mere ikhtiyar mein hai. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main agar chahun to tumhein itna de dun ke Firaun ki daulat is ke pasang mein bhi na asake lekin main apne bandon ko umoman ghareeb hi rakhta hun taake unki akhirat sanwri rahe yeh is liye nahi hota ke woh mere nazeeq qabil-e-ikram nahi balki sirf is liye hota hai ke dono jahan ki nematein ane wale jahan mein jama mil jayen. Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain ek girah khulne ki dua ki thi jo poori hui agar poori ki dua hoti to woh bhi poori hoti. Aap ne sirf isi qadr dua ki thi ke Aap ki zaban aisi kar di jaye ke log Aap ki baat samajh liya karein. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain dar tha ke kahin woh ilzam-e-qatl rakh kar qatl na kar dein is ki dua ki jo qabul hui. Zaban mein atkao tha is ki babat dua ki ke itni saaf ho jaye ke log baat samajh lein yeh dua bhi poori hui. Dua ki ke Haroon ko bhi nabi bana diya jaye yeh bhi poori hui. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Rahimahullah ke paas un ke ek rishtedaar aaye aur kehne lage yeh to bari kami hai ke tum bolne mein ghalat bol jate ho. Aap ne farmaya bhatije kya meri baat tumhari samajh mein nahi aati? Kaha haan samajh mein to aa jati hai kaha bas yehi kafi hai Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne bhi Allah se yehi aur itni hi dua ki thi. Phir aur dua ki ke meri khariji aur zahiri imdad ke liye mera wazir bana de aur ho bhi woh mere kunbe mein se. Yani mere bhai Haroon ko nubuwwat ata farma. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt Hazrat Haroon Alaihis Salam ko Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke sath hi nubuwwat ata ki gayi. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa Razi Allahu Anha umrah ke liye jate hue kisi arabi ke yahan muqim thin ke suna ek shakhs poochta hai ke duniya mein kisi bhai ne apne bhai ko sab se ziyada nafa pohchaya hai is sawal par sab khamosh ho gaye aur keh diya ke hamein is ka ilm nahi. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Firon ke samne Kalma-e-Haq. Phir hukum huwa ke Firon ne hamari bagawat par kamar kas li hai, us ke pas ja kar ise samjhao. Wahab Rahimahullah kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko qareeb hone ka hukum diya yahan tak ke aap us darakht ke tane se lag kar khare ho gaye, dil thahar gaya, khauf aur khatra door ho gaya. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Us se kaho ke woh hamari ibadat kare, kisi ko shareek na banaye, Bani Israel ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare, unhein taklif aur eza na de. Firon bara baghi ho gaya hai, duniya ka maftoon ban kar akhirat ko faramosh kar baitha hai aur apne paida karne wale ko bhool gaya hai to meri risalat le kar us ke pas ja. Mere kaan aur meri aankhein tere sath hain, main tujhe dekhta bhalta aur teri baatein sunta sunata rahunga. Meri madad tere pas hogi main ne apni taraf se tujhe hujjatein ata farma di hain aur tujhe qawi aur mazboot kar diya hai to akela hi mera poora lashkar hai. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Meri rububiyat se bezar, meri uluhiyat se bar sar-e-paikar hai. Mujh se aankhein pher li hain, dide badal liye hain. Meri pakar se ghafil ho gaya hai. Mere azabon se be-khauf ho gaya hai. Mujhe apni izzat ki qasam agar main ise dheel dena na chahta to aasman is par toot parte zameen ise nigal jati darya ise dobo dete lekin chunke woh mere muqable ka nahi har waqt mere bas mein hai main ise dheel diye hue hoon aur is se be-parwai barat raha hoon. Main hoon bhi sari makhlooq se be-parwah. Haq to yeh hai ke be-parwai sirf meri hi sifat hai. To meri risalat ada kar, ise meri ibadat ki hidayat kar, ise tauheed-o-ikhlas ki dawat de, meri naamatein yaad dila, mere azabon se dhamka, mere ghazab se hoshyar kar de. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Usay yeh samjha ke meri maan le to main bhi maghfirat se pesh aonga. Chaar sau saal usay sarkashi karte, mere bandon par zulm dhalte, meri ibadat se logon ko rokte guzar chuke hain. Taham na main ne is par baarish band ki na paidawar roki na bimar dala na boodha kiya na maghloob kiya. Agar chahta zulm ke sath hi pakad leta lekin mera hilm bahut badha hua hai. To apne bhai ke sath mil kar is se poori tarah jehad kar aur meri madad par bharosa rakh main agar chahun to apne lashkaron ko bhej kar is ka bheja nikal dun. Lekin is be-buniyaad bande ko dikhana chahta hun ke meri jamaat ka ek bhi rooye zameen ki takaton par ghalib aaskakta hai. Madad mere ikhtiyar mein hai. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main agar chahun to tumhein itna de dun ke Firaun ki daulat is ke pasang mein bhi na asake lekin main apne bandon ko umoman ghareeb hi rakhta hun taake unki akhirat sanwri rahe yeh is liye nahi hota ke woh mere nazeeq qabil-e-ikram nahi balki sirf is liye hota hai ke dono jahan ki nematein ane wale jahan mein jama mil jayen. Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Un ke samne har ek ko ba-adab rehna chahiye. Apni zabaan aur dil ko un ka tabi rakhna chahiye. Sun le mere doston se dushmani rakhne wala goya mujhe ladai ka elan deta hai. To kya mujh se ladne ka irada rakhne wala kabhi sarsabz hosakta hai? Main ne qahr ki nazar se usay dekha aur woh tahas nahas hua. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne apna bachpan ka zamana Firaun ke ghar mein balki is ki god mein guzara tha jawani tak mulk Misr mein usi ki badshahat mein tehre rahe the phir ek qibti be-irada apke haath se margaya tha jis se ap yahan se bhaag nikle the tab se lekar aj tak Misr ki soorat nahi dekhi thi. Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Firon ke samne Kalma-e-Haq. Phir hukum huwa ke Firon ne hamari bagawat par kamar kas li hai, us ke pas ja kar ise samjhao. Wahab Rahimahullah kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko qareeb hone ka hukum diya yahan tak ke aap us darakht ke tane se lag kar khare ho gaye, dil thahar gaya, khauf aur khatra door ho gaya. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Us se kaho ke woh hamari ibadat kare, kisi ko shareek na banaye, Bani Israel ke sath sulook-o-ehsan kare, unhein taklif aur eza na de. Firon bara baghi ho gaya hai, duniya ka maftoon ban kar akhirat ko faramosh kar baitha hai aur apne paida karne wale ko bhool gaya hai to meri risalat le kar us ke pas ja. Mere kaan aur meri aankhein tere sath hain, main tujhe dekhta bhalta aur teri baatein sunta sunata rahunga. Meri madad tere pas hogi main ne apni taraf se tujhe hujjatein ata farma di hain aur tujhe qawi aur mazboot kar diya hai to akela hi mera poora lashkar hai. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Meri rububiyat se bezar, meri uluhiyat se bar sar-e-paikar hai. Mujh se aankhein pher li hain, dide badal liye hain. Meri pakar se ghafil ho gaya hai. Mere azabon se be-khauf ho gaya hai. Mujhe apni izzat ki qasam agar main ise dheel dena na chahta to aasman is par toot parte zameen ise nigal jati darya ise dobo dete lekin chunke woh mere muqable ka nahi har waqt mere bas mein hai main ise dheel diye hue hoon aur is se be-parwai barat raha hoon. Main hoon bhi sari makhlooq se be-parwah. Haq to yeh hai ke be-parwai sirf meri hi sifat hai. To meri risalat ada kar, ise meri ibadat ki hidayat kar, ise tauheed-o-ikhlas ki dawat de, meri naamatein yaad dila, mere azabon se dhamka, mere ghazab se hoshyar kar de. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Usay yeh samjha ke meri maan le to main bhi maghfirat se pesh aonga. Chaar sau saal usay sarkashi karte, mere bandon par zulm dhalte, meri ibadat se logon ko rokte guzar chuke hain. Taham na main ne is par baarish band ki na paidawar roki na bimar dala na boodha kiya na maghloob kiya. Agar chahta zulm ke sath hi pakad leta lekin mera hilm bahut badha hua hai. To apne bhai ke sath mil kar is se poori tarah jehad kar aur meri madad par bharosa rakh main agar chahun to apne lashkaron ko bhej kar is ka bheja nikal dun. Lekin is be-buniyaad bande ko dikhana chahta hun ke meri jamaat ka ek bhi rooye zameen ki takaton par ghalib aaskakta hai. Madad mere ikhtiyar mein hai. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main agar chahun to tumhein itna de dun ke Firaun ki daulat is ke pasang mein bhi na asake lekin main apne bandon ko umoman ghareeb hi rakhta hun taake unki akhirat sanwri rahe yeh is liye nahi hota ke woh mere nazeeq qabil-e-ikram nahi balki sirf is liye hota hai ke dono jahan ki nematein ane wale jahan mein jama mil jayen. Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Un ke samne har ek ko ba-adab rehna chahiye. Apni zabaan aur dil ko un ka tabi rakhna chahiye. Sun le mere doston se dushmani rakhne wala goya mujhe ladai ka elan deta hai. To kya mujh se ladne ka irada rakhne wala kabhi sarsabz hosakta hai? Main ne qahr ki nazar se usay dekha aur woh tahas nahas hua. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne apna bachpan ka zamana Firaun ke ghar mein balki is ki god mein guzara tha jawani tak mulk Misr mein usi ki badshahat mein tehre rahe the phir ek qibti be-irada apke haath se margaya tha jis se ap yahan se bhaag nikle the tab se lekar aj tak Misr ki soorat nahi dekhi thi. Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Dono hath apni lakڑی par tika kar sar jhuka kar gardan kham kar ke ba adab irshad-e-Ilahi sunne lage to farmaya gaya ke mulk-e-Misr ke badshah Firon ki taraf hamara paigham le kar jao, yahin se tum bhag kar aaye ho. Firon bara baghi ho gaya hai, duniya ka maftoon ban kar akhirat ko faramosh kar baitha hai aur apne paida karne wale ko bhool gaya hai to meri risalat le kar us ke pas ja. Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun.
