Meri madad tere pas hogi main ne apni taraf se tujhe hujjatein ata farma di hain aur tujhe qawi aur mazboot kar diya hai to akela hi mera poora lashkar hai. Apne ek zaeef bande ki taraf tujhe bhej raha hoon jo meri naamatein paakar phool gaya hai aur meri pakar ko bhool gaya hai duniya mein phas gaya aur ghuroor takabbur mein dhans gaya hai. Meri rububiyat se bezar, meri uluhiyat se bar sar-e-paikar hai. Mujh se aankhein pher li hain, dide badal liye hain. Meri pakar se ghafil ho gaya hai. Mere azabon se be-khauf ho gaya hai. Mujhe apni izzat ki qasam agar main ise dheel dena na chahta to aasman is par toot parte zameen ise nigal jati darya ise dobo dete lekin chunke woh mere muqable ka nahi har waqt mere bas mein hai main ise dheel diye hue hoon aur is se be-parwai barat raha hoon. Main hoon bhi sari makhlooq se be-parwah. Haq to yeh hai ke be-parwai sirf meri hi sifat hai. To meri risalat ada kar, ise meri ibadat ki hidayat kar, ise tauheed-o-ikhlas ki dawat de, meri naamatein yaad dila, mere azabon se dhamka, mere ghazab se hoshyar kar de. Jab main gussa kar baithta hoon to aman nahi milta. Ise narmi se samjha taake na manne ka uzr toot jaye. Meri bakhshish ke mere karam-o-rahm ki ise khabar de keh de ke ab bhi agar meri taraf jhukega to main tamam bad-amaliyon se qata nazar kar lunga. Meri rahmat mere ghazab se bahut ziyada wasi' hai.

Khabardar is ka duniyawi thaath dekh kar raub mein na ajana is ki choti mere haath mein hai is ki zabaan chal nahi sakti is ke haath uth nahi sakte is ki ankh phadak nahi sakti is ka saans chal nahi sakta jab tak meri ijazat na ho. Usay yeh samjha ke meri maan le to main bhi maghfirat se pesh aonga. Chaar sau saal usay sarkashi karte, mere bandon par zulm dhalte, meri ibadat se logon ko rokte guzar chuke hain. Taham na main ne is par baarish band ki na paidawar roki na bimar dala na boodha kiya na maghloob kiya. Agar chahta zulm ke sath hi pakad leta lekin mera hilm bahut badha hua hai. To apne bhai ke sath mil kar is se poori tarah jehad kar aur meri madad par bharosa rakh main agar chahun to apne lashkaron ko bhej kar is ka bheja nikal dun. Lekin is be-buniyaad bande ko dikhana chahta hun ke meri jamaat ka ek bhi rooye zameen ki takaton par ghalib aaskakta hai. Madad mere ikhtiyar mein hai. Duniyawi jah-o-jalal ki to parwaah na karna balki ankh bhar kar dekhna bhi nahi. Main agar chahun to tumhein itna de dun ke Firaun ki daulat is ke pasang mein bhi na asake lekin main apne bandon ko umoman ghareeb hi rakhta hun taake unki akhirat sanwri rahe yeh is liye nahi hota ke woh mere nazeeq qabil-e-ikram nahi balki sirf is liye hota hai ke dono jahan ki nematein ane wale jahan mein jama mil jayen. Mere nazeeq bande ka koi amal itna waqat wala nahi jitna zuhd aur duniya se doori. Main apne khaas bandon ko sakeenat aur khushoo khuzu ka libas pehna deta hun un ke chehre sajdon ki chamak se roshan hojate hain. Yahi sache Awliya Allah hote hain. Un ke samne har ek ko ba-adab rehna chahiye. Apni zabaan aur dil ko un ka tabi rakhna chahiye. Sun le mere doston se dushmani rakhne wala goya mujhe ladai ka elan deta hai. To kya mujh se ladne ka irada rakhne wala kabhi sarsabz hosakta hai? Main ne qahr ki nazar se usay dekha aur woh tahas nahas hua. Mere dushman mujh par ghalib nahi asakte, mere mukhalif mera kuch bhi bigaad nahi sakte. Main apne doston ki khud madad karta hun, unhein dushmano ka shikaar nahi hone deta. Duniya-o-akhirat mein unhein surkhru rakhta hun aur unki madad karta hun. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne apna bachpan ka zamana Firaun ke ghar mein balki is ki god mein guzara tha jawani tak mulk Misr mein usi ki badshahat mein tehre rahe the phir ek qibti be-irada apke haath se margaya tha jis se ap yahan se bhaag nikle the tab se lekar aj tak Misr ki soorat nahi dekhi thi. Firaun ek sakht dil bad-khuluq ukhad mizaj awarah insan tha ghuroor aur takabbur itna badh gaya tha ke kehta tha ke main Allah ko janta hi nahi apni riaya se kehta tha ke tumhara Allah main hi hoon mulk-o-maal mein daulat-o-mata'a mein lao lashkar aur kufr mein koi rooye zameen par is ke muqable ka na tha. Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ki duaein.

Jab Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko use hidayat karne ka hukum huwa to Aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke mera seena khol de aur mere kaam mein aasani paida kar de agar tu khud mera madadgar na bana to yeh sakht baar mere kamzor kandhe nahi utha sakte. Aur meri zaban ki girah khol de. Chonke Aap ke bachpan ke zamane mein Aap ke samne khajoor aur angare rakhe gaye the Aap ne angara le kar munh mein rakh liya tha is liye zaban mein luknat ho gayi thi to dua ki ke mere zaban ki girah khul jaye Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke is adab ko dekhiye ke qadr-e-hajat sawal karte hain yeh nahi arz karte ke meri zaban bilkul saaf ho jaye balke dua yeh karte hain ke girah khul jaye taake log meri baat samajh lein. Anbiya Alaihimas Salam Allah se sirf hajat-rwai ke mutabiq hi arz karte hain aage nahi barhte. Chonacha Aap ki zaban mein phir bhi kuch kasar reh gayi thi jaise ke Firon ne kaha tha ke kya main behtar hoon ya yeh? Jo fard-e-maya hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain ek girah khulne ki dua ki thi jo poori hui agar poori ki dua hoti to woh bhi poori hoti. Aap ne sirf isi qadr dua ki thi ke Aap ki zaban aisi kar di jaye ke log Aap ki baat samajh liya karein. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain dar tha ke kahin woh ilzam-e-qatl rakh kar qatl na kar dein is ki dua ki jo qabul hui. Zaban mein atkao tha is ki babat dua ki ke itni saaf ho jaye ke log baat samajh lein yeh dua bhi poori hui. Dua ki ke Haroon ko bhi nabi bana diya jaye yeh bhi poori hui. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Rahimahullah ke paas un ke ek rishtedaar aaye aur kehne lage yeh to bari kami hai ke tum bolne mein ghalat bol jate ho. Aap ne farmaya bhatije kya meri baat tumhari samajh mein nahi aati? Kaha haan samajh mein to aa jati hai kaha bas yehi kafi hai Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne bhi Allah se yehi aur itni hi dua ki thi. Phir aur dua ki ke meri khariji aur zahiri imdad ke liye mera wazir bana de aur ho bhi woh mere kunbe mein se. Yani mere bhai Haroon ko nubuwwat ata farma. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain usi waqt Hazrat Haroon Alaihis Salam ko Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke sath hi nubuwwat ata ki gayi. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqa Razi Allahu Anha umrah ke liye jate hue kisi arabi ke yahan muqim thin ke suna ek shakhs poochta hai ke duniya mein kisi bhai ne apne bhai ko sab se ziyada nafa pohchaya hai is sawal par sab khamosh ho gaye aur keh diya ke hamein is ka ilm nahi. Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam mujhe is ka ilm hai. Siddiqa farmati hain main ne apne dil mein kaha dekho yeh shakhs kitni beja jasarat karta hai baghair Insha'Allah ki qasam kha raha hai. Logon ne is se poocha ke batao us ne jawab diya Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke apne bhai ko apni dua se nubuwwat dilwai. Main bhi yeh sun kar dang reh gayi aur dil mein kehne lagi baat to sach kahi fi-waqai is se ziyada koi bhai apne bhai ko nafa nahi pohcha sakta. Allah ne sach farmaya ke Musa Alaihis Salam Allah ke paas bare aabru-dar the. Is dua ki wajah bayan karte hain ke meri kamar mazboot ho jaye.

Taake hum teri tasbeeh achchi tarah bayan karein. Har waqt teri pakeezgi bayan karte rahein aur teri yaad bakasrat karein. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain banda Allah Ta'ala ka zyada zikr karne wala usi waqt hota hai jab ke woh baithte uthte aur lete zikr-e-Allah mein mashghool rahe. Tu hamein dekhta hai yeh tera rahm-o-karam hai ke tu ne hamein bargazeeda kiya, hamein nubuwwat ata farmai aur hamein apne dushman Fir'aun ki taraf apna nabi bana kar us ki hidayat ke liye mabouth farmaya. Tera shukra hai aur tere hi liye tamam tareefein saza-war hain. Teri in naimaton par hum tere shukr-guzaar hain.

Muajizat ki nauyat. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko dusra mojiza diya jata hai hukum hota hai ke apna hath apni baghal mein dal kar phir ise nikal lo to woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua roshan ban kar niklega. Yeh nahi ke baras ki safedi ho ya koi bimari aur aib ho. Chunacha Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne jab hath dal kar nikala to woh chiragh ki tarah roshan nikla jis se aap ka yeh yaqeen ke aap Allah Ta'ala se kalam kar rahe hain aur barh gaya. Yeh dono mojaze yahin isisi liye mile the ke aap Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lein.

Musa Alaihis Salam ka bachpan. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ki tamam duaein qabul huin aur farma diya gaya ke tumhari darkhwast منظور (manzoor) hai. Is ehsan ke sath hi aur ehsan ka bhi zikr kar diya gaya ke hum ne tujh par ek martaba aur bhi bara ehsan kiya hai. Phir is waqie ko mukhtasar taur par yaad dilaya ke hum ne tere bachpan ke waqt teri maan ki taraf wahi bheji jis ka zikr ab tum se ho raha hai. Tum us waqt doodh peete bachche thay tumhari walida ko Firaun aur Firauniyon ka khatka tha kyunki us saal woh Bani Israel ke larkon ko qatal kar raha tha. Is khauf ke mare woh har waqt kanpti rehti thin toh hum ne wahi ki ke ek sandoq bana lo doodh pila kar bachche ko us mein lata kar daryaye Neel mein is sandoq ko chor do chunancha woh yehi karti rahin ek rassi us mein bandh rakhi thi jis ka ek sira apne makan se bandh leti thin ek martaba bandh rahi thin jo rassi hath se chhoot gayi aur sandoq ko pani ki maujein baha le chalin ab toh kaleja tham kar reh gayin is qadar ghamzada huin ke sabr namumkin tha, shayad raaz fash kar dete lekin hum ne dil mazboot kar diya sandoq behta huwa Firaun ke mehal ke paas se guzra Aal-e-Firaun ne ise utha liya ke jis gham se woh bachna chahte thay jis sadme se woh mehfooz rehna chahte thay woh un ke samne aa jaye. Jis ki shama-e-hayat ko bujhane ke liye woh begunah masoomon ka qatal-e-aam kar rahe thay woh unhi ke tel se unhi ke haan roshan ho aur Allah ke irade berok poore ho jayen un ka dushman unhi ke hathon pale unhi ka khaye unhi ke haan tarbiyat paye. Khud Firaun aur us ki ahliya mohtarma ne jab bachche ko dekha rag rag mein mohabbat sama gayi le kar parwarish karne lage. Ankhon ka tara samajhne lage shahzadon ki tarah naz-o-niamat se palne lage shahi darbar mein rehne lage. Allah ne apni mohabbat tujh par daal di go Firaun tera dushman tha lekin Rabb ki baat kaun badle? Allah ke irade ko kaun tale Firaun par hi kya munhasir hai jo dekhta aap ka walih-o-sheeda ban jata yeh is liye tha ke teri parwarish meri nigah ke samne ho shahi khorakein kha izzat-o-waqrat ke sath reh. Firaun walon ne sandoqcha utha liya khola bachche ko dekha palne ka irada kiya lekin aap kisi daya ka doodh dabate hi nahi balki munh mein hi nahi lete. Behen jo sandoq ko dekhti bhalti kinare kinare aa rahi thi woh bhi mauqe par pahunch gayi kehne lagin ke aap agar is ki parwarish ki tamanna karte hain aur maqool ujrat bhi dete hain toh main ek gharana bataon jo ise mohabbat se pale aur khair khwahana bartao kare. Sab ne kaha hum tayyar hain aap unhe liye huwe apni walida ke paas pahunchin jab bachcha un ki god mein daal diya gaya. Aap ne jhatt se munh laga doodh peena shuru kiya jis se Firaun ke haan bari khushiyan manayi gayin aur bahut kuch inaam-o-ikram diya gaya. Tankhuah muqarrar ho gayi apne hi bachche ko doodh pilayen aur tankhuah aur inaam bhi aur izzat-o-ikram bhi payen duniya bhi mile deen bhi barhe.

Isi liye hadith mein aya hai ke jo shakhs apne kaam kare aur naik neeyati se kare us ki misaal Umm-e-Musa ki misaal hai ke apne hi bachche ko doodh pilaye aur ujrat bhi le. Pas yeh bhi hamari karam-furmaayi hai ke hum ne tujhe teri maan ki god mein wapas kiya ke us ki aankhein thandi rahein aur gham-o-ranj jaata rahe. Phir tumhare haath se ek fir'auni qatbi maar dala gaya to bhi hum ne tumhein bacha liya fir'auniyon ne tumhare qatal ka iradah kar liya tha raaz faash ho chuka tha tumhein yahan se najaat di tum bhaag khade hue Madyan ke kuanwe par ja kar tum ne dam liya. Wahan hamare ek naik bande ne tumhein basharat sunayi ke ab koi khauf nahi in zalimon se tumhein najaat pa li. Tujhe hum ne ba-taur aazmaish aur bhi bohat se fitno mein dala. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain ke main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas se is ki baabat sawal kiya toh Aap ne farmaya ab toh din doobne ko hai waqiyat zyada hain phir sahi chunacha main ne doosri subh phir sawal kiya toh Aap ne farmaya suno! Fir'aun ke darbar mein ek din is baat ka zikr chhada ke Allah ka wada Hazrat Ibrahim Khaleelullah Alaihis Salam se yeh tha ke un ki aulaad mein anbiya aur baadshah hoge chunacha Bani Israel is ke aaj tak muntazir hain aur unhein yaqeen hai ke misr ki saltanat phir un mein jayegi. Pehle toh un ka khayal tha ke yeh wada Hazrat Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki baabat tha lekin un ki wafat tak jab ke yeh wada poora nahi hua toh woh ab aqeeda rakhte hain ke Allah un mein apne ek paighambar ko bheje ga jin ke haathon unhein saltanat bhi milegi aur un ki qaumi aur mazhabi taraqqi hogi yeh baatein kar ke unhon ne majlis-e-mushawarat qaim ki ke ab kya kiya jaye jis se aainda ke is khatre se mehfooz reh sakein. Aakhir is jalsay mein qarar-daad manzoor hui ke police ka ek mehakma qaim kiya jaye jo shehar ka gasht lagata rahe aur Bani Israel mein jo nareena aulaad ho usay usi waqt sarkar mein pesh kiya jaye aur zibah kar diya jaye. Lekin jab ek muddat guzar gayi toh unhein khayal paida hua ke is tarah toh Bani Israel bilkul fana ho jayenge aur jo zaleel khidmaten un se li jati hain jo begaarein un se wasool ho rahi hain sab mauqoof ho jayengi is liye ab tajweez hua ke ek saal un ke bachchon ko chhod diya jaye aur ek saal un ke ladke qatal kar diye jayen. Is tarah maujooda Bani Israiliyon ki tadad bhi na badhegi aur na itni kam ho jayegi ke humein apni khidmat-guzari ke liye bhi na mil saken jitne buddhe do saal mein marenge utne bachche ek saal mein paida ho jayenge.

Jis saal qatl moqoof tha us saal to Hazrat Haroon (Alaihis Salam) paida hue aur jis saal qatl-e-aam bachon ka jari tha us baras Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) tawallud hue. Aap ki walida ki us waqt ki ghabrahat aur pareshani ka kya poochna? Be-andaza thi. Ek fitna to yeh tha. Chunacha yeh khatra us waqt dafa ho gaya jab ke Allah ki wahi un ke paas aayi ke dar khauf na kar hum ise teri taraf phir lautayenge aur ise apna rasool banayenge. Chunacha buhkum-e-Ilahi aap ne apne bachche ko sandoq mein band kar ke darya mein baha diya jab sandoq nazron se ojhal ho gaya to shaitan ne dil mein waswase daalne shuru kiye ke afsos is se to yahi behtar tha ke mere samne hi ise zibah kar diya jata to main ise khud hi kafnati dafnati to sahi lekin ab to main ne khud ise machliyon ka shikar banaya. Yeh sandoq yunhi behta hua khas Firauni ghat se ja laga wahan us waqt mehal ki londiyan mojood thin unhon ne is sandoq ko utha liya aur irada kiya ke khol kar dekhein lekin phir dar gayin ke aisa na ho ke chori ka ilzam lage yunhi muqaffal sandoq malika-e-Firaun ke paas pohcha diya. Yeh badshah begam ke samne khola gaya to is mein se chand jaisi soorat ka ek chhota sa masoom bachcha nikla jise dekhte hi Firaun ki biwi sahibah ka dil mohabbat ke josh se uchalne laga. Idhar Umme Musa ki halat ghair ho gayi siwaye apne is pyare bachche ke khyal ke dil mein aur koi tasawwur hi na tha. Idhar un qasaiyon ko jo hukumat ki taraf se bachchon ke qatl ke mehkame ke ملازم (mulazim) the maloom hua to wo apni churiyan tez kiye hue barhe aur malika se taqaza kiya ke bachcha unhen sonp dein taakhay wo ise zibah kar dalen. Yeh doosra fitna tha aakhir malika ne jawab diya ke tehro main khud badshah se milti hoon aur is bachche ko talab karti hoon agar wo mujhe de dein to khair warna tumhein ikhtiyar hai. Chunacha aap ayin aur badshah se kaha ke yeh bachcha to meri aur aap ki aankhon ki thandak sabit hoga is khabees ne kaha bas tum hi is se apni aankhein thandi rakho meri thandak wo kyun hone laga? Mujhe is ki koi zaroorat nahi. Allah Ta'ala ki tadabeer aala aur mehroom-e-hidayat Firaun. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba-half bayan farmate hain ke agar wo bhi keh deta ke haan beshak wo meri aankhon ki bhi thandak hai to Allah Ta'ala ise bhi zaroor rah-e-rast dikha deta jaisa ke is ki biwi sahibah musharraf ba-hidayat hui lekin is ne khud is se mehroom rehna chaha Allah ne bhi ise mehroom kar diya. Al-Gharz Firaun ko joon toon razi razamand kar ke is bachche ke palne ki ijazat le kar aap ayin ab mehal ki jitni dayin thin sab ko jama kiya ek ek ki god mein bachcha diya gaya lekin Allah Ta'ala ne sab ka doodh aap par haram kar diya aap ne kisi ka doodh munh mein liya hi nahi. Is se malika ghabrayin ke yeh to bohat hi bura huwa. Yeh pyara bachcha yunhi halak ho jayega. Aakhir soch kar hukum diya ke unhen bahar le jao idhar udhar talash karo aur agar kisi ka doodh yeh masoom qabool kare to ise ba-minnat sonp do.

bahar bazaron mein mela sa lag gaya har shakhs is saadat se mala maal hona chahta tha lekin Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne kisi ka doodh na piya. Aap ki walida ne apni bari sahabzadi aap ki behan ko bahar bhej rakha tha ke woh dekhein kya hota hai? Woh is majma mein mojood theen aur tamam waqiyat dekh sun rahi theen jab yeh log aajiz aagaye to aap ne farmaya agar tum kaho to main aik gharana aisa batlaon jo is ki nigahbani kare aur ho bhi is ka khair khwah yeh kehna tha ke logon ko shak huwa ke zaroor yeh larki is bachche ko jaanti hai aur is ke ghar ko bhi pehchanti hai. Ae Ibn-e-Jubair yeh tha teesra fitna. Lekin Allah ne larki ko samajh de di aur us ne jhatt se kaha ke bhala tum itna nahi samjhe kaun badnaseeb aisa hoga jo is bachche ki khair khwah nahi ya parwarish mein kami kare jo bachcha hamari malika ka pyara hai. Kaun na chahega ke yeh hamare haan pale taake inaam-o-ikram se is ka ghar bhar jaye. Yeh sun kar sab ki samajh mein aagaya ise chhor diya aur kaha bata to kaun si daya is ke liye tajwez karti hai? Us ne kaha main abhi layi dauri hui gayeen aur walida ko yeh khushkhabri sunai walida sahab shauq-o-umeed se ayeen apne pyare bachche ko god mein liya apna doodh munh mein diya bachche ne pait bhar kar piya usi waqt shahi mehlat mein yeh khushkhabri pohanchai gayi malika ka hukum huwa ke foran is daya ko aur bachche ko mere paas lao jab maan beta pohnche to apne samne doodh pilwaya aur yeh dekh kar ke bachcha achhi tarah doodh peeta hai bohat hi khush huin aur farmane lagein ke dayi amman mujhe is bachche se woh mohabbat hai jo dunya ki kisi aur cheez se nahi tum yehi mehal mein raho aur is bachche ki parwarish karo. Lekin Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ki walida sahabah ke samne Allah ka wada tha unhein yaqeen-e-kamil tha is liye aap zara rukin aur farmaya ke yeh to namumkin hai ke main apne ghar ko aur apne bachchon ko chhor kar yahan rahon. Agar aap chahti hain to yeh bachcha mere supurd kardein main ise apne ghar le jaati hoon un ki parwarish mein koi kotahi na karungi malika sahabah ne majbooran is baat ko bhi maan liya aur aap usi din khushi khushi apne bachche ko liye huwe ghar aagaye. Is bachche ki wajah se is mahalle ke Bani Israel bhi farauni mazalim se rehai pa gaye. Jab kuch zamana guzar gaya to badshah begum ne hukum bheja ke kisi din mere bachche ko mere paas lao aik din muqarrar ho gaya tamam arkan-e-saltanat aur darbariyon ko hukum huwa ke aaj mera bachcha mere paas aayega tum sab qadam qadam par is ka istiqbal karo aur dhoom dhaam se nazrein dete huwe ise mere mehal saraye tak lao. Chunacha jab sawari rawanah hui wahan se lekar mehal saraye sultani tak barabar tohfe tahayef nazrein aur hadiye paishkesh hote rahe aur bari hi izzat-o-ikram ke sath aap yahan pohnche to khud begum ne bhi khushi khushi bohat bari raqam paish ki aur bari khushi manai gayi. Phir kehne lagi ke main to ise badshah ke paas le jaungi woh bhi ise inaam-o-ikram denge, le gayen aur badshah ki god mein lita diya.

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne us ki darhi pakar kar zor se ghaseeti. Firaun khatak gaya aur us ke darbariyon ne kehna shuru kiya ki kya ajab yehi woh larka ho aap ise foran qatal kara dijiye. Aye Ibn-e-Jubair yeh tha chautha fitna. Malika betab ho kar bol uthin: Aye Badshah! Kya irada kar rahe hain? Aap ise mujhe de chuke hain, main ise apna beta bana chuki hoon. Badshah ne kaha: Yeh sab theek hai lekin dekho toh, is ne toh aate hi darhi pakar kar mujhe neecha kar diya, goya yehi mera girane wala aur mujhe takht-o-taraj karne wala hai. Begum Sahiba ne farmaya: Badshah! Bachon ko in cheezon ki kya tamiz, suno main ek faisla-kun baat bataon, iske samne do angare aag ke surkh rakh do aur do moti aabdar chamakte hue rakh do, phir dekho yeh kya uthata hai, agar moti utha le toh samajhna ki is mein aql hai aur agar aag ke angare tham le toh samajhna ki aql nahi. Jab aql-o-tamiz nahi toh is ki darhi pakar lene par itne lambe khayalat kar ke is ki jaan ka dushman ban jana kaun si danai ki baat hai? Chunacha yehi kiya gaya, dono cheezein aap ke samne rakhi gayen, aap ne dahakte hue angare utha liye, usi waqt woh cheen liye ke aisa na ho haath jal jayen. Ab Firaun ka gussa thanda hua aur is ka badla hua rukh theek ho gaya. Haq toh yeh hai ki Allah ko jo kaam karna maqsood hota hai, us ke qudrati asbab muhayya ho hi jate hain. 

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki darbar-e-Firaun mein, Firaun ke khas mahal mein, Firaun ki biwi ki god mein hi parwarish hoti rahi. Yahan tak ke aap achchi umar ko pahunch gaye aur baligh ho gaye. Ab toh Firaniyon ke jo mazalim Israiliyon par ho rahe the, un mein bhi kami ho gayi thi, sab amn-o-aman se the. Ek din Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) kahin ja rahe the ki raste mein ek Firani aur ek Israili ki larai ho rahi thi, Israili ne Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se faryad ki. Aap ko sakht gussa aaya isliye ke us waqt woh Firani us Bani Israel ko daboche hue tha, aap ne use ek mukka mara, Allah ki shan mukka lagte hi woh mar gaya. Yeh toh logon ko umuman maloom tha ki Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) Bani Israiliyon ki taraf-dari karte hain, lekin log is ki wajah ab tak yehi samajhte the ki chunke aap ne unhi mein doodh piya hai isliye un ke taraf-dar hain, asli raaz ka ilm toh sirf aap ki walida ko tha aur mumkin hai Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kalim ko bhi maloom kara diya ho. Use murda dekhte hi Musa (Alaihis Salam) kanp uthe ke yeh toh shaitani harkat hai, woh behkane wala aur khula dushman hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala se maafi mangne lage ki Bari Ta'ala! Main ne apni jaan par zulm kiya, tu maaf farma. Parwardigar ne bhi aap ki is khata se darguzar farma liya, woh toh Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai hi. Chunke qatal ka mamla tha, aap phir bhi khaufzada hi rahe, taak-jhank mein rahe ke kahin mamla khul toh nahi gaya.

Idhar Firaun ke paas shikayat hui ke ek Qibti ko kisi Bani Israel ne maar dala hai, Firaun ne hukum jari kar diya ke waqiate ki poori tehqeeq karo, qatil ko talash kar ke pakar lao aur gawah bhi paish karo aur jurm sabit ho jane ki soorat mein use bhi qatal kar do. Police ne har-chand tafteesh ki lekin qatil ka koi suragh na mila. Ittefaq ki baat ke doosre hi din Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) phir kahin ja rahe thay ke dekha wohi Bani Israeli shakhs ek doosre Firauni se jhagrah raha hai. Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko dekhte hi woh dohai dene laga lekin is ne yeh mehsoos kiya ke shayad Musa (Alaihis Salam) apne kal ke fel se nadim hain. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko bhi is ka yeh bar bar ka jhagarna aur fariyad karna bura maloom hua aur kaha tum toh bare laraka ho, yeh farma kar us Firauni ko pakadna chaha lekin us Israeli buzdil ne samjha ke shayad Aap chunke mujh par naraz hain mujhe hi pakadna chahte hain, halanki is ka yeh sirf buzdilana khayal tha, Aap toh usi Firauni ko pakadna chahte the aur use bachana chahte the lekin khauf-o-haras ki halat mein be-sakhta is ke munh se nikal gaya ke, "Aye Musa! Jaise ke kal to ne ek admi ko maar dala tha, kya aaj mujhe maar dalna chahta hai?" Yeh sun kar woh Firauni ise chor bhaga, dora gaya aur sarkari sipahi ko is waqiate ki khabar kar di. Firaun ko bhi qissa maloom hua, usi waqt jaladon ko hukum diya ke Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko pakar kar qatal kar do. Yeh log share-e-am se Aap ki justaju mein chale, idhar ek Bani Israeli ne rasta kaat kar nazdeek ke raste se aa kar Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko khabar kar di. Aye Ibn-e-Jubair! Yeh hai panchwan fitna. 

Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) yeh sunte hi muthiyan band kar ke Misr se bhag khare hue, na kabhi pedal chale the, na kabhi kisi musibat mein phanse the, shehzadon ki tarah lad-pyar mein pale the, na raste ki khabar thi na kabhi safar ka ittefaq para tha, Rab par bharosa kar ke yeh dua kar ke, "Aye Allah! Mujhe seedhi rah le chalna," chal khare hue yahan tak ke Madyan ki hudood mein pahuche. Yahan dekha ke log apne janvaron ko pani pila rahe hain, wahin do larkiyon ko dekha ke apne janvaron ko roke khari hain. Pucha ke tum in ke sath apne janvaron ko pani kyun nahi pila leitin? Alag khari hui inhein kyun rok rahi ho? Inhon ne jawab diya ke is bheed mein hamare bas ki baat nahi ke apne janvaron ko pani pilayein, hum toh jab ye log pani pila chukte hain, in ka baqiya apne janvaron ko pila liya karti hain. Aap foran age bare aur in ke janvaron ko pani pila diya. Chunke bohat jald pani khincha, Aap bohat qawi admi the, sab se pehle in ke janvaron ko sair kar diya. Yeh apni bakriyan le kar apne ghar rawanah huin aur Aap ek darakht ke saye tale baith gaye aur Allah se dua karne lage ke, "Parwardigar! Main teri tamam-tar meharbaniyon ka mohtaj hoon." Yeh dono larkiyan jab apne walid ke paas pahucheen toh inhon ne kaha, "Aaj kya baat hai ke tum waqt se pehle hi aa gayeen?"

aur bakriyan bhi khoob asooda aur shikam seer maloom hoti hain to un bachiyon ne sara waqia keh sunaya aap ne hukum diya ke tum mein se ek abhi chali jaye aur unhein mere paas bula laye. Woh ayen aur Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ko apne walid sahib ke paas le gayen unhon ne sarsari mulaqat ke baad waqia poochha to aap ne sara qissa keh sunaya is par woh farmane lage ab koi dar ki baat nahi aap in zalimoon se chhoot gaye. Hum log Firaun ki riaya nahi na hum par is ka koi dabao hai usi waqt ek larki ne apne baap se kaha ke abba ji unhon ne hamara kaam kar diya hai aur yeh hain bhi quwat wale amanat dar shakhs kya achha ho ke aap unhein apne haan muqarrar kar lijiye ke yeh ujrat par hamari bakriyan chara laya karein. Baap ko ghairat aur ghussa aa gaya aur poochha beti tumhein yeh kaise maloom ho gaya ke yeh qawi aur ameen hain. Bachi ne jawab diya ke quwat to us waqt maloom hui jab unhon ne hamari bakriyon ke liye pani nikala itne bare dole ko akeli hi kheenchte they aur bari phurti aur harpan se. Amanat dari yoon maloom hui ke meri awaz sun kar unhon ne nazar oonchi ki aur jab yeh maloom ho gaya ke main aurat hoon phir neechi gardan kar ke meri baatein sunte rahe wallah aap ka poora paigham pahunchane tak unhon ne nigah oonchi nahi ki. Phir mujh se farmaya ke tum mere peechhe raho mujhe door se rasta bata diya karna yeh bhi daleel hai un ki Allah khofi aur amanat dari ki. Baap ki ghairat-o-hamiyat bhi reh gayi bachi ki taraf se bhi dil saaf ho gaya aur Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ki mohabbat dil mein sama gayi. Ab Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam se farmane lage mera irada hai ke apni in dono larkiyon mein se ek ka nikah aap ke sath kar doon is shart par ke aap aath saal tak mere haan kaam kaaj karte rahein haan agar das saal tak karein to aur bhi achha hai Insha'Allah aap dekh lenge ke main bhala aadmi hoon. Chunacha yeh mamla te ho gaya aur Allah ke paighambar Alaihis Salam ne bajaye aath saal ke das saal poore kiye. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmaye hain pehle mujhe yeh maloom na tha aur ek nasrani alim mujh se yeh pooch baitha tha to main ise koi jawab na de saka phir jab main ne Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se poochha aur aap ne jawab diya to main ne is se zikr kiya us ne kaha tumhare ustad bare alim hain. Main ne kaha haan hain hi. Ab Musa Alaihis Salam is muddat ko poori kar ke apni ahliya sahibah ko liye hue yahan se chale. Phir woh waqiat hue jin ka zikr in ayaton mein hai. Aag dekhi, gaye, Allah se kalam kiya, lakri ka ajdaha banna, haath ka noorani banna mulahiza kiya, nabuwat paayi, Firaun ki taraf bheje gaye to qatl ke waqia ke badle ka andesha zahir farmaya. Is se itminan hasil kar ke zaban ki girah kushaai ki talab ki. Is ko hasil kar ke apne bhai Harun ki hamdardi aur shirkati kar chahi. Yeh bhi hasil kar ke larki liye hue shah-e-Misr ki taraf chale. Idhar Hazrat Harun Alaihis Salam ke paas wahi pahunchi ke apne bhai ki muwafqat karein aur un ka sath dein. Dono bhai mile aur Firaun ke darbar mein pahuche.

Itla' karai bari dair mein ijazat mili, andar gaye Firon par zahir kiya ke hum Allah ke Rasool ban kar tere paas aaye hain. Ab jo sawal jawab hue woh Quran mein mojood hain. Firon ne kaha accha tum chahte kya ho aur waqia-e-qatl yaad dilaya jis ka uzr Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne bayan kiya jo Quran mein mojood hai aur kaha hamara irada yeh hai ke tu iman la aur hamare sath Bani Israel ko apni ghulami se rihai de. Us ne inkar kiya aur kaha ke agar sache ho to koi mojiza dikhao aap ne usi waqt apni lakri zameen par dal di woh zameen par parte hi ek zabardast khofnak ajdaha ki surat mein munh phare kachliyan nikale Firon ki taraf lapka mare khof ke Firon takht se kood gaya aur bhagta hua aajizi se fariyaad karne laga ke Musa (Alaihis Salam) Allah ke waste ise pakar lo. Aap ne hath lagaya usi waqt lathi apni asli halat mein aagayi. Phir aap ne apna hath apne gareban mein dal kar nikala to woh baghair kisi marz ke dagh ke chamakta hua nikla jise dekh kar woh hairan hogaya aap ne phir hath dal kar nikala to woh apni asli halat mein tha. Ab Firon ne apne darbariyon ki taraf dekh kar kaha ke tum ne dekha yeh dono jadugar hain chahte hain ke apne jadoo ke zor se tumhein tumhare mulk se nikal bahar karein aur tumhare mulk par qabiz ho kar tumhare tareeqe mita dein. Phir Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se kaha ke humein aap ki nabuwat manne se bhi inkar hai aur aap ka koi mutalba bhi hum poora nahi kar sakte balki hum apne jadugaro ko tumhare muqabla ke liye bula rahe hain jo tumhare is jadoo par ghalib aajayenge chunacha yeh log apni koshishon mein mashghool hogaye. Tamam mulk se jadugaroon ko bari izzat se bulwaya jab sab jama hogaye to unho ne poocha ke iska jadoo kis qism ka hai? Firon walon ne kaha lakri ka saanp bana deta hai unho ne kaha is mein kya hai hum lakriyon ki rasiyon ke woh saanp banayenge ke roo-e-zameen par un ka koi muqabla na kar sake. Lekin hamare liye inaam muqarrar hojana chahiye Firon ne un se qaul-o-qarar kiya ke inaam kaisa? Main to tumhein apna muqarrar-e-khas aur darbari bana loon ga aur tumhein nihaal nihaal kar doonga jo mango ge paoge. Chunacha unho ne elan kardiya ke Eid ke roz din charhe falan maidan mein muqabla hoga. Marwi hai ke un ki yeh Eid Ashoora ke din thi us din tamam log subah hi subah us maidan mein pahunch gaye ke aaj chal kar dekhenge ke kon ghalib aata hai hum to jadugaroon ke kamaal ke qail hain wahi ghalib aayenge aur hum unhi ki manenge. Mazaq se is baat ko badal kar kehte thay ke chalo unhi dono jadugaroon ke mutee ban jayenge agar woh ghalib rahein. Maidan mein aa kar jadugaroon ne Anbiya-ullah se kaha ke lo ab batao tum pehle apna jadoo zahir karte ho ya hum hi shuru karein? Aap ne farmaya tum hi ibteda karo taake tumhare arman poore hon.

Ab unhon ne apni lakdiyan aur rassiyan maidan mein daal dein woh sab saanp aur balayein ban kar Allah ke nabiyon ki taraf daudein jis se khaufzada ho kar aap peechhe hatne lage us waqt Allah ki wahi aayi ke aap apni lakri zameen par daal dijiye aap ne daal di woh ek khaufnak bhayanak azeem-ush-shan ajdha ban kar un ki taraf daura yeh lakdiyan rassiyan sab gud mud ho gayin aur woh un sab ko nigal gaya. Jadu-gar samajh gaye ke yeh jadoo nahi yeh toh sach much Allah ki taraf ka nishaan hai jadoo mein yeh baat kahan? Chunacha sab ne apne iman ka elaan kar diya ke hum Musa ke Rab par iman laye aur un dono bhaiyon ki nubuwwat hamein tasleem hai. Hum apne guzishta gunahon se tauba karte hain. Firoon aur Fironiyon ki kamar toot gayi, ruswa hue, munh kaale par gaye, zillat ke sath khamosh ho gaye. Khoon ke ghont pi kar chup ho gaye. Idhar yeh ho raha tha idhar Firoon ki biwi sahiba R.A jinhon ne Hazrat Musa A.S ko apne sage bachche ki tarah pala tha, be-qarar baithi thin aur Allah se duaein maang rahi thin ke Allah Zul-Jalal apne Nabi ko ghalib kare Fironiyon ne bhi is haal ko dekha tha lekin unhon ne khayal kiya ke apne khawand ki taraf-dari mein in ka yeh haal hai yahan se nakaam wapas jane par Firoon ne be-imani par kamar baandh li. Allah ki taraf se Hazrat Musa A.S ke haathon bahut se nishaanaat zahir hue. Jab kabhi koi pakar aa jati yeh ghabra kar balke gar-ga kar wada karta ke acha is museebat ke hat jane par main Bani Israel ko tere sath kar dunga lekin jab azab hat jata phir munkir ban kar sarkashi par aa jata aur kehta tera Rab is ke siva kuch aur bhi kar sakta hai? Chunacha un par toofan aaya. Taddiyan aayin, juwayin aayin, mendak aaye, khoon aaya aur bhi bahut si saaf saaf nishaniyan dekhein. Jahan aafat aayi, dara, wada kiya. Jahan woh tal gayi mukar gaya aur akar gaya. Ab Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hua ke Bani Israel ko le kar yahan se nikal jao aap raaton raat unhen le kar rawanah ho gaye. Subh Fironiyon ne dekha ke raat ko sare Bani Israel chale gaye hain. Unhon ne Firoon se kaha is ne sare mulk mein ahkaam bhej kar har taraf se foujein jama keen aur bahut bari jamiyat ke sath un ka peechha kiya. Raste mein jo darya parta tha us ki taraf Allah ki wahi pahuinchi ke tujh par jab mere bande Musa A.S ki lakri parre toh tu unhen rasta de dena. Tujh mein barah raste ho jayein ke Bani Israel ke barah qabile alag alag apni rah lag jayein. Phir jab yeh par ho jayein aur Fironi aa jayein toh tu mil jana aur un mein se ek ko bhi be-duboye na chorna. Musa A.S jab darya par pahuinche dekha ke woh maujein maar raha hai pani charha hua hai shor uth raha hai ghabra gaye aur lakri marna bhool gaye darya be-qarar yoon tha ke kahin aisa na ho is ke kisi hisse par Hazrat Musa A.S lakri maar dein aur use khabar na ho toh azab-e-ilahi mein ba-sabab Allah ki na-farmani ke phans jaye.

Itne mein Firon ka lashkar Bani Israel ke sar par ja pohancha yeh ghabra gaye aur kehne lage lo Musa hum toh pakar liye gaye ab aap woh kijiye jo Allah ka aap ko hukum hai yaqinan na toh Allah jhoota hai na aap. Aap ne farmaya mujh se toh yeh farmaya gaya hai ki jab tu darya par pohnchega woh tujhe barah raaste de dega toh guzar jana. Usi waqt yaad aaya ki lakri marne ka hukum hua hai. Chunacha lakri mari idhar Fironi lashkar ka awwal hissa Bani Israel ke akhri hisse ke paas achuka tha ki darya khushk hogaya aur us mein raaste numayan hogaye aur aap apni kaum ko liye hue us mein be-khatar utar gaye aur ba-aram jane lage jab yeh nikal chuke Fironi sipah un ke taqab mein darya mein utri jab yeh sara lashkar us mein utar gaya toh farman-e-Ilahi ke mutabiq darya rawan hogaya aur sab ko yak-wakt gharq kardiya Banu Israel is waqie ko apni ankhon dekh rahe the taham unhon ne kaha ki aye Rasul Allah hamein kya khabar ki Firon bhi mara ya nahi ? Aap ne dua ki aur darya ne Firon ki be-jan lash ko kinare par phenk diya. Jise dekh kar unhein yaqein-e-kamil hogaya ki un ka dushman ma-apne lao lashkar ke tabaah hogaya. Firon se nijat ke baad Bani Israel ki na-farmaniyan. Ab yahan se aage chale toh dekha ki ek kaum apne buton ki mujawir ban kar baithi hai toh kehne lage aye Allah ke Rasul hamare liye bhi koi mabood aisa hi muqarrar kar dijiye. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne naraz ho kar kaha ki tum bare hi jahil log ho al-khabar, tum ne itni bari ibrat-nak nishaniyan dekhi aisi ahem waqiat sune lekin ab tak na ibrat hai na ghairat. Yahan se aage barh kar ek manzil par aap ne qiyam kiya aur yahan apna khalifa apne bhai Hazrat Haron (A.S) ko bana kar kaum se farmaya ki meri wapsi tak un ki farmanbardari karte rehna main apne Rab ke paas ja raha hoon. Tees din ka is ka wada hai. Chunacha kaum se alag ho kar wade ki jagah pohnch kar tees din raat ke rozon poore kar ke Allah se baten karne ka dhyan paida huwa lekin yeh samajh kar ki rozon ki wajah se munh se bhabka nikal raha hoga thori si ghaas le kar aap ne chaba li. Allah Ta'ala ne bawajood ilm ke daryaft farmaya ki aisa kyun kiya ? Aap ne jawab diya sirf is liye ki tujh se baten karte waqt mera munh khushbu-dar ho. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya kya tujhe maloom nahi ki roza-dar ke munh ki boo mujhe mushk-o-anbar ki khushbu se zyada achhi lagti hai ab toh das roze aur rakh phir mujh se kalam karna. Aap ne roze rakhna shuru kardiye.

Qaum par tees din jab guzar gaye aur hasb-e-wada Hazrat Musa (A.S) na lotay toh woh ghamgeen rehne lagay. Hazrat Harun (A.S) ne un mein khutbah kiya aur farmaya ke jab tum Misr se chalay thay toh Qibtiyon ki raqamen tum mein se ba'az par udhaar thin, isi tarah un ki amanatein bhi tumharay paas reh gayi hain. Yeh hum unhein wapas toh karne ke nahi lekin main yeh bhi nahi chahta ke woh hamari malkiyat mein rahein, is liye tum ek gehra garha khodo aur jo asbaab, bartan, bhanda, zewar, sona, chandi waghera un ka tumharay paas hai sab us mein dalo phir aag laga do. 

Chanacha yehi kiya gaya. Un ke sath Samri naami ek shakhs tha, yeh gaaye bachre poojne walon mein se tha, Bani Israel mein se na tha lekin wajah-e-parosi hone ke aur Firon ki kaum mein se na hone ke yeh bhi un ke sath wahan se nikal aya tha. Us ne kisi nishaan se kuch muthi mein utha liya tha. Hazrat Harun (A.S) ne farmaya tu bhi ise daal de. Us ne jawab diya ke yeh toh us ke asar se hai jo tumhein darya se paar kara le gaya. Khair main ise daal deta hoon lekin is shart par ke ap Allah se dua karein ke is se woh ban jaye jo main chahta hoon. 

Ap ne dua ki aur us ne apni muthi mein jo tha use daal diya aur kaha main chahta hoon is ka ek bachra ban jaye. Qudrat-e-Ilahi se us garhe mein jo tha woh ek bachray ki soorat mein ho gaya jo andar se khokhla tha, us mein rooh na thi lekin hawa us ke peechay ke surakh se ja kar munh se nikalti thi, is se ek awaz paida hoti thi. 

Banu Israel ne pucha Samri yeh kya hai? Us be-eiman ne kaha yehi tumhara sab ka Rabb hai lekin Musa (A.S) rasta bhool gaye aur doosri jagah Rabb ki talash mein chalay gaye.

Is baat ne Bani Israel ke kayi firqe kar diye. Ek firqe ne to kaha Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke aane tak hum is ki baabat koi baat tay nahi kar sakte, mumkin hai yehi Allah ho toh hum is ki beadabi kyun karein? Aur agar yeh Rab nahi hai toh Musa (A.S) ke aate hi haqeeqat khul jayegi. Dusri jamaat ne kaha mahz wahiyat hai, yeh shaytani harkat hai, hum is laghviyat par mutlaqan iman nahi rakhte, na yeh hamara Rab, na hamara is par iman. Ek paaji firqe ne dil se ise maan liya aur Samiri ki baat par iman laye magar ba-zahir is ki baat ko jhutlaya. Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ne usi waqt sab ko jama kar ke farmaya ke logo yeh Allah ki taraf se tumhari aazmayish hai, tum is jhagre mein kahan phans gaye, tumhara Rab toh Rahman hai, tum meri ittaba karo aur mera kehna mano. Unho ne kaha aakhir is ki kya wajah ke tees din ka wada kar ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) gaye hain aur aaj chaalis din hone ko aaye lekin ab tak laute nahi. Baaz bewqufon ne yahan tak keh diya ke un se un ka Rab khata kar gaya, ab yeh is ki talaash mein honge. Idhar das roze aur pure hone ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko Allah Ta'ala se ham-kalami ka sharaf hasil hua, aap ko bataya gaya ke aap ke baad aap ki kaum ka is waqt kya haal hai, aap usi waqt ranj-o-afsos aur gham-o-ghusse ke sath wapas laute aur yahan aa kar kaum se bahut kuch kaha suna, apne bhai ke sar ke baal pakad kar ghasitne lage, ghusse ki ziyadti ki wajah se takhtiyan bhi hath se phenk di, phir asal haqeeqat maloom ho jane par aap ne apne bhai se maazrat ki, un ke liye istighfar kiya aur Samiri ki taraf mutawajje ho kar farmane lage ke tu ne aisa kyun kiya? Us ne jawab diya ke Allah ke bheje hue ke paon tale se main ne ek mutthi utha li, yeh log ise na pehchan sake aur main ne jaan liya tha. Main ne wohi mutthi us aag mein daal di thi, meri raye mein yehi baat aayi. Aap ne farmaya ja is ki saza duniya mein toh yeh hai ke tu yehi kehta rahe ke "haath lagana nahi", phir ek wade ka waqt hai jis ka talna namumkin hai aur tere dekhte dekhte hum tere is mabood ko jala kar is ki khaak bhi daryaye mein baha denge. Chunacha aap ne yehi kiya, usi waqt Bani Israel ko yaqeen aa gaya ke waqai woh Allah na tha. Ab woh bade nadam hue aur siwaye un musalmanon ke jo Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ke ham-aqeeda rahe the, baaqi ke logon ne uzr-o-maazrat ki aur kaha ke ae Allah ke Nabi! Allah se dua kijiye ke woh hamare liye tauba ka darwaza khol de, jo woh farmayega hum baja layenge taakih hamari yeh zabardast khata maaf ho jaye. Aap ne Bani Israel ke is groh mein se sattar logon ko chhaant kar alag kiya aur tauba ke liye chale, wahan zameen phat gayi aur aap ke sab sathi us mein utaar diye gaye. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko fikar lahaq hui ke main Bani Israel ko kya munh dikhaunga? Girya-o-zari shuru ki aur dua ki ke ae Allah agar tu chahta toh is se pehle hi mujhe aur in sab ko halak kar deta, hamare bewqufon ke gunah ke badle tu humein halak na kar.

Aap to un ke zahir ko dekh rahe thay aur Allah ki nazrein un ke batin par thin, un mein aise bhi thay jo ba-zahir musalman bane hue thay lekin darasal wahi aqeedah un ka us bachre ke rabb hone par tha, un hi munafiqein ki wajah se sab ko teh-zameen kar diya gaya tha. Nabi Allah ki is ah-o-zari par Rahmat-e-Ilahi josh mein aayi aur jawab mila ke yun to meri rahmat sab par chhayi hui hai lekin main ise un ke naam hiba karunga jo muttaqi parhezgar hon, zakat ke ada karne wale hon, meri baaton par iman layein aur mere is Rasul wa Nabi ki itteba karein jis ke ausaf woh apni kitabon mein likhe pate hain yaani Taurat-o-Injeel mein. 

Hazrat Kaleemullah alaihi salawatullah ne arz ki ke bar-ilahi main ne apni kaum ke liye tauba talab ki, tu ne jawab diya ke tu apni rahmat ko un ke sath kar dega jo aage aane wale hain, phir Allah mujhe bhi tu apni usi rahmat wale Nabi ki ummat mein paida karta. Rabb-ul-Alameen ne farmaya suno un ki tauba us waqt qabul hogi ke yeh log aapas mein ek dusre ko qatal karna shuru kar dein, na baap bete ko dekhe na beta baap ko chhore, aapas mein guth jayein aur ek dusre ko qatal karna shuru kar dein. 

Chunancha Bani Israel ne yahi kiya aur jo munafiq log thay unhon ne bhi sachche dil se tauba ki, Allah Ta'ala ne un ki tauba qabul farmayi, jo bach gaye thay woh bhi bakhshe gaye jo qatal hue woh bhi bakhsh diye gaye. 

Hazrat Musa A.S ab yahan se Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf chale. Taurat ki takhtiyan apne sath leen aur unhein ahkam-e-ilahi sunaye jo un par bahut bhari pare aur unhon ne saaf inkar kar diya. Chunancha ek pahad un ke saron par moalla khura kar diya gaya, woh misl sayeban ke saron par tha aur har dam darr tha ke ab gira, unhon ne ab iqrar kiya aur Taurat qabul kar li, pahad hat gaya. 

Us pak zameen par pahunche jahan Kaleemullah unhein le jana chahte thay, dekha ke wahan ek bari taqatwar zabardast kaum ka qabza hai, to Hazrat Musa A.S ke samne nihayat namardi se kaha ke yahan to bari zor-awar kaum hai hum mein un ke muqabale ki taqat nahi, yeh nikal jayein to hum shehar mein dakhil ho sakte hain. 

Yeh to yunhi namardi aur buzdli zahir karte rahe, idhar Allah Ta'ala ne un sarkashon mein se do shakhson ko hidayat de di, woh shehar se nikal kar Hazrat Musa A.S ki kaum mein aa mile aur unhein samjhane lage ke tum un ke jismon aur tadad se maroob na ho jao, yeh log bahadur nahi un ke dil gurde kamzor hain, tum aage to barho, un ke shehar ke darwaze mein gaye aur un ke hath paon dhele hue, yaqinan tum un par ghalib aa jaoge. 

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh dono shakhs jinhone Bani Israel ko samjhaya aur unhein daler banaya khud Bani Israel mein se hi thay, Wallahu A'lam.

Lekin un ke samjhane bujhane, Allah ke hukm ho jane aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke waade ne bhi un par koi asar na kiya balki unhon ne saaf kora jawab de diya ke jab tak yeh log shahar mein hain hum to yahan se uthne ke bhi nahi, Musa (A.S) tu aap apne Rabb ko apne sath lekar chala ja aur un se lad bhad le hum yahan baithe hue hain. Ab to Hazrat Musa (A.S) se sabr na ho saka, aap ke munh se un buzdilon aur naqadron ke haq mein baddua nikal gayi aur aap ne un ka naam fasiq rakh diya. Allah ki taraf se bhi un ka yahi naam muqarrar ho gaya aur unhein usi maidan mein qudrati taur par qaid kar diya gaya, chalis saal unhein yahin guzar gaye, kahin qarar na tha, usi biyaban mein pareshani ke sath bhatakte phirte the, usi maidan-e-qaid mein un par abr ka saya kar diya gaya aur Mann-o-Salwa utar diya gaya, kapde na phatte the na maile hote the, ek chokona patthar rakha hua tha jis par Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne lakdi mari to us mein se barah nahrein jari ho gayin, har taraf se teen teen log chalte chalte aage badh jate, thak kar qiyam kar dete, subh uthte to dekhte ke woh patthar wahin hai jahan kal tha. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne is hadis ko marfoo bayan kiya hai. Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se suni to farmaya ke is fir'oni ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke agle din ke qatal ki khabar rasani ki thi, yeh baat samajh mein nahi aati, kyunki qibti ke qatal ke waqt siwaye us Bani Israel ek shakhs ke jo qibti se lad raha tha wahan koi aur na tha, is par Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) bahut bigde aur Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) ka hath tham kar Hazrat Sa'd bin Malik (R.A) ke paas le gaye aur un se kaha aap ko yaad hai ke ek din Rasool Allah ﷺ ne hum se us shakhs ka hal bayan farmaya tha jis ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke qatal ke raaz ko khola tha, batao woh Bani Israel shakhs tha ya fir'oni? Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ne farmaya Bani Israel se us fir'oni ne suna phir us ne ja kar hukumat se kaha aur khud us ka shahid bana (Sunan Kubra Nasai). 

Yahi riwayat aur kitabon mein bhi hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke apne kalam se bahut thoda sa hissa marfoo bayan kiya gaya hai. Bahut mumkin hai ke aap ne Banu Israel mein se kisi se yeh riwayat li ho kyunki un se riwayatein lena mubah hain, ya to aap ne Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) se hi yeh riwayat suni hogi aur mumkin hai kisi aur se suni ho. Wallahu A'lam. Main ne apne ustad Sheikh Hafiz Abul Hajjaj Mizzi (R.H) se bhi yahi suna hai.

Lekin un ke samjhane bujhane, Allah ke hukm ho jane aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke waade ne bhi un par koi asar na kiya balki unhon ne saaf kora jawab de diya ke jab tak yeh log shahar mein hain hum to yahan se uthne ke bhi nahi, Musa (A.S) tu aap apne Rabb ko apne sath lekar chala ja aur un se lad bhad le hum yahan baithe hue hain. Ab to Hazrat Musa (A.S) se sabr na ho saka, aap ke munh se un buzdilon aur naqadron ke haq mein baddua nikal gayi aur aap ne un ka naam fasiq rakh diya. Allah ki taraf se bhi un ka yahi naam muqarrar ho gaya aur unhein usi maidan mein qudrati taur par qaid kar diya gaya, chalis saal unhein yahin guzar gaye, kahin qarar na tha, usi biyaban mein pareshani ke sath bhatakte phirte the, usi maidan-e-qaid mein un par abr ka saya kar diya gaya aur Mann-o-Salwa utar diya gaya, kapde na phatte the na maile hote the, ek chokona patthar rakha hua tha jis par Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne lakdi mari to us mein se barah nahrein jari ho gayin, har taraf se teen teen log chalte chalte aage badh jate, thak kar qiyam kar dete, subh uthte to dekhte ke woh patthar wahin hai jahan kal tha. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne is hadis ko marfoo bayan kiya hai. Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se suni to farmaya ke is fir'oni ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke agle din ke qatal ki khabar rasani ki thi, yeh baat samajh mein nahi aati, kyunki qibti ke qatal ke waqt siwaye us Bani Israel ek shakhs ke jo qibti se lad raha tha wahan koi aur na tha, is par Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) bahut bigde aur Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) ka hath tham kar Hazrat Sa'd bin Malik (R.A) ke paas le gaye aur un se kaha aap ko yaad hai ke ek din Rasool Allah ﷺ ne hum se us shakhs ka hal bayan farmaya tha jis ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke qatal ke raaz ko khola tha, batao woh Bani Israel shakhs tha ya fir'oni? Hazrat Sa'd (R.A) ne farmaya Bani Israel se us fir'oni ne suna phir us ne ja kar hukumat se kaha aur khud us ka shahid bana (Sunan Kubra Nasai). 

Yahi riwayat aur kitabon mein bhi hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke apne kalam se bahut thoda sa hissa marfoo bayan kiya gaya hai. Bahut mumkin hai ke aap ne Banu Israel mein se kisi se yeh riwayat li ho kyunki un se riwayatein lena mubah hain, ya to aap ne Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) se hi yeh riwayat suni hogi aur mumkin hai kisi aur se suni ho. Wallahu A'lam. Main ne apne ustad Sheikh Hafiz Abul Hajjaj Mizzi (R.H) se bhi yahi suna hai.

Musa (Alaihis Salam) farar ke baad. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal farma raha hai ke tum Firaun se bhag kar Madyan pahuche, yahan susral mil gaye aur shart ke mutabiq un ki bakriyan barson tak charate rahe. Phir Allah Ta'ala ke andaze aur us ke muqarra waqt par tum us ke paas pahuche. Us Rab ki koi chahat nakaam nahi rehti, koi farman nahi toutta, us ke wade ke mutabiq us ke muqarra waqt par tumhara us ke paas pahuchna lazmi amr tha. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke tum apni qadr-o-izzat ko pahuche yani risalat aur nubat mili. Main ne tumhein apna barguzida paigambar bana liya. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki mulaqat hui to Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha aap ne to logon ko mashaqat mein daal diya unhein jannat se nikal diya. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya aap ko Allah ne apni risalat se mumtaz farmaya aur apne liye pasand farmaya aur Taurat ata farmayi kya is mein aap ne yeh nahi padha ke meri paidaish se pehle yeh sab muqarrar ho chuka tha? Kaha haan. Al-Gharz Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) par daleel mein ghalba pa gaye. Meri di hui daleel aur mojze lekar tu aur tera bhai dono Firaun ke paas jao. Meri yaad mein ghaflat na karna thak kar baith na rehna. Chunacha Firaun ke samne dono zikrullah mein lage rehte taake Allah ki madad un ka sath de unhein qawi aur mazboot bana de aur Firaun ki shaan-o-shaukat taal de. Chunacha Hadith Sharif mein bhi hai ke mera pura aur sacha banda woh hai jo puri umar meri yaad karta rahe. Firaun ke paas tum mera paigam lekar pahucho. Us ne bohat sar utha rakha hai, Allah ki nafarmaniyon par daleer ho gaya hai, bohat phool gaya hai aur apne khaliq-o-malik ko bhool gaya hai. Us se guftagu naram

Jaise farman hai yeh nasihat us ke liye jo ibrat hasil karle ya dar jaye, pas ibrat hasil karne se murad buraiyon se aur khauf ki cheez se hat jana aur dar se murad itaat ki taraf mail hojana hai. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain us ki halakat ki dua na karna jab tak ke us ke tamam uzr khatam na hojayin. Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke ya Umayya bin Abi Salt ke sheron mein hai ke O Allah tu woh hai jis ne apne fazl-o-karam se Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko yeh keh kar baghi Firaun ki taraf bheja ke us se pucho toh kya is asman ko be-sutun ke tu ne tham rakha hai aur tu ne hi ise banaya hai? Aur kya tu ne hi is ke darmiyan roshan suraj ko charhaya hai jo andhere ko ujale se badal deta hai udhar subh ke waqt woh nikla udhar duniya se zulmat door huwi. Bhala batla toh ke mitti mein se dane nikalne wala kaun hai? Aur us mein baliyan paida karne wala kaun hai? Kya in tamam nishaniyon se bhi tu Allah ko nahi pehchan sakta?

Allah ke samne izhar-e-be-basi. Allah ke in dono rasolon ne Allah ki panah talab karte hue apni kamzori ki shikayat Rab ke samne ki ke humein khouf hai ke Firaun kahin hum par koi zulm na kare aur bad-suluki se pesh na aaye. Hamari awaz ko dabane ke liye jaldi se humein kisi museebat mein mubtala na kar de. Aur hamare sath na-insafi se pesh na aaye. Rab-ul-Alameen ki taraf se un ki tashfi kar di gayi. Irshad hua ke is ka kuch khouf na khao main khud tumhare sath hoon aur tumhari aur is ki baat-cheet sunta rahunga aur tumhara haal dekhta rahunga koi baat mujh par makhfi nahi reh sakti is ki choti mere hath mein hai woh baghair meri ijazat ke sans bhi to nahi le sakta. Mere qabze se kabhi bahar nahi nikal sakta. Meri hifazat-o-nusrat ta'yeed-o-madad tumhare sath hai. 

Hadrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-bari mein dua ki ke mujhe woh dua taleem farmai jaye jo main Firaun ke pas jate hue parh liya karun to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh dua taleem farmai. Haya Shrahya jis ke mani arabi mein Ana-ul-Hai qabla kulli shai-in wal-hai ba'da kulli shai-in yani main hi hoon sab se pehle zinda aur sab se baad bhi zinda. 

Phir unhein bataya gaya ke yeh Firaun ko kya kahein? Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh gaye, darwaze par thahere, ijazat mangi, bari der ke baad ijazat mili. 

Muhammad bin Ishaq (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke woh dono paighambar do saal tak rozana subh-o-sham Firaun ke han jate rahe darbanon se kehte rahe ke hum dono paighambaron ki amad ki khabar badshah se karo. Lekin Firaun ke dar ke mare kisi ne khabar na ki do saal ke baad ek roz us ke ek be-takalluf dost ne jo badshah se hasi dil-lagi bhi kar liya karta tha kaha ke aap ke darwaze par ek shakhs khara hai aur ek ajeeb maze ki baat keh raha hai woh kehta hai ke aap ke siva is ka koi aur Rab hai aur is ke Rab ne ise aap ki taraf apna rasool bana kar bheja hai us ne kaha kya mere darwaze par woh hai us ne kaha han. Hukam diya ki andar bula lo chunacha admi gaya aur dono paighambar darbar mein aaye. Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya main Rab-ul-Alameen ka rasool hoon Firaun ne aap ko pehchan liya ke yeh to Musa (A.S) hai. 

Saddi (Rahimahullah) ka bayan hai ke aap Misr mein apne hi ghar thahere the maan ne aur bhai ne pehle to aap ko pehchana nahi ghar mein jo paka tha woh mehman samajh kar un ke pas la rakha is ke baad pehchana salam kiya Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya Allah ka mujhe hukam hua hai ke main is badshah ko Allah ki taraf bulaun aur tumhari nisbat farman hua hai ki tum meri ta'yeed karo. Hadrat Haroon (A.S) ne farmaya phir Bismillah kijiye. Raat ko dono sahib badshah ke han gaye, Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne apni lakri se kawar khatkhataye. Firaun aag bagola ho gaya ke itna bara daler admi kaun aa gaya? Jo yun be-sakhta darbar ke adab ke khilaf apni lakri se mujhe hoshiyar kar raha hai? Darbariyon ne kaha Hadrat kuch nahi yunhi ek majnoon admi hai kehta phirta hai ke main rasool hoon. Firaun ne hukam diya ke ise mere samne pesh karo.

Chanacha Hazrat Harun (Alaihis Salam) ko liye huwe aap us ke paas gaye aur us se farmaya keh hum Allah ke Rasul hain to hamare sath Bani Israel ko bhej de unhein sazaaein nah kar hum Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se apni risalat ki daleelein aur mo'jize le kar aaye hain agar tu hamari baat maan le to tujh par Allah ki taraf se salamati nazil hogi. Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ) ne bhi jo khat Shah-e-Rum Harqal ke naam likha tha us mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim ke baad yeh mazmun tha ke yeh khat Muhammad Rasulullah ki taraf se Shah-e-Rum Harqal ke naam hai jo hidayat ki pairwi kare us par salam ho. Us ke baad yeh ke tum Islam qabul karlo to salamat rahoge Allah Ta'ala dohra ajr inayat farmayega. Musailama Kazzab ne Sadiq-o-Masduq Khatam-ul-Mursalin (ﷺ) ko ek khat likha tha jis mein tahrir tha ke yeh khat Allah ke Rasul Musailama ki janib se Allah ke Rasul Muhammad ke naam, aap par salam ho, main ne aap ko sharik-e-kar karliya hai shahri aap ke liye aur dehati mere liye. Yeh Qurayshi to bare hi zalim log hain. Us ke jawab mein An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne use likha ke yeh Muhammad Rasulullah ki taraf se Musailama Kazzab ke naam hai salam ho un par jo hidayat ki tabadari karein sun le zameen Allah ki malkiyat hai woh apne bando mein se jise chahe is ka waris banata hai anjam ke lihaz se bhale log woh hain jin ke dil khauf-e-ilahi se pur hon. Al-garz Rasulullah Kalimullah Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi Firaun se yahi kaha ke salam un par hai jo hidayat ke pairu hon. Phir farmata hai ke humein bazariya wahi-e-ilahi yeh baat maloom karayi gayi hai ke azab ke layiq sirf wahi log hain jo Allah ke kalam ko jhutlayein aur Allah ki baton ke manne se inkar kar jayein. Jaise irshad hai: (Fa amma man tagha 37) (79. An-Naziat: 37) Jo shakhs sarkashi kare aur duniya ki zindagani par mar mit kar usi ko pasand karle is ka akhiri thikana Jahannam hi hai. Aur ayaton mein hai ke main tumhein shole marne wali aag Jahannam se dara raha hoon jis mein sirf woh badbakht dakhil honge jo jhutlayein aur munh mor lein aur ayaton mein hai ke us ne na to mana na namaz ada ki balkay dil se munkir raha aur kaam farman ke khilaf kiye.

Hukam diya ki andar bula lo chunacha admi gaya aur dono paighambar darbar mein aaye. Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya main Rab-ul-Alameen ka rasool hoon Firaun ne aap ko pehchan liya ke yeh to Musa (A.S) hai. 

Saddi (Rahimahullah) ka bayan hai ke aap Misr mein apne hi ghar thahere the maan ne aur bhai ne pehle to aap ko pehchana nahi ghar mein jo paka tha woh mehman samajh kar un ke pas la rakha is ke baad pehchana salam kiya Hadrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya Allah ka mujhe hukam hua hai ke main is badshah ko Allah ki taraf bulaun aur tumhari nisbat farman hua hai ki tum meri ta'yeed karo. Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ) ne bhi jo khat Shah-e-Rum Harqal ke naam likha tha us mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim ke baad yeh mazmun tha ke yeh khat Muhammad Rasulullah ki taraf se Shah-e-Rum Harqal ke naam hai jo hidayat ki pairwi kare us par salam ho. Us ke baad yeh ke tum Islam qabul karlo to salamat rahoge Allah Ta'ala dohra ajr inayat farmayega. Al-garz Rasulullah Kalimullah Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne bhi Firaun se yahi kaha ke salam un par hai jo hidayat ke pairu hon. Phir farmata hai ke humein bazariya wahi-e-ilahi yeh baat maloom karayi gayi hai ke azab ke layiq sirf wahi log hain jo Allah ke kalam ko jhutlayein aur Allah ki baton ke manne se inkar kar jayein. Jaise irshad hai: (Fa amma man tagha 37) (79. An-Naziat: 37) Jo shakhs sarkashi kare aur duniya ki zindagani par mar mit kar usi ko pasand karle is ka akhiri thikana Jahannam hi hai. Allah ke samne izhar-e-be-basi. Allah ke in dono rasolon ne Allah ki panah talab karte hue apni kamzori ki shikayat Rab ke samne ki ke humein khouf hai ke Firaun kahin hum par koi zulm na kare aur bad-suluki se pesh na aaye. Hamari awaz ko dabane ke liye jaldi se humein kisi museebat mein mubtala na kar de. Aur hamare sath na-insafi se pesh na aaye. Rab-ul-Alameen ki taraf se un ki tashfi kar di gayi. Irshad hua ke is ka kuch khouf na khao main khud tumhare sath hoon aur tumhari aur is ki baat-cheet sunta rahunga aur tumhara haal dekhta rahunga koi baat mujh par makhfi nahi reh sakti is ki choti mere hath mein hai woh baghair meri ijazat ke sans bhi to nahi le sakta. Mere qabze se kabhi bahar nahi nikal sakta. Meri hifazat-o-nusrat ta'yeed-o-madad tumhare sath hai.

Haya Shrahya jis ke mani arabi mein Ana-ul-Hai qabla kulli shai-in wal-hai ba'da kulli shai-in yani main hi hoon sab se pehle zinda aur sab se baad bhi zinda.

Mukalamat-e-Musa (A.S) aur Fir'aun. Chunki yeh nahin-hajar yaani Fir'aun-e-Misr wujud-e-Bari Ta'ala ka munkir tha, paigham-e-Ilahi Kaleemullah ki zubani sun kar wujud-e-khaliq ke inkar ke taur par sawal karne laga ke tumhara bhejne wala aur tumhara Rab kaun hai, main to use nahi janta na use manta hu. Balki meri danish mein to tum sab ka Rab mere siwa aur koi nahi. Allah ke sache Rasool ﷺ ne jawab diya ke hamara Rab woh hai jis ne har shakhs ko is ka jora ata farmaya hai; insan ko basurat-e-insan, gadhe ko is ki surat par, bakri ko ek alag surat par paida farmaya hai. Har ek ko is ki makhsoos surat mein banaya hai. Har ek ki paidaish nirali shan se durust kar di hai. Insani paidaish ka tarika alag, chaupaye alag surat mein hain, darande alag waz'a mein hain. Har ek ki jore ki hayyat-e-tarkibi alhada hai. Khana pina, khane pine ki cheezein, jore sab alag alag aur mumtaz-o-makhsoos hain. Har ek ka andaz muqarrar kar ke phir is ki tarkib ise batla di hai. Amal, ajal, rizq muqarrar aur mukhtas kar ke usi par laga diya hai. Nizam ke sath sari makhlooq ka karkhana chal raha hai. Koi is se idhar udhar nahi ho sakta. Khalq ka khaliq, taqdeeron ka muqarrar karne wala, apne irade par makhlooq ki paidaish karne wala hi hamara Rab hai.

Yeh sab sun kar is be-samajh ne pucha ke acha to phir un ka kya hal hai jo hum se pehle the aur Allah ki ibadat ke munkir the? Is sawal ko is ne ahmiyat ke sath bayan kiya. Lekin Allah ke paighambar (A.S) ne aisa jawab diya ke aajiz ho gaye. Farmaya: Un sab ka ilm mere Rab ko hai. Loh-e-Mahfooz mein un ke aamal likhe hue hain, jaza-saza ka din muqarrar hai, na woh ghalat kare ke koi chota bada is ki pakar se chhoot jaye, na woh bhoole ke mujrim is ki girft se reh jayein. Us ka ilm tamam cheezon ko apne mein ghere hue hai. Uski zat bhool chuk se pak hai, na is ke ilm se koi cheez bahar, na ilm ke baad bhool jane ka is ka wasf, woh kami-e-ilm ke nuqsan se aur bhool ke nuqsan se pak hai.

Chunki yeh nahin-hajar yaani Fir'aun-e-Misr wujud-e-Bari Ta'ala ka munkir tha, paigham-e-Ilahi Kaleemullah ki zubani sun kar wujud-e-khaliq ke inkar ke taur par sawal karne laga ke tumhara bhejne wala aur tumhara Rab kaun hai, main to use nahi janta na use manta hu. Balki meri danish mein to tum sab ka Rab mere siwa aur koi nahi. Allah ke sache Rasool ﷺ ne jawab diya ke hamara Rab woh hai jis ne har shakhs ko is ka jora ata farmaya hai; insan ko basurat-e-insan, gadhe ko is ki surat par, bakri ko ek alag surat par paida farmaya hai. Har ek ko is ki makhsoos surat mein banaya hai. Har ek ki paidaish nirali shan se durust kar di hai. Insani paidaish ka tarika alag, chaupaye alag surat mein hain, darande alag waz'a mein hain. Har ek ki jore ki hayyat-e-tarkibi alhada hai. Khana pina, khane pine ki cheezein, jore sab alag alag aur mumtaz-o-makhsoos hain. Har ek ka andaz muqarrar kar ke phir is ki tarkib ise batla di hai. Amal, ajal, rizq muqarrar aur mukhtas kar ke usi par laga diya hai. Nizam ke sath sari makhlooq ka karkhana chal raha hai. Koi is se idhar udhar nahi ho sakta. Khalq ka khaliq, taqdeeron ka muqarrar karne wala, apne irade par makhlooq ki paidaish karne wala hi hamara Rab hai.

Yeh sab sun kar is be-samajh ne pucha ke acha to phir un ka kya hal hai jo hum se pehle the aur Allah ki ibadat ke munkir the? Is sawal ko is ne ahmiyat ke sath bayan kiya. Lekin Allah ke paighambar (A.S) ne aisa jawab diya ke aajiz ho gaye. Farmaya: Un sab ka ilm mere Rab ko hai. Loh-e-Mahfooz mein un ke aamal likhe hue hain, jaza-saza ka din muqarrar hai, na woh ghalat kare ke koi chota bada is ki pakar se chhoot jaye, na woh bhoole ke mujrim is ki girft se reh jayein. Us ka ilm tamam cheezon ko apne mein ghere hue hai. Uski zat bhool chuk se pak hai, na is ke ilm se koi cheez bahar, na ilm ke baad bhool jane ka is ka wasf, woh kami-e-ilm ke nuqsan se aur bhool ke nuqsan se pak hai.

Allah Rab-ul-Izzat ka ta'aruf. Musa (Alaihis Salam) Firon ke sawal ke jawab mein awsaf-e-Ilahi bayan karte hue farmate hain ke usi Allah ne zameen ko logon ke liye farsh banaya hai. 'Mahda' ki doosri qirat 'Mahada' hai. Zameen ko Allah Ta'ala ne ba-taur farsh ke banadiya hai ke tum is par qarar kiye hue ho, usi par sote baithte rehte sehte ho. Usi ne zameen mein tumhare chalne phirne aur safar karne ke liye raahein banadi hain taake tum rasta na bholo aur manzil-e-maqsood tak ba-aasaani pahunch sako. Wohi aasman se barish barsata hai aur uski wajah se zameen se har qism ki paidawar ugata hai. Khetiyan baغات mewaye qism qism ke zaiqa-dar ke tum khud khalo aur apne janwaro ko chara bhi do. Tumhara khana aur mewaye tumhare janwaron ka chara khushq aur tar sab usi se Allah Ta'ala paida karta hai. Jin ki aqlein sahih salim hain un ke liye to qudrat ki yeh tamam nishaniyan daleel hain. Allah ki uluhiyat, uski wahdaniyat aur uske wajood par. Isi zameen se hum ne tumhein paida farmaya hai. Tumhari ibtida usi se hai. Isliye ke tumhare baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki paidaish usi se hui hai. Isi mein tumhein phir lautna hai, mar kar usi mein dafn hona hai, usi se phir qayamat ke din khade kiye jaoge. Hamari pukar par hamari tareefien karte hue utho ge aur yaqeen karloge ke tum bahut hi thodi der rahe. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke isi zameen par tumhari zindagi guzregi mar kar bhi isi mein jaoge phir usi mein se nikale jaoge. Sunan ki hadith mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne ek mayyat ke dafn ke baad uski qabar par mitti dalte hue pehli baar farmaya (Minha khalaqnakum) (20. Taha: 55), doosri lap dalte hue farmaya (Wa fiha nuidukum) (20. Taha: 55), teesri baar farmaya (Wa minha nukhrijukum taratan ukhra) (20. Taha: 55). Al-gharz Firon ke samne dalelein aa chukin, us ne mojze aur nishan dekh liye lekin sab ka inkar aur takzeeb karta raha, kufr sarakshi zidd aur takabbur se baaz na aaya. Jaise farman hai yaani bawajood yeh ke un ke dilon mein yaqeen ho chuka tha lekin taham az-raah zulm-o-ziyadati inkar se baaz na aaye.

Firoaun ke sahir aur Musa (Alaihis Salam). Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka mojiza lakri ka sanp ban jana, hath ka roshan hojana waghera dekh kar Firoaun ne kaha ke yeh to jadoo hai aur tu jadoo ke zor se hamara mulk chheenna chahta hai. Tu maghroor na hoja hum bhi is jadoo mein tera muqabla kar sakte hain. Din aur jagah muqarrar hojaye aur muqabla hojaye. Hum bhi us din us jagah aajayen aur tu bhi aisa na ho ke koi na aaye. Khule maidan mein sab ke samne haar jeet khul jaye. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya mujhe manzoor hai aur mere khayal se to is ke liye tumhari eid ka din munasib hai kyunke woh fursat ka din hota hai sab aajayen ge aur dekh kar haq-o-batil mein tameez kar lenge. Mojize aur jadoo ka farq sab par zahir hojaye ga. Waqt din charhe ka rakhna chahiye taake jo kuch maidan mein aaye sab dekh saken. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain un ki zeenat aur eid ka din Ashoore ka din tha. Yeh yaad rahe ke Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aise mauqon par kabhi peechhe nahi rehte aisa kaam karte hain jis se haq saaf wazeh hojaye aur har ek parakh le. Isi liye aap ne un ki eid ka din muqarrar kiya aur waqt din charhe ka bataya aur saaf hamwar maidan muqarrar kiya ke jahan se har ek dekh sake aur jo baatein hon woh bhi sun sake. Wahab bin Munbah farmate hain ke Firoaun ne mohlat chahi Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne inkar kiya is par wahi utri ke muddat muqarrar karlo Firoaun ne chaalis din ki mohlat mangi jo manzoor ki gayi.

Muqabla aur Nateeja. Jab ke muqable ki tarikh muqarrar hogayi, din waqt aur jagah bhi hogayi toh Fir'aun ne idhar udhar se jadugaroon ko jama karna shuru kiya us zamane mein jadoo ka bahut zor tha aur bare bare jadugar maujood thay. Fir'aun ne aam taur se hukum jari kardiya tha ke tamam hoshiyar jadugaroon ko mere paas bhej do. Muqarrara waqt tak tamam jadugar jama hogaye Fir'aun ne usi maidan mein apna takht nikalwaya us par baitha tamam umra-o-wuzara apni apni jagah baith gaye riaya sab jama hogayi jadugaroon ki saffon ki saffain parr bandhe takht ke aage khari hogayin. Fir'aun ne unki kamar thonkni shuru ki aur kaha dekho aaj apna woh hunar dikhao ke duniya mein yaadgar reh jaye. Jadugaroon ne kaha ke agar hum baazi le jayein toh hamein kuch inaam bhi milega? Kaha kyun nahi? Main toh tumhe apna khas darbari bana loon ga. Idhar se Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein tabligh shuru ki ke dekho Allah par jhoot na bandho warna shamat-e-amal barbad kar degi. Logon ki aankhon mein khaak na jhonko ke dar-haqeeqat kuch na ho aur tum apne jadoo se bahut kuch dikha do. Allah ke siva koi khaliq nahi jo fi-waqi' kisi cheez ko paida kar sake. Yaad rakho aise jhoote buhtani log falah nahi patay. Yeh sun kar un mein aapas mein che-migoyian shuru hogayin. Baaz toh samajh gaye aur kehne lage yeh kalam jadugaroon ka nahi yeh toh sach much Allah ke rasool hain. Baaz ne kaha nahi balkih yeh jadugar hain muqabla karo. Yeh batein bahut hi ehtiyat aur raaz se ki gayin. (In hazan) ki dusri qirat (In hazain) bhi hai matlab aur maani dono qiratoon ka ek hi hai. Ab ba-aawaz buland kehne lage ke yeh dono bhai sayane aur pahuche hue jadugar hain. Us waqt tak toh tumhari hawa bandhi hui hai badshah ka qurb naseeb hai maal-o-daulat qadmon tale loot raha hai lekin aaj agar yeh baazi le gaye toh zahir hai ke riyasat in hi ki hojaye gi tumhe mulk se nikal dein ge awam in ke matehat hojaye ge in ka zor bandh bandh jaye ga yeh badshahat chheen lein ge aur sath hi tumhare mazhab ko maliya-met kardein ge. Badshahat aish-o-aram sab cheezein tum se chheen jayengi. Sharafat aqlmandi riyasat sab in ke qabze mein aajaye gi tum yunhi bhate bhounte reh jaoge. Tumhare ashraf zaleel hojayein ge ameer faqeer ban jayein ge sari raunaq aur bahar jati rahegi. Bani Israel jo tumhare londhi ghulam bane hue hain yeh sab in ke sath hojaye ge aur tumhari hukumat pash pash hojaye gi. Tum sab ittefaq karlo. In ke muqabale mein saff-bandi kar ke apna koi fann baqi na rakho ji khol kar hoshyari aur danai se apne jadoo ke zor se ise daba lo. Ek hi dafa har ustad apni kari-gari dikha de taake maidan hamare jadoo se pur hojaye dekho agar woh jeet gaya toh yeh riyasat usi ki hojaye gi aur agar hum ghalib aagaye toh tum sun chuke ho ke badshah hamein apna muqarrab aur darbar-e-khas ke araneen bana de ga.

Muqabla aur Nateeja. Jab ke muqable ki tarikh muqarrar hogayi, din waqt aur jagah bhi hogayi toh Fir'aun ne idhar udhar se jadugaroon ko jama karna shuru kiya us zamane mein jadoo ka bahut zor tha aur bare bare jadugar maujood thay. Fir'aun ne aam taur se hukum jari kardiya tha ke tamam hoshiyar jadugaroon ko mere paas bhej do. Muqarrara waqt tak tamam jadugar jama hogaye Fir'aun ne usi maidan mein apna takht nikalwaya us par baitha tamam umra-o-wuzara apni apni jagah baith gaye riaya sab jama hogayi jadugaroon ki saffon ki saffain parr bandhe takht ke aage khari hogayin. Fir'aun ne unki kamar thonkni shuru ki aur kaha dekho aaj apna woh hunar dikhao ke duniya mein yaadgar reh jaye. Jadugaroon ne kaha ke agar hum baazi le jayein toh hamein kuch inaam bhi milega? Kaha kyun nahi? Main toh tumhe apna khas darbari bana loon ga. Idhar se Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein tabligh shuru ki ke dekho Allah par jhoot na bandho warna shamat-e-amal barbad kar degi. Logon ki aankhon mein khaak na jhonko ke dar-haqeeqat kuch na ho aur tum apne jadoo se bahut kuch dikha do. Allah ke siva koi khaliq nahi jo fi-waqi' kisi cheez ko paida kar sake. Yaad rakho aise jhoote buhtani log falah nahi patay. Yeh sun kar un mein aapas mein che-migoyian shuru hogayin. Baaz toh samajh gaye aur kehne lage yeh kalam jadugaroon ka nahi yeh toh sach much Allah ke rasool hain. Baaz ne kaha nahi balkih yeh jadugar hain muqabla karo. Yeh batein bahut hi ehtiyat aur raaz se ki gayin. (In hazan) ki dusri qirat (In hazain) bhi hai matlab aur maani dono qiratoon ka ek hi hai. Ab ba-aawaz buland kehne lage ke yeh dono bhai sayane aur pahuche hue jadugar hain. Us waqt tak toh tumhari hawa bandhi hui hai badshah ka qurb naseeb hai maal-o-daulat qadmon tale loot raha hai lekin aaj agar yeh baazi le gaye toh zahir hai ke riyasat in hi ki hojaye gi tumhe mulk se nikal dein ge awam in ke matehat hojaye ge in ka zor bandh bandh jaye ga yeh badshahat chheen lein ge aur sath hi tumhare mazhab ko maliya-met kardein ge. Muqabla shuru huwa. Jadoogron ne Musa A.S se kaha ke ab batao tum apna waar pehle karte ho ya hum pehal karein? Us ke jawab mein Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya tum hi pehle apne dil ki bhadas nikal lo taake duniya dekh le ke tum ne kya kya aur phir Allah ne tumhare kiye ko kis tarah mita diya? Isi waqt unhon ne apni lakdiyan aur rassiyan maidan mein daal dien kuch aisa maloom hone laga ke goya woh saanp ban kar chal phir rahi hain aur maidan mein daud bhaag rahi hain. Kehne lage Firon ke iqbal se ghalib hum hi rahenge logon ki ankhon par jadoo kar ke unhein khaufzada kar diya aur jadoo ke zabardast kartab dikha diye. Yeh log bahut zyada thay. Un ki phenki hui rassiyon aur lathiyon se ab saare ka sara maidan saanpon se pur ho gaya woh aapas mein gud mud ho kar upar tale hone lage. Is manzar ne Hazrat Musa A.S ko khaufzada kar diya ke kahin aisa na ho log un ke kartab ke qayil ho jayein aur is baatil mein phans jayein. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari ne wahi nazil farmayi ke apne dahine haath ki lakdi ko maidan mein daal do harasan na ho. Aap ne hukm ki taamil ki. Allah ke hukm se yeh lakdi ek zabardast bemisal ajdaha ban gayi, jis ke pair bhi thay aur sar bhi tha. Kuchliyan aur daant bhi thay. Us ne sab ke dekhte sare maidan ko saaf kar diya. Us ne jadoogron ke jitne kartab thay sab ko hadap kar liya. Ab sab par haq wazeh ho gaya, mojze aur jadoo mein tameez ho gayi. Haq-o-baatil mein pehchan ho gayi. Sab ne jaan liya ke jadoogron ki banawat mein asliyat kuch bhi na thi. Fi al-waqie jadoogar koi chaal chalein lekin is mein ghalib nahi aa sakte. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadith hai Tirmizi mein bhi mawqufan aur marfuan marwi hai ke jadoogar ko jahan pakdo maar dalo, phir aap ne yehi jumla tilawat farmaya. Yani jahan paya jaye amn na diya jaye. Jadoogron ne jab yeh dekha unhein yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh kaam insani taaqat se kharij hai woh jadoo ke fann mein mahir thay aik nigah pehchan gaye ke waqie yeh us Allah ka kaam hai jis ke farman atal hain jo kuch woh chahe us ke hukm se ho jata hai. Us ke irade se murad juda nahi. Us ka itna kamil yaqeen unhein ho gaya ke isi waqt isi maidan mein sab ke samne baadshah ki maujudgi mein woh Allah ke samne sar-ba-sujud ho gaye aur pukar uthe ke hum Rab-ul-Alamin par yani Harun aur Musa (Alaihimas Salam) ke parvardigar par iman laye. SubhanAllah subah ke waqt kafir aur jadoogar thay aur shaam ko pakbaz momin aur Allah ki raah ke shaheed thay. Kehte hain ke un ki tadad assi hazaar thi ya sattar hazaar ya kuch upar tees hazaar ya unees hazaar ya pandrah hazaar ya barah hazaar. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh sattar thay. Subah jadoogar shaam ko shaheed. Marwi hai ke jab yeh sajde mein gire hain Allah Ta'ala ne unhein jannat dikha di aur unhon ne apni manzilein apni ankhon se dekh leen.

Kehne lage Firon ke iqbal se ghalib hum hi rahenge logon ki ankhon par jadoo kar ke unhein khaufzada kar diya aur jadoo ke zabardast kartab dikha diye. Yeh log bahut zyada thay. Un ki phenki hui rassiyon aur lathiyon se ab saare ka sara maidan saanpon se pur ho gaya woh aapas mein gud mud ho kar upar tale hone lage. Is manzar ne Hazrat Musa A.S ko khaufzada kar diya ke kahin aisa na ho log un ke kartab ke qayil ho jayein aur is baatil mein phans jayein. Natija Musa A.S ki sadaqat ka gawah bana. Allah ki shan dekhiye chahiye to yeh tha ki Firaun ab rah-e-rast par ajata. Jin ko is muqable ke liye bulwaya tha woh aam majma mein haare. Unhon ne apni haar maan li apne kartoot ko jadoo aur Hazrat Musa A.S ke mojize ko Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se ata-karda mojiza tasleem karliya. Khud iman le aye jo muqable ke liye bulwaye gaye the. Majma-e-aam mein sab ke samne be-jhijhak unhon ne deen-e-haq qubool karliya. Lekin yeh apni shaitaniyat mein aur barh gaya aur apni quwwat-o-taqat dikhane laga lekin bhala haq wale madi taqaton ko samajhte hi kya hain? Pehle to jadugaron ke is muslim giroh se kehne laga ki meri ijazat ke baghair tum is par iman kyun laye? Phir aisa bohtan bandha jis ka jhoot hona bilkul wazeh hai ki Hazrat Musa A.S to tumhare ustad hain unhi se tum ne jadoo seekha hai. Tum sab aapas mein ek hi ho mashwara karke humein taraj karne ke liye tum ne pehle unhein bheja phir is ke muqable mein khud aye ho aur apne androni samjhote ke mutabiq samne haar gaye ho aur ise jata diya aur phir is ka deen qubool karliya taake tumhari dekha-dekhi meri raaya bhi chakkar mein phans jaye magar tumhein apni is saz-baaz ka anjam bhi maloom hojaye ga. Main ulti seedhi taraf se tumhare hath paon kaat kar khajoor ke tanon par suli doonga aur is buri tarah tumhari jaan loon ga ki doosron ke liye ibrat ho. Isi badshah ne sab se pehle yeh saza di hai. Tum jo apne aapko hidayat par aur mujhe aur meri kaum ko gumraahi par samajhte ho is ka hal tumhein maloom hojaye ga ki daimi azab kis par ata hai. Is dhamki ka un dilon par ulta asar huwa. Woh apne iman mein kamil ban gaye aur nihayat be-parwahi se jawab diya ki is hidayat-o-yaqeen ke muqable mein jo humein ab Allah ki taraf se hasil huwa hai hum tera mazhab kisi tarah qubool karne ke nahi. Na tujhe hum apne sachche khaliq malik ke samne koi cheez samjhein. Aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ki yeh jumla qasam ho yani us Allah ki qasam jis ne humein awwalan paida kiya hai hum in wazeh daleelon par teri gumraahi ko tarjeeh de hi nahi sakte khwah tu hamare sath kuch hi karle. Mustahiq-e-ibadat woh hai jis ne humein banaya na ki tu, jo khud usi ka banaya huwa hai. Tujhe jo karna ho is mein kami na kar tu to humein usi waqt tak saza de sakta hai jab tak hum is duniya ki hayat ki qaid mein hain humein yaqeen hai ki is ke baad abadi rahat aur ghair fani khushi-o-masarrat naseeb hogi. Hum apne Rab par iman laye hain humein umeed hai ki woh hamare agle qasooron se dar-guzar farma lega bilkhusoos yeh qasoor jo hum se Allah ke sachche nabi ke muqable par jadoo bazi karne ka sarzad huwa hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Firaun ne Bani Israel ke chaalis bachche lekar unhein jadugaron ke supurd kiya tha ki unhein jadoo ki poori taleem do ab yeh larke yeh maqoola keh rahe hain ki tune hum se jabran jadugari ki khidmat li. Hazrat Abdul Rahman bin Zaid R.H ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

Iman yaaftah jadugaroron par Firaun ka itab. Zahir maloom hota hai ki jadugaroron ne iman qabul farma kar Firaun ko jo nasihtein kin unhi mein yeh ayatein bhi hain. Usay Allah ke azab ke azabon se dara rahe hain aur Allah ki nematon ka lalach dila rahe hain ke gunahgaron ka thikana Jahannam hai jahan maut to kabhi aane hi ki nahi lekin zindagi bhi bari mashaqqat wali maut se badtar hogi. Jiska farman hai (la yuqda 'alayhim fayamutu wa la yukhaffafu 'anhum min 'azabiha, kazaalika najzi kulla kafur 36) (35. Fatir: 36). Yani na maut aaye gi na azab halke honge kafiron ko hum isi tarah saza dete hain. Aur ayatein mein hai (wa yatajannabuha al-ashqa 11) (87. Al-A'la: 11) yani Allah ki nasihtein se befayiz wahi rahega jo azali badbakht ho jo akhirkar bari sakht aag mein girega jahan na to موت aaye na chain ki zindagi naseeb ho. Aur aayat mein hai ki Jahannam mein jhalste hue kahenge ke aye darogha-e-Dozakh tum dua karo ke Allah Ta'ala humein maut hi de de lekin woh jawab dega ke na tum marne wale ho na nikalne wale. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain ke asli jahannami to Jahannam mein hi pare rahenge na wahan unhein maut aaye na aaram ki zindagi mile haan aise log bhi honge jinhein un gunahon ki padash mein dozakh mein dal diya jayega jahan woh jal kar koyla ho jayenge jaan nikal jayegi phir shafahat ki ijazat ke baad unka chura nikala jayega aur Jannat ki nahron ke kinaron par bikhir diya jayega aur jannatiyon se farmaya jayega ke un par pani dalo to jis tarah tumne nahar ke kinare ke khet ke danon ko ugte hue dekha hai usi tarah woh ugenge. Yeh sun kar ek shakhs kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ ne misal to aisi di hai goya aap kuch zamana jangal mein guzar chuke hain. Aur hadith mein hai ki khutbe mein is aayat ki tilawat ke baad aap ne yeh farmaya tha. Aur jo Allah se qayamat iman aur amal-e-salih ke sath ja mila use unche bala khanon wali Jannat milegi. Rasool اللہ ﷺ farmate hain Jannat ke sau darjon mein itna hi fasila hai jitna zameen-o-asman mein. Sab se upar Jannat-ul-Firdaus hai usi se charon nahrein jari hoti hain iski chat Rahman ka Arsh hai Allah se jab Jannat mango to Jannat-ul-Firdaus ki dua karo. (Tirmidhi waghairah) Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke kaha jata tha ke Jannat ke sau darje hain har darje ke phir sau darje hain do darjon mein itni duri hai jitni asman-o-zameen mein. In mein yaqut aur moti hain aur zewar bhi. Har Jannat mein ameer hai jiski fazilat aur sardari ke dusre qail hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke A'la Illiyyin wale aise dikhai dete hain jaise tum log asman ke sitaron ko dekhte ho. Logon ne kaha phir yeh buland darje to nabiyon ke liye hi مخصوص honge? Farmaiyega suno uski qsam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai yeh woh log hain jo Allah par iman laye nabiyon ko sacha jana. Sunan ki hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke Abu Bakr-o-Umar unhi mein se hain. Aur kitne hi acche martabe wale hain.

Yeh jannatein humeshagi ki iqamat hain jahan yeh hamesha abad-ul-abad rahenge. Jo log apne nafs pak rakhein gunahon se, khabase se, gandagi se, shirk-o-kufr se door rahein, Allah wahid ki ibadat karte rahein, rasoolon ki ita'at mein umr guzar dein, un ke liye yahi qabil-e-rashq maqamat aur qabil-e-sad mubarakbad inaam hain (Razaqna Allahu iyyaha).

Yeh sun kar ek shakhs kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ ne misal to aisi di hai goya aap kuch zamana jangal mein guzar chuke hain. Aur kitne hi acche martabe wale hain.
