Bani Israel ki hijrat aur Firaun ka taaqub. Chونکہ (Chunke) Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke is farman ko bhi Firaun ne taal diya tha ke woh Bani Israel ko apni ghulami se azaad kar ke unhein Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ke supurd karde is liye Janab-e-Bari ne Aap ko hukum farmaya ke Aap raato raat unki behkhabri mein tamam Bani Israel ko chup chaap le kar yahan se chale jayen jaise ke iska tafsili bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein aur bahut si jagah par hua hai chunache hasb-e-irshad Aap ne Bani Israel ko apne sath le kar yahan hijrat ki. Subah jab Firauni jaage aur sare shehar mein ek Bani Israel na dekha. Firaun ko itlaa di woh maare ghusse ke chakkar kha gaya aur har taraf munadi dora diye ke lashkar jama hojayen aur daant pees pees kar kehne laga ke is muthi bhar jamalat ne hamare naak mein dam kar rakha hai aaj in sab ko teh-tegh kardunga. Suraj nikalte hi lashkar aa mojood hua usi waqt khud sare lashkar ko le kar unke taaqub mein rawanah hogaya. Bani Israel darya ke kinare pahunche hi the ke Firauni lashkar unhein dikhai de gaya ghabra kar apne nabi se kehne lage lo Hazrat ab kya hoga samne darya hai peeche Firauni hain. Aap ne jawab diya ghabrane ki baat nahi meri madad par khud mera Rabb hai woh abhi mujhe raah dikha dega usi waqt Wahi-e-Ilahi aayi ke Musa darya par apni lakri maar woh hat kar tumhe rasta de dega. Chunache Aap ne yeh keh kar lakri mari ke A darya buhkum-e-Ilahi tu hat ja usi waqt uska pani patthar ki tarah idhar udhar jam gaya aur beech mein raste numayan hogaye. Idhar udhar pani misl paharon ke khada hogaya aur tez aur khushk hawaon ke jhonkon ne raston ko bilkul sokhi zameen ke raston ki tarah kardia. Na to Firaun ki pakad ka khauf raha na darya mein doob jaane ka khatra raha. Firaun aur uske lashkari yeh haal dekh rahe the. Firaun ne hukum diya ke inhi raston se tum bhi paar hojao. Chikhta koodta ma tamam lashkar ke in hi raahon mein utar pada unke utarte hi pani ko behne ka hukum hogaya aur chashm-e-zadan mein tamam Firauni dubo diye gaye. Darya ki maujon ne unhein chhupaliya. Yahan jo farmaya ke unhein is cheez ne dhanp liya jis ne dhanp liya yeh is liye ke yeh mashhoor-o-maroof hai, naam lene ki zaroorat nahi

Ihsanaat ki yaad-dehani. Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne Bani Israel par jo bare bare ehsan kiye the unhe yaad dila raha hai, un mein se ek toh yeh hai ki unhe unke dushman se nijat di. Aur itna hi nahi balki unke dushmano ko unke dekhte hue darya mein dubo diya. Ek bhi un mein se baaki na bacha jaise farman hai (Wa aghraqna Aala Fir'awna wa antum tanzurun). Yaani hum ne tumhare dekhte hue Fir'awniyo ko dubo diya. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ki Madine ke yahudiyo ko Ashure ke din ka roza rakhte hue dekh kar Rasulullah ﷺ ne un se is ka sabab maloom farmaya, unho ne jawab diya ki isi din Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa ؑ ko Fir'awn par kamyab kiya tha. Aap ne farmaya phir toh hume ba-nisbat tumhare un se zyada qurb hai, chunache aap ne musalmano ko is din ke roze ka hukum diya. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kaleem ko Koh-e-Toor ki daayi jaanib ka wada diya. Aap wahan gaye aur peeche se Banu Israel ne gosalaparasti shuru kar di. Jis ka bayan abhi aage aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Isi tarah ek ehsan un par yeh kiya ki Mann-o-Salwa khane ko diya, is ka poora bayan Surah Al-Baqarah waghaira ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Mann ek meethi cheez thi jo un ke liye aasmaan se utarti thi aur Salwa ek qism ke parind the jo ba-hukum-e-Khawandari un ke saamne aa jaate the, yeh ba-qadr ek din ki khuraak ke unhe le lete the. Hamari yeh di hui rozi khao is mein had se na guzar jao, haram cheez ya haram zariye se ise na talab karo. Warna mera ghazab nazil hoga aur jis par mera ghazab utre yaqeen mano ki woh badbakht ho gaya. Hazrat Shaqeeq bin Salama (ya Shughi bin Mani' ؒ) farmate hain ki Jahannam mein ek oonchi jagah bani hui hai jahan kafir ko Jahannam mein giraya jata hai toh zanjeeron ki jagah tak chaalis saal mein pahunchta hai, yahi matlab is aayat ka hai ki woh garhe mein gir para. Haan jo bhi apne gunaho se mere saamne tauba kare main us ki tauba qubool karta hoon. Dekho Bani Israel mein se jinhone bachhre ki puja ki thi, un ki tauba ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne un ko bakhsh diya. Gharaz jis kufr-o-shirk, gunah-o-masiyat par koi ho phir woh ise ba-khauf-e-Ilahi chhor de Allah Ta'ala use maaf farma deta hai. Haan dil mein iman aur aamal-e-saliha bhi karta ho aur ho bhi rah-e-raast par. Shakki na ho, Sunnat-e-Rasul aur Jamamat-e-Sahaba ki rosh par ho, is mein sawab janta ho. Yahan par thumma ka lafz khabar ki khabar par tarteeb karne ke liye aaya hai, jaise farman (Thumma kana minal-lazeena amanu wa tawasaw bil-sabri wa tawasaw bil-marhamah) (Surah Al-Balad: 17).

Bani Israel ka darya paar jana. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) jab darya paar kar ke nikal gaye toh aik jagah pohnche jahan ke log apne buton ke mujawir ban kar baithe hue thay toh Bani Israel kehne lage Musa hamare liye bhi in ki tarah koi mabood muqarrar kar dijiye. Aap ne farmaya tum bare jahil log ho yeh toh barbaad shuda log hain aur in ki ibadat bhi baatil hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko tees rozon ka hukm diya. Phir das barha diye gaye poore chaalis ho gaye din raat roze se rehte thay ab aap jaldi se Tur ki taraf chale Bani Israel par apne bhai Harun ko khalifa muqarrar kiya. Wahan jab pohnche toh Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne is jaldi ki wajah daryaft farmayi. Aap ne jawab diya ke woh bhi Tur ke qareeb hi hain aa rahe hain main ne jaldi ki hai ke teri raza-mandi hasil kar loon aur is mein barh jaon. Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke baad phir shirk. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke tere chale aane ke baad teri qoum mein naya fitna barpa huwa aur unhon ne gosalaparasti shuru kar di hai is bachre ko Samari ne banaya aur unhe is ki ibadat mein laga diya hai Israeli kitabon mein hai ke Samari ka naam bhi Harun tha Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko ata farmane ke liye Taurat ki takhtiyan likh li gayi thin jaise farman hai (Wakatabna lahu fil-alwahi min kulli shayin maw-izatan wa tafsilan likulli shayin fakhuzha biquwwatin wa amur qawmaka ya/khuzu bi-ahsanha sa-urikumu dara-l-fasiqin) (7. Al-A'raf: 145) yaani hum ne is ke liye takhtiyon mein har shay ka tazkira aur har cheez ki tafseil likh di thi aur keh diya ke ise mazbooti se tham lo aur apni qoum se bhi kaho ke is par omdagi se amal karein. Main tumhein anqareeb fasiqon ka anjam dikha doon ga. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko jab apni qoum ke mushrikanah fail ka ilm huwa toh sakht ranj huwa aur gham-o-ghusse mein bhare hue wahan se wapas qoum ki taraf chale ke dekho in logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke inaamat ke bawajood aise sakht ahmaqanah aur mushrikanah fail ka irtikab kiya. Gham-o-andoh ranj-o-ghussa aap ko bohat aya. Wapas aate hi kehne lage ke dekho Allah Ta'ala ne tum se tamam naik waade kiye thay tumhare sath bare bare sulook-o-inam kiye lekin zara se waqfe mein tum Allah Ta'ala ki neamton ko bhula baithe balkih tum ne woh harkat ki jis se Allah ka ghazab tum par utar para tum ne mujh se jo wada kiya tha is ka mutlaq lehaz na rakha. Ab Bani Israel mazrat karne lage ke hum ne yeh kaam apne ikhtiyar se nahi kiya baat yeh hai ke jo zewar Firayoniyon ke hamare paas mustaar liye hue thay hum ne behtar yahi samjha ke unhein phenk dein chunancha hum ne sab ke sab bator parhezgari ke phenk diye. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke aane se pehle Hazrat Harun (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein harchand samjhaya bujhaya ke dekho fitne mein na pado Allah Rahman ke siva aur kisi ke samne na jhuko. Koh-e-Tur se wapsi aur Bani Israel ki harkat pe ghussa. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) sakht ghussay aur pooray gham mein lotay thay. Takhtiyan zameen par marain aur apnay bhai Haroon ki taraf ghussay se barh gaye aur unke sar ke baal thaam kar apni taraf ghaseetnay lagay. Iska tafseeli bayaan Surah Al-A'raf ki tafseer mein guzar chuka hai aur wohin woh hadith bhi bayaan ho chuki hai ke sunna dekhne ke mutabiq nahi. Aap ne apnay bhai aur apnay jaan-nasheen ko malamat karni shuru ki ke is بت parستی ke shuru hotay hi tu ne mujhe khabar kyun na ki ? Kya jo kuch mein tujhe keh gaya tha tu bhi iska mukhalif ban baitha ? Mein to saaf keh gaya tha ke meri kaum mein meri jaan-nasheeni kar islah ke darpay reh aur mufsidon ki na maan. Hazrat Haroon (Alaihis Salam) ne jawab detay huwe kaha ke ay meray maa jaye bhai—yeh sirf is liye ke Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko ziyada raham aur mohabbat aaye warna baap alag alag na thay baap bhi ek hi thay dono sagay bhai thay. Aap uzr pesh kartay hain ke ji mein to meray bhi aayi thi ke aap ke paas aa kar aap ko iski khabar karun lekin phir khayaal aaya ke unhein tanha chhorna munasib nahi kahin aap mujh par na bigar baithay ke unhein tanha kyun chhor diya aur aulaad-e-Yaqub mein yeh judai kyun daal di ? Aur jo mein keh gaya tha uski nigehbani kyun na ki ? Baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Haroon (Alaihis Salam) mein jahan itaat ka poora maada tha wahan Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki izzat bhi bohat kartay thay aur unka bohat hi lihaaz rakhtay thay.

Gaye parast Samri aur bachhra. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne Samri se poocha ke tu ne yeh fitna kyun uthaya? Yeh shakhs Bajruka rehne wala tha iski kaum gaye parast thi. Iske dil mein gaye ki mohabbat ghar kiye hue thi. Usne Bani Israel ke sath apne iman ka izhaar kiya tha. Uska naam Musa bin Zafar tha, ek riwayat mein hai yeh Karmani tha. Ek riwayat mein hai iski basti ka naam Samra tha. Usne jawab diya ke jab Firon ki halakat ke liye Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) aaye toh maine unke ghore ke tap tale se thori si mitti utha li. Aksar mufassirin ke nazdeek mashhoor baat yahi hai, Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) aaye aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko lekar charhne lage toh Samri ne dekh liya. Usne jaldi se unke ghore ke sum tale ki mitti utha li. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko Jibril (Alaihis Salam) asman tak le gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne Taurat likhi, Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) qalam ki tehreer ki awaz sun rahe thay lekin jab apko apni kaum ki museebat maloom hui toh niche utar aye aur is bachhre ko jala diya. Lekin is asar ki sanad gharib hai. Isi khaak ki chutki ya mutthi ko usne Bani Israel ke jama kardah zewaron ke jalne ke waqt in mein dal diya. Jo ba-soorat bachhra ban gaye aur chunke beech mein khala tha wahan se hawa ghusti thi aur isse awaz nikalti thi. Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) ko dekhte hi iske dil mein khayal guzra tha ke main iske ghore ke tapon tale ki mitti utha loon, main jo chahoonga woh is mitti ke dalne se ban jayega. Iski ungliyan usi waqt sookh gayi thin. Jab Bani Israel ne dekha ke unke pas Fironiyon ke zewarat reh gaye aur Fironi halak ho gaye aur yeh ab unko wapas nahi ho sakte toh ghamzada hone lage. Samri ne kaha dekho iski wajah se tum par museebat nazil hui hai, ise jama kar ke aag laga do. Jab woh jama ho gaye aur aag se pighal gaye

Marvi hai ke us ne Bani Israel ki aurton ke zewar jahan tak us ke bas mein thay liye, un ka bachra banaya jisay Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne jala diya aur darya mein us ki khaak baha di. Jis ne bhi us ka pani piya us ka chehra zard par gaya, us se saare gowsala parast maloom ho gaye. Ab unhon ne tauba ki aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se daryaft kiya ke hamari tauba kaise qubool hogi? Hukam hua ke aik doosray ko qatal karo. Is ka poora bayan pehlay guzar chuka hai. Phir Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tumhara mabood yeh nahi. Mustahiq-e-ibadat to sirf Allah Ta'ala hai, baqi tamam jahan us ka mohtaj hai aur us ke matahat hai. Woh har cheez ka alim hai, us ke ilm ne tamam makhlooq ka ihata kar rakha hai, har cheez ki ginti usay maloom hai. Aik zarra bhi us ke ilm se bahar nahi, har pattay ka aur har danay ka usay ilm hai balkay us ke paas ki kitab mein woh likha hua mojood hai. Zameen ke tamam jandaron ko roziyan wahi pohanchata hai, sab ki jagah usay maloom hai, sab kuch khuli aur wazeh kitab mein likha hua hai. Ilm-e-Ilahi moheet-e-kul aur sab ko haawi hai, is mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain.

Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) ko dekhte hi iske dil mein khayal guzra tha ke main iske ghore ke tapon tale ki mitti utha loon, main jo chahoonga woh is mitti ke dalne se ban jayega. Iski ungliyan usi waqt sookh gayi thin. Jab Bani Israel ne dekha ke unke pas Fironiyon ke zewarat reh gaye aur Fironi halak ho gaye aur yeh ab unko wapas nahi ho sakte toh ghamzada hone lage. Samri ne kaha dekho iski wajah se tum par museebat nazil hui hai, ise jama kar ke aag laga do. Jab woh jama ho gaye aur aag se pighal gaye

Marvi hai ke us ne Bani Israel ki aurton ke zewar jahan tak us ke bas mein thay liye, un ka bachra banaya jisay Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne jala diya aur darya mein us ki khaak baha di. Jis ne bhi us ka pani piya us ka chehra zard par gaya, us se saare gowsala parast maloom ho gaye. Ab unhon ne tauba ki aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) se daryaft kiya ke hamari tauba kaise qubool hogi? Hukam hua ke aik doosray ko qatal karo. Is ka poora bayan pehlay guzar chuka hai. Phir Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tumhara mabood yeh nahi. Mustahiq-e-ibadat to sirf Allah Ta'ala hai, baqi tamam jahan us ka mohtaj hai aur us ke matahat hai. Woh har cheez ka alim hai, us ke ilm ne tamam makhlooq ka ihata kar rakha hai, har cheez ki ginti usay maloom hai. Aik zarra bhi us ke ilm se bahar nahi, har pattay ka aur har danay ka usay ilm hai balkay us ke paas ki kitab mein woh likha hua mojood hai. Zameen ke tamam jandaron ko roziyan wahi pohanchata hai, sab ki jagah usay maloom hai, sab kuch khuli aur wazeh kitab mein likha hua hai. Ilm-e-Ilahi moheet-e-kul aur sab ko haawi hai, is mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain.

Gaye parast Samri aur bachhra. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne Samri se poocha ke tu ne yeh fitna kyun uthaya? Yeh shakhs Bajruka rehne wala tha iski kaum gaye parast thi. Sab se aala kitab farman hai ke jaise Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka qissa asli rang mein aap ke saamne bayan huwa aise hi aur bhi haalat-e-guzashta aap ke saamne hum bah-o-bah bayan farma rahe hain. Hum ne to aap ko Quran-e-Azeem de rakha hai jis ke paas baatil phatak nahi sakta kyunke aap Hikmat-o-Hamd wale hain, kisi Nabi ko koi kitab is se zyada kamal wali aur is se zyada jami aur is se babarakat nahi mili. Har tarah sab se aala kitab yahi Kalam-e-Allah Sharif hai jis mein guzashta ki khabrein, ayinda ke umoor aur har kaam ke tareeqe mazkoor hain. Isse na manne wala, is se munh pherne wala, iske ahkaam se bhagne wala, iske siva kisi aur mein hidayat ko talaash karne wala gumrah hai aur jahannam ki taraf jaane wala hai. Qayamat ko woh apna bojh aap uthayega aur is mein dab jayega, iske saath jo bhi kufr kare woh jahannami hai, kitabi ho ya ghair kitabi, ajmi ho ya arbi, iska munkir jahannami hai. Jaise farman hai ke main tumhe bhi hoshyari karne wala hoon aur jise bhi yeh pahunche, pas iska muttabi hidayat wala aur iska mukhalif zalalat-o-shaqawat wala jo yahan barbaad huwa woh wahan dozakhi bana. Is azaab se isse na to kabhi chhutkara hasil ho na bach sake, bura bojh hai jo is par is din hoga.

Soor kya hai ? Rasoolullah ﷺ se sawal hota hai ke soor kya cheez hai ? Aap ne farmaya woh ek qarn hai jo phoonka jayega. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ka daaira bi-qadr aasmanon aur zameenon ke hai Hazrat Israfil ؑ ise phoonkenge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne farmaya main kaise aaram hasil karun halanki soor phoonkne wale farishte ne soor ka luqma bana liya hai peshani jhuka di hai aur intezar mein hai ke kab hukum diya jaye. Logon ne kaha phir Huzoor ﷺ hum kya padhein ? Farmaya kaho (Wa qalu hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel) (Surah Ali-Imran: 173). Us waqt tamam logon ka hashar hoga ki maare dar aur ghabrahat ke gunehgaaron ki aankhein tedhi ho rahi hongi. Ek dusre se poshida poshida keh rahe honge ke duniya mein to hum bahut hi kam rahe zyada se zyada shayad das din wahan guzre honge. Hum un ki is raazdari ki guftugu ko bhi ba-khoobi jaante hain jab ke un mein se bada aaqil aur kamil insan kahega ke miyan din bhi kahan ke ? Hum to sirf ek din hi duniya mein rahe. Garz kuffaar ko duniya ki zindagi ek sapne ki tarah maloom hogi. Us waqt woh qasemein kha kha kar kahenge ke sirf ek sa'at hi duniya mein hum to tehre honge. Chunache aur aayat mein hai (Awa lam nu'ammirkum ma yatazakkaru fihi) (Surah Fatir: 37) Hum ne tumhein ibrat hasil karne ke qabil umar bhi di thi phir hoshyar karne wale bhi tumhare paas aa chuke the. Aur aayaton mein hai ke is sawal par ke tum kitna arsa zameen par guzar aaye ? Un ka jawab hai ek din balke is se bhi kam. Fi-waqia duniya hai bhi akhirat ke muqable mein aisi hi. Lekin agar is baat ko pehle se bawar kar lete to is fani ko is baaqi par is thodi ko is bahut par pasand na karte balke akhirat ka saman is duniya mein karte.

Pahaaron ka kya hoga ? Logon ne pucha ke Qiyamat ke din yeh pahaad baaqi rahenge ya nahi ? Unka sawaal naqal karke jawab diya jata hai ke yeh hat jayenge, chalte phirte nazar aayenge aur aakhir reza reza ho jayenge. Zameen saaf chatil hamwaar maidan ki soorat mein ho jayegi. Qaa ke maane hamwaar saaf maidan ke hain. Safsofa usi ki taakeed hai aur safsaf ke maane baghair rooyidagi ki zameen ke bhi hain lekin pehle maane zyada ache hain aur doosre muradi aur lazmi hain. Na us mein koi waadi rahegi na teela na oonchan rahegi na nichai. In dehshatnaak umoor ke sath hi ek aawaz dene wala aawaz dega jis ki aawaz par saari makhlooq lag jayegi, daudti hui hasab-e-farman ek taraf chali ja rahi hogi na idhar udhar hogi na tedhi baanki chalegi kaash ke yahi rawash duniya mein rakhte aur Allah ke ahkaam ki baja-aavari mein mashghool rehte. Lekin aaj ki yeh rawash bilkul besood hai. Us din to khoob dekhte sunte ban jayenge aur aawaz ke sath farman-bardari karenge. Andheri jagah hashr hoga aasman lapet liya jayega sitare jhad padenge sooraj chaand mit jayega aawaz dene wale ki aawaz par sab chal khade honge. Us ek maidan mein saari makhlooq jama hogi magar us ghazab ka sanata hoga ke adaab-e-ilahi ki wajah se ek aawaz na uthegi. Bilkul sukoon-o-sakoot hoga sirf pairo ki chaap hogi aur kaana phoonsi. Chal kar ja rahe honge to pairo ki chaap to lamahala honi hi hai aur ba-ijazat-e-ilahi kabhi kabhi kisi kisi haal mein bolenge bhi. Lekin chalna bhi ba-adab aur bolna bhi ba-adab. Jaise irshad hai, (YAWMA YA'TI LA TAKALLAMU NAFSUN ILLA BI-IZNIH, FAMINHUM SHAQYYUN WA SAEED) (11. Hud : 105). Yaani jis din woh mere samne haazir honge kisi ki majaal na hogi ke baghair meri ijazat ke zaban khol le. Baaz naik honge aur baaz bad honge.

Ek dusre ke dushman. Hazrat Adam Alaihis Salam wa Hawwa Alaihis Salam aur Iblis-e-Laeen se usi waqt farma diya gaya ke tum sab jannat se nikal jao, Surah Al-Baqarah mein iski poori tafsir guzar chuki hai. Tum aapas mein ek dusre ke dushman ho yaani aulaad-e-Adam aur aulaad-e-Iblis. Tumhare paas mere Rasool aur meri kitabein aayengi, meri batai hui rah ki pairwi karne wale na to duniya mein ruswa honge na aakhirat mein zaleel honge. 

Haan, hukmon ke mukhalif, mere Rasool ki rah ke taarik, dusri raahon pe chalne wale duniya mein bhi tang rahenge, itminan aur kushaada dili mayassar na hogi, apni gumrahi ki wajah se tangi hi mein rahenge, go bazahir khane peene, pehnne odhne, rehne sehne ki farakhi ho lekin dil mein yaqeen-o-hidayat na hone ki wajah se hamesha shak shabey aur tangi aur qillat mein mubtala rahenge.

Duniya ki sazaein. Jo hudood-e-Ilahi ki parwah na karein, Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlayein, unhein hum usi tarah duniya aakhirat ke azaab mein mubtala karte hain khususan aakhirat ka azaab to bahut hi bhaari hai aur wahan koi na hoga jo bacha sake. Duniya ke azaab na to sakhti mein iske muqable ke hain na muddat mein daaimi aur nihayat almanaq hain. Mula'ana karne walon ko samjhate hue Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yehi farmaya tha ki duniya ki saza aakhirat ke azaabon ke muqable mein bahut hi halki aur na-cheez hai.

Veeranon se ibrat hasil karo. Jo log tujhe nahi maan rahe aur teri shariat ka inkar kar rahe hain kya woh is baat se bhi ibrat hasil nahi karte ke unse pehle jinhon ne yeh dhang nikale the hum ne unhein tabah-o-barbaad kardiya? Aaj unki ek aankh jhapakti hui aur ek saans chalta hua aur ek zuban bolti hui baaki nahi bachi, unke buland-o-bala pukhta aur khubsurat kushada aur zeenat-daar mahal veeran khandhar pade hue hain jahan se unki aamad-o-raft rehti thi agar yeh aqlmand hote toh yeh saman-e-ibrat unke liye bahut kuch tha. Kya yeh zameen mein chal phir kar qudrat ki un nishaniyon par dil se ghor-o-fikr nahi karte? Kya kaanon se unke dard-naak fasane sun kar ibrat hasil nahi karte? Kya yeh ujdi hui bastiyan dekh kar bhi aankhein nahi kholte? Yeh aankhon ke hi andhe nahi balki dil ke bhi andhe hain. Surah Alif-Lam-Mim As-Sajdah mein bhi mundarja-bala aayat jaisi aayat hai. Allah Ta'ala yeh baat muqarrar kar chuka hai ke jab tak bando par apni hujat khatam na karde unhein azaab nahi karta. Unke liye us ne ek waqt muqarrar kar diya hai, usi waqt unko unke aamal ki saza milegi. Agar yeh baat na hoti toh idhar gunah karte udhar pakad liye jaate. Toh unki takzeeb par sabr kar, unki behuda baaton par bardasht kar. Tasalli rakh yeh mere qabze se baahar nahi. 

Suraj nikalne se pehle se murad toh namaz-e-fajr hai aur suraj doobne se pehle se murad namaz-e-asr hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke hum ek martaba Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithe hue the aap ne chaudhween raat ke chaand ko dekh kar farmaya ke tum anqareeb apne Rab ko usi tarah dekhoge jis tarah is chaand ko baghair muzahamat aur takleef ke dekh rahe ho, pas agar tum se hosake toh suraj nikalne se pehle ki aur suraj ghuroob hone se pehli ki namaz ki poori tarah hifazat karo. Phir aap ne usi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Musnad Ahmad ki hadees mein hai ke aap ne farmaya in dono waqton ki namaz padhne wala aag mein na jayega. Musnad aur Sunan mein hai ke aap ne farmaya sab se adna darje ka jannati woh hai jo hazaar baras ki raah tak apni hi apni malkiyat dekhega sab se door ki cheez bhi uske liye aisi hi hogi jaise sab se nazdeek ki aur sab se aala manzil wale toh din mein do do dafa deedar-e-Ilahi karenge. 

Phir farmata hai raat ke waqton mein bhi tahajjud padha kar. Baaz kehte hain isse murad Maghrib aur Esha ki namaz hai. Aur din ke waqton mein bhi Allah ki pakeezgi bayaan kiya kar. Taake Allah ke ajr-o-sawab se tu khush hoja. Jaise farmaan hai ke anqareeb tera Allah tujhe woh dega ke tu khush hojayega. 

Sahih hadees mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmayega aye jannatiyo! Woh kahenge Labbaik Rabbana wa Sa'daik. Allah Ta'ala farmayega kya tum khush hogaye? Woh kahenge aye Allah hum bahut hi khush hain tu ne hamein woh nematein ata farma rakhi hain jo makhlooq mein se kisi ko nahi dien. Phir kya wajah ke hum raazi na hon. Janab-e-Bari Arham-ur-Rahimein farmayega lo main tumhe in sab se afzal cheez deta hoon. Poochhenge aye Allah is se afzal cheez kya hai?

Farmaye ga main tumhein apni razamandi deta hoon ke ab kisi waqt bhi main tumse na-khush na hoonga. Aur hadith mein hai ke jannatiyon se farmaya jayega ke Allah ne tumse jo wada kiya tha woh ise poora karne wala hai, kahenge Allah ke sab wade poore hue, hamare chehre roshan hain, hamari nekiyon ka palla garan raha, hamein dozakh se hata diya gaya, jannat mein dakhil kar diya gaya, ab kaun si cheez baqi hai? Isi waqt hijab uth jayenge aur deedar-e-Ilahi hoga. Allah ki qasam isse behtar aur koi naemat na hogi, yahi ziyadti hai.

Aaj unki ek aankh jhapakti hui aur ek saans chalta hua aur ek zuban bolti hui baaki nahi bachi, unke buland-o-bala pukhta aur khubsurat kushada aur zeenat-daar mahal veeran khandhar pade hue hain jahan se unki aamad-o-raft rehti thi agar yeh aqlmand hote toh yeh saman-e-ibrat unke liye bahut kuch tha. Kya yeh zameen mein chal phir kar qudrat ki un nishaniyon par dil se ghor-o-fikr nahi karte? Kya kaanon se unke dard-naak fasane sun kar ibrat hasil nahi karte? Kya yeh ujdi hui bastiyan dekh kar bhi aankhein nahi kholte? Yeh aankhon ke hi andhe nahi balki dil ke bhi andhe hain. Surah Alif-Lam-Mim As-Sajdah mein bhi mundarja-bala aayat jaisi aayat hai. Allah Ta'ala yeh baat muqarrar kar chuka hai ke jab tak bando par apni hujat khatam na karde unhein azaab nahi karta. Unke liye us ne ek waqt muqarrar kar diya hai, usi waqt unko unke aamal ki saza milegi. Agar yeh baat na hoti toh idhar gunah karte udhar pakad liye jaate. Toh unki takzeeb par sabr kar, unki behuda baaton par bardasht kar. Tasalli rakh yeh mere qabze se baahar nahi. 

Suraj nikalne se pehle se murad toh namaz-e-fajr hai aur suraj doobne se pehle se murad namaz-e-asr hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke hum ek martaba Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithe hue the aap ne chaudhween raat ke chaand ko dekh kar farmaya ke tum anqareeb apne Rab ko usi tarah dekhoge jis tarah is chaand ko baghair muzahamat aur takleef ke dekh rahe ho, pas agar tum se hosake toh suraj nikalne se pehle ki aur suraj ghuroob hone se pehli ki namaz ki poori tarah hifazat karo. Phir aap ne usi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Musnad Ahmad ki hadees mein hai ke aap ne farmaya in dono waqton ki namaz padhne wala aag mein na jayega. Musnad aur Sunan mein hai ke aap ne farmaya sab se adna darje ka jannati woh hai jo hazaar baras ki raah tak apni hi apni malkiyat dekhega sab se door ki cheez bhi uske liye aisi hi hogi jaise sab se nazdeek ki aur sab se aala manzil wale toh din mein do do dafa deedar-e-Ilahi karenge. 

Phir farmata hai raat ke waqton mein bhi tahajjud padha kar. Baaz kehte hain isse murad Maghrib aur Esha ki namaz hai. Aur din ke waqton mein bhi Allah ki pakeezgi bayaan kiya kar. Taake Allah ke ajr-o-sawab se tu khush hoja. Jaise farmaan hai ke anqareeb tera Allah tujhe woh dega ke tu khush hojayega. 

Sahih hadees mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmayega aye jannatiyo! Woh kahenge Labbaik Rabbana wa Sa'daik. Allah Ta'ala farmayega kya tum khush hogaye? Woh kahenge aye Allah hum bahut hi khush hain tu ne hamein woh nematein ata farma rakhi hain jo makhlooq mein se kisi ko nahi dien. Phir kya wajah ke hum raazi na hon. Janab-e-Bari Arham-ur-Rahimein farmayega lo main tumhe in sab se afzal cheez deta hoon. Poochhenge aye Allah is se afzal cheez kya hai?

Farmaye ga main tumhein apni razamandi deta hoon ke ab kisi waqt bhi main tumse na-khush na hoonga. Aur hadith mein hai ke jannatiyon se farmaya jayega ke Allah ne tumse jo wada kiya tha woh ise poora karne wala hai, kahenge Allah ke sab wade poore hue, hamare chehre roshan hain, hamari nekiyon ka palla garan raha, hamein dozakh se hata diya gaya, jannat mein dakhil kar diya gaya, ab kaun si cheez baqi hai? Isi waqt hijab uth jayenge aur deedar-e-Ilahi hoga. Allah ki qasam isse behtar aur koi naemat na hogi, yahi ziyadti hai.

Shukriya ya takabbur? In kuffar ki duniyawi zeenat aur un ki tip-top ko to hasrat bhari nigaahon se na dekh, yeh to zara si der ki cheezein hain. Yeh sirf an aazmaish ke liye unhein yahan mili hain ki dekhein shukr o tawazo karte hain ya nashukri aur takabbur karte hain? Haqiqatan shukr guzaaron ki kami hai. In ke maaladaron ko jo kuch mila hai us se tujhe to bahut hi behtar nemat mili hai. Hum ne tujhe saat aayatein di hain jo dohrai jaati hain aur Quran-e-Azeem ata farma rakha hai, pas apni nazrein in ke duniyawi saaz-o-samaan ki taraf na daal. Isi tarah Aey Rasool Allah ﷺ aap ke liye Allah ke paas jo mehman-dari hai us ki na to koi inteha hai aur na us waqt koi is ke bayaan ki taaqat rakhta hai. Tujhe tera parvardigar is qadar dega ki tu raazi razamand ho jayega. Allah ki deen behtar aur baaqi hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne apni azwaaj-e-mutahharat se ila kiya tha aur ek baala-khane mein muqeem the. Hazrat Umar ؓ jab wahan pahuche toh dekha ki aap ek khurdare boriye par lete hue hain, chamde ka ek tukra ek taraf rakha tha aur kuch mashkein latak rahi thein. Yeh be-sar-o-samani ki halat dekh kar aap ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ne daryaft kiya kyun ro diye? Jawab diya ke Huzoor ﷺ Qaisar-o-Kisra kis qadar aish-o-ishrat mein hain aur aap bawajood saari makhlooq mein se Allah ke barguzida hone ke kis halat mein hain? Aap ne farmaya Aey Khattab ke bete kya ab tak tum shaq mein hi ho? In logon ko achhaiyon ne duniya mein hi jaldi kar li hai. Pas Rasool ﷺ bawajood qudrat aur dastaras ke duniya se nihayat hi be-raghbat the. Jo haath lagta use rah-e-lillah de dete aur apne liye ek paisa bhi na bacha rakhte. Ibn Abi Hatim mein Huzoor ﷺ ka farman marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya mujhe to tum par sab se zyada khauf is waqt ka hai ke duniya tumhare qadmon mein apna tamam saaz-o-samaan daal degi, apni barkatein tum par ulat degi. Al-Gharz kuffar ko zeenat ki zindagi aur duniya sirf un ki aazmaish ke liye di jaati hai. Apne gharane ke logon ko namaz ki taakeed karo taake woh azab-e-ilahi se bach jayen, khud bhi pabandi ke sath is ki adai-gi karo. Apne aap ko aur apne ahl-o-ayyal ko jahannam se bacha lo. Hazrat Umar Farooq ؓ ki aadat-e-mubarakah thi ke raat ko jab tahajjud ke liye uthte toh apne ghar walon ko bhi jagate aur isi aayat ki tilawat farmate. Hum tujh se rizq ke talib nahi. Namaz ki pabandi kar lo Allah aisi jagah se rizq pahunchayega jo khwab-o-khayal mein bhi na ho. Allah Ta'ala parheizgaron ke liye chhutkara kar deta hai aur be-shaan-o-guman jagah se rizq pahunchata hai. Tamam jinnaat aur insan sirf ibadat-e-ilahi ke liye paida kiye gaye hain, Razzaq aur zabardast quwaton ke maalik Allah Ta'ala hi hain. Farmata hai hum khud tamam makhlooq ke rizq-rasaan hain, hum tumhein talab ki takleef nahi dete. Hazrat Hisham ke walid sahab jab amir umra ke makanon par jaate aur un ka thaath dekhte toh wapas apne makan par aa kar isi aayat ki tilawat farmate aur kehte mere kunbe walo namaz ki hifazat karo, namaz ki pabandi karo.

Allah Ta'ala tum par raham farmaye ga. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki jab Huzoor ﷺ ko koi tangi hoti to apne ghar ke sab logon ko farmate 'Ae mere ghar walon namazein padho, namazein qaim rakho.' Tamam Anbiya Alaihimas Salam ka yahi tariqa raha hai ki apni har ghabrahat aur har kaam ke waqt namaz shuru kar dete. Tirmizi, Ibn Majah waghera ki Qudsi Hadith mein hai ki Allah Ta'ala farmata hai 'Ae Ibn-e-Adam meri ibadat ke liye farigh ho ja, main tera seena amiri aur be-parwahi se pur kar doon ga, teri faqiri aur hajat ko door kar doon ga aur agar tu ne yeh na kiya toh main tera dil ashغال se bhar doon ga aur teri faqiri band hi na karoon ga.' 

Ibn Majah Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain 'Jis ne apni tamam ghor-o-fikr aur qasd-o-khayal ko ikhatta karke akhirat ka khayal bandh liya aur usi mein mashghool ho gaya, Allah Ta'ala use duniya ki tamam pareshaniyon se mehfooz kar lega. Aur jis ne duniya ki fikarain pal lin, yahan ke gham mol liye, Allah ko us ki mutlaqan parwah na rahegi khwah kisi hairani mein halak ho jaye.' 

Aur riwayat mein hai ki duniya ke ghamon mein hi, usi ki fikron mein hi masroof ho jane wale ke tamam kaamon mein Allah Ta'ala pareshaniyan daal dega aur us ki faqiri us ki ankhon ke samne kar dega aur duniya utni hi milegi jitni muqaddar mein hai aur jo dil ka markaz akhirat ko bana lega, apni niyyat wahi rakhega, Allah Ta'ala use har kaam ka itminan naseeb farma dega, us ke dil ko ser aur sher bana dega aur duniya us ke qadmon ki thokron mein aya karegi. 

Phir farmaya duniya-o-akhirat mein naik anjam parhezgar log hi hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain 'Main ne aj raat khwab mein dekha ki goya hum Uqbah bin Rafi ke ghar mein hain. Wahan hamare samne Ibn-e-Tab ke bagh ki tar khajoorein pesh ki gayi hain. Main ne is ki tabeer yeh ki hai ki duniya mein bhi anjam ke lihaz se hamara hi palla garan rahega aur bulandi aur onchai hum ko hi milegi aur hamara deen pak saaf, tayyib-o-tahir, kamil-o-mukammal hai.'

Quran-e-Hakeem sab se bara mojiza. Kuffar yeh bhi kaha karte thay ke aakhir kya wajah hai ke yeh Nabi apni sachai ka koi mojiza hamein nahi dikhate? Jawab milta hai ke yeh hai Quran-e-Kareem jo agli kitabon ki khabar ke mutabiq Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ par utara hai jo na likhna jaanein na parhna ﷺ. Dekh lo is mein agle logon ke halaat hain aur bilkul un kitabon ke mutabiq jo Allah ki taraf se is se pehle nazil shuda hain. Quran un sab ka nigehbaan hai. Chunke agli kitabein kami-beshi se paak nahi rahein, is liye Quran utra hai ke un ki sehat-o-ghairsehat ko mumtaz karde. Surah Ankabut mein kafiron ke is etraz ke jawab mein farmaya (Qul innamal-ayatu indallahi wa ma yush'irukum annaha iza ja'at la yu'minun) (6. Al-Anam: 109) yaani keh de ke Allah Ta'ala Rabbul-Alameen har qism ke mojizaat zahir karne par qadir hai, main to sirf tanbeeh karne wala Rasul hoon, mere qabze mein koi mojiza nahi lekin kya unhein yeh mojiza kafi nahi ke hum ne tujh par kitab nazil farmayi hai jo un ke samne barabar tilawat ki ja rahi hai jis mein har yaqeen wale ke liye rahmat-o-ibrat hai.

Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Har Nabi ko aise mojize mile ke unhein dekh kar log un ki nabuvat par iman le aaye. Lekin mujhe jeeta jagta, zinda aur hamesha rehne wala mojiza diya gaya hai yaani Allah ki yeh kitab Quran-e-Majeed jo ba-zariya wahi mujh par utri hai. Pas mujhe umeed hai ke Qiyamat ke din tamam nabiyon ke tabaidaron se mere tabaidar zyada honge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yahan Rasulullah ﷺ ka sab se bara mojiza bayan hua hai, is se yeh matlab nahi ke aap ke mojize aur thay hi nahi, alawa is paak mojiza-e-Quran ke aap ke hathon is qadr mojizaat sarzad hue hain jo ginti mein nahi aa sakte. Lekin un tamam beshumar mojizon se barh charh kar aap ka sab se aala mojiza Quran-e-Kareem hai.

Agar is mohtaram Khatam-ul-Mursaleen aakhri paighambar A.S ko bhejne se pehle hi hum in na manne walon ko apne azab se halak kar dete to un ka yeh uzr baqi reh jata ke agar hamare paighambar aate, koi wahi-e-ilahi nazil hoti to hum zaroor is par iman laate aur is ki tabaidari aur farmanbardari mein lag jaate aur is zillat-o-ruswai se bach jaate. Is liye hum ne un ka yeh uzr bhi kaat diya. Rasul bhej diya, kitab nazil farma di, unhein iman naseeb na hua, azabon ke mustahiq ban gaye aur uzr bhi door ho gaye. Hum khoob jaante hain ke ek kya hazaron aayetein aur nishanaat dekh kar bhi unhein iman naseeb nahi hoga. Haan jab azabon ko apni aankhon se dekh lenge is waqt iman layenge lekin woh mahz be-sood hai, jaise farmaya hum ne yeh paak aur behtar kitab nazil farma di hai jo ba-barkat hai tum ise maan lo aur is ki farmanbardari karo to tum par raham kiya jayega, al-akh. Yehi mazmoon aayat (Wa aqsamu billahi jahda aimanihim la-in ja'at-hum ayatun layu'minunna biha) (6. Al-Anam: 109) mein bhi hai.

Al-An'am: 109 mein hai ke kehte hain ke Rasool ki amad par hum momin ban jayenge mojiza dekh kar iman qubool kar lenge lekin hum in ki sirisht se waqif hain yeh tamam aayatein dekh kar bhi iman na layenge. Phir irshad hota hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in kafiron se keh dijiye ke udhar hum udhar tum muntazir hain. Abhi haal khul jayega ke rah-e-mustaqeem par kaun hai? Haq ki taraf kaun chal raha hai? Azabon ko dekhte hi aankhein khul jayengi us waqt maloom ho jayega kaun gumrahi mein mubtala tha. Ghabrao nahi abhi abhi jaan loge ke kazzab aur shareer kaun tha? Yaqinan musalman rah-e-rast par hain aur ghair-muslim is se hate hue hain.

Phir irshad hota hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in kafiron se keh dijiye ke udhar hum udhar tum muntazir hain. Abhi haal khul jayega ke rah-e-mustaqeem par kaun hai? Haq ki taraf kaun chal raha hai? Azabon ko dekhte hi aankhein khul jayengi us waqt maloom ho jayega kaun gumrahi mein mubtala tha. Ghabrao nahi abhi abhi jaan loge ke kazzab aur shareer kaun tha? Yaqinan musalman rah-e-rast par hain aur ghair-muslim is se hate hue hain.

Quran-e-Hakeem sab se bara mojiza. Kuffar yeh bhi kaha karte thay ke aakhir kya wajah hai ke yeh Nabi apni sachai ka koi mojiza hamein nahi dikhate? Jawab milta hai ke yeh hai Quran-e-Kareem jo agli kitabon ki khabar ke mutabiq Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ par utara hai jo na likhna jaanein na parhna ﷺ. Dekh lo is mein agle logon ke halaat hain aur bilkul un kitabon ke mutabiq jo Allah ki taraf se is se pehle nazil shuda hain. Quran un sab ka nigehbaan hai. Chunke agli kitabein kami-beshi se paak nahi rahein, is liye Quran utra hai ke un ki sehat-o-ghairsehat ko mumtaz karde. Surah Ankabut mein kafiron ke is etraz ke jawab mein farmaya (Qul innamal-ayatu indallahi wa ma yush'irukum annaha iza ja'at la yu'minun) (6. Al-Anam: 109) yaani keh de ke Allah Ta'ala Rabbul-Alameen har qism ke mojizaat zahir karne par qadir hai, main to sirf tanbeeh karne wala Rasul hoon, mere qabze mein koi mojiza nahi lekin kya unhein yeh mojiza kafi nahi ke hum ne tujh par kitab nazil farmayi hai jo un ke samne barabar tilawat ki ja rahi hai jis mein har yaqeen wale ke liye rahmat-o-ibrat hai.

Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Har Nabi ko aise mojize mile ke unhein dekh kar log un ki nabuvat par iman le aaye. Lekin mujhe jeeta jagta, zinda aur hamesha rehne wala mojiza diya gaya hai yaani Allah ki yeh kitab Quran-e-Majeed jo ba-zariya wahi mujh par utri hai. Pas mujhe umeed hai ke Qiyamat ke din tamam nabiyon ke tabaidaron se mere tabaidar zyada honge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yahan Rasulullah ﷺ ka sab se bara mojiza bayan hua hai, is se yeh matlab nahi ke aap ke mojize aur thay hi nahi, alawa is paak mojiza-e-Quran ke aap ke hathon is qadr mojizaat sarzad hue hain jo ginti mein nahi aa sakte. Lekin un tamam beshumar mojizon se barh charh kar aap ka sab se aala mojiza Quran-e-Kareem hai.

Agar is mohtaram Khatam-ul-Mursaleen aakhri paighambar A.S ko bhejne se pehle hi hum in na manne walon ko apne azab se halak kar dete to un ka yeh uzr baqi reh jata ke agar hamare paighambar aate, koi wahi-e-ilahi nazil hoti to hum zaroor is par iman laate aur is ki tabaidari aur farmanbardari mein lag jaate aur is zillat-o-ruswai se bach jaate. Is liye hum ne un ka yeh uzr bhi kaat diya. Rasul bhej diya, kitab nazil farma di, unhein iman naseeb na hua, azabon ke mustahiq ban gaye aur uzr bhi door ho gaye. Hum khoob jaante hain ke ek kya hazaron aayetein aur nishanaat dekh kar bhi unhein iman naseeb nahi hoga. Haan jab azabon ko apni aankhon se dekh lenge is waqt iman layenge lekin woh mahz be-sood hai, jaise farmaya hum ne yeh paak aur behtar kitab nazil farma di hai jo ba-barkat hai tum ise maan lo aur is ki farmanbardari karo to tum par raham kiya jayega, al-akh.
